zh-Hans: 信鸽推送为开发者提供免费、快速、简单的推送服务。
en: Xinge Push provides developers with free, fast, and simple push services.

zh-Hans: Mars 是微信官方的跨平台跨业务的终端基础组件。
en: Mars is the cross-platform cross-business terminal basic component officially developed by WeChat.

zh-Hans: xCrash 能为安卓 app 提供捕获 Java 崩溃，native 崩溃和 ANR 的能力。不需要 root 权限或任何系统权限。
en: xCrash provides the ability to capture Java crashes, native crashes, and ANRs for Android apps. No root or system permissions are required.

zh-Hans: Weex 致力于使开发者能基于通用跨平台的 Web 开发语言和开发经验，来构建 Android、iOS 和 Web 应用。简单来说，在集成了 WeexSDK 之后，你可以使用 JavaScript 语言和前端开发经验来开发移动应用。
en: Weex is committed to enabling developers to build Android, iOS, and Web applications based on common cross-platform web development languages and experiences. Simply put, after integrating WeexSDK, you can use JavaScript language and front-end development experience to develop mobile applications.

zh-Hans: 穿山甲是巨量引擎旗下全球应用变现与增长平台，合作优质媒体超 30,000 家，日请求突破 607 亿，日均展示达 100 亿，覆盖 7 亿日活用户，为全球应用和广告主提供高效的用户增长和变现解决方案。
en: Pangolin is a global application monetization and growth platform under ByteDance, cooperating with over 30,000 quality media, with daily requests exceeding 60.7 billion, daily displays reaching 10 billion, covering 700 million daily active users, providing efficient user growth and monetization solutions for global applications and advertisers.

zh-Hans: MNN 是一个高效、轻量的深度学习框架。它支持深度模型推理与训练，尤其在端侧的推理与训练性能在业界处于领先地位。
en: MNN is an efficient, lightweight deep learning framework. It supports deep model inference and training, especially leading in inference and training performance on the end side.

zh-Hans: 小米应用检查更新 SDK
小米应用检查更新 SDK 帮助您的用户尽快获得最新版本的应用，轻松增加【应用检查更新】的功能，通过小米应用商店的 CDN 服务，快速的把最新版应用推送给用户。
en: Xiaomi App Update Check SDK helps your users get the latest version of the app as soon as possible, easily adding the 'App Update Check' feature, and quickly pushing the latest version of the app to users through the Xiaomi App Store's CDN service.

zh-Hans: HUAWEI AR Engine 是一个用于在 Android 上构建增强现实应用的平台。HUAWEI AR Engine 基于海思芯片平台整合 AR 核心算法提供了运动跟踪、环境跟踪、人体和人脸跟踪等 AR 基础能力，通过这些能力可让您的应用实现虚拟世界与现实世界的融合，为您的应用提供全新的视觉体验和交互方式。
en: HUAWEI AR Engine is a platform for building augmented reality applications on Android. Based on the HiSilicon chip platform, HUAWEI AR Engine integrates AR core algorithms to provide basic AR capabilities such as motion tracking, environment tracking, body and face tracking. These capabilities can enable your application to achieve the fusion of the virtual world and the real world, providing a new visual experience and interaction method for your application.

zh-Hans: Fresco 是一个用于管理图像及其使用的内存的 Android 库。
en: Fresco is an Android library for managing images and their memory usage.

zh-Hans: Yoga 意在打造一个跨 iOS、Android、Windows 平台在内的布局引擎，兼容 Flexbox 布局方式，让界面布局更加简单。
en: Yoga aims to create a layout engine across iOS, Android, and Windows platforms, compatible with the Flexbox layout method, making interface layout simpler.

zh-Hans: Bugly 是 TDS 腾讯端服务（Tencent Device-oriented Service）旗下的端质量监控平台，通过采集、监控、定位、告警等核心能力，提供专业的质量监控服务，帮助开发者及时发现并解决质量问题，打造高质量应用。
en: Bugly is an end quality monitoring platform under Tencent Device-oriented Service (TDS), which provides professional quality monitoring services through the core competencies of collection, monitoring, location, and alerts to help developers find and solve quality problems in time and build high-quality applications.

zh-Hans: React Native 使你只使用 JavaScript 也能编写原生移动应用。 它在设计原理上和 React 一致，通过声明式的组件机制来搭建丰富多彩的用户界面。
en: React Native allows you to write native mobile applications using only JavaScript. It is consistent with React in design principles, building rich user interfaces through a declarative component mechanism.

zh-Hans: AndFix 是一种在线修复错误而无需重新分发 Android App 的解决方案。
en: AndFix is a solution for fixing bugs online without redistributing the Android App.

zh-Hans: DuMix AR 平台是百度 AR 推出的 AR 技术产品化应用服务，帮助开发者快速集成 SDK，高效制作并分发 AR 内容。它包括 AR SDK、内容制作工具、云端内容平台和内容分发服务，组成了一站式 AR 开发集成解决方案。
en: DuMix AR Platform is an AR technology productized application service launched by Baidu AR, helping developers quickly integrate SDKs, efficiently produce and distribute AR content. It includes AR SDK, content production tools, cloud content platform, and content distribution services, forming a one-stop AR development and integration solution.

zh-Hans: Facebook SDK是适用于 Android 的将 Facebook集成到 Android 应用程序中的最简单方法。
en: Facebook SDK is the easiest way to integrate Facebook into Android applications for Android.

zh-Hans: GPUImage for Android 是一个开源项目，用于在 Android 上执行 GPU 加速的图像和视频处理。
en: GPUImage for Android is an open-source project for performing GPU-accelerated image and video processing on Android.

zh-Hans: SQLCipher 是一个 SQLite 扩展，它提供数据库文件的 256 位 AES 加密能力。
en: SQLCipher is an SQLite extension that provides 256-bit AES encryption for database files.

zh-Hans: 云直播（Cloud Streaming Services，CSS）依托腾讯强大的技术平台，将腾讯视频等核心业务底层能力开放给用户，为用户提供专业稳定快速的直播接入和分发服务，具有低延迟、高安全、高性能、易接入、多终端、多码率支持等特点。
en: Cloud Streaming Services (CSS) relies on Tencent's powerful technical platform, opening up the core business underlying capabilities of Tencent Video to users, providing professional, stable, and fast live streaming access and distribution services, characterized by low latency, high security, high performance, easy access, multi-terminal, and multi-bitrate support.

zh-Hans: 腾讯云通信基于 QQ 底层 IM 能力开发，仅需植入 SDK 即可轻松集成聊天、会话、群组、资料管理能力，帮助您实现文字、图片、短语音、短视频等富媒体消息收发，全面满足通信需要。
en: Tencent Cloud Communication, developed based on QQ's underlying IM capabilities, allows easy integration of chat, session, group, and data management capabilities by embedding the SDK, helping you achieve the sending and receiving of rich media messages like text, images, short voice, and short video, fully meeting communication needs.

zh-Hans: 腾讯云点播推出了短视频一站式解决方案，覆盖了视频生成、上传、处理、分发和播放在内的各个环节，帮助用户以最快速度实现短视频应用的上线。
en: Tencent Cloud VOD has launched a one-stop solution for short videos, covering all aspects of video generation, upload, processing, distribution, and playback, helping users to launch short video applications as quickly as possible.

zh-Hans: LiteRT（简称自 Lite Runtime，以前称为 TensorFlow Lite）是 Google 面向设备端 AI 的高性能运行时。
en: LiteRT (short for Lite Runtime), formerly known as TensorFlow Lite, is Google's high-performance runtime for on-device AI.

zh-Hans: glog 是一个 C++ 日志库，它提供 C++ 流式风格的 API。
en: glog is a C++ logging library that provides a C++ stream-style API.

zh-Hans: 银联在线支付网关是中国银联联合各商业银行为持卡人提供的集成化、综合性互联网支付工具，主要支持输入卡号付款、用户登录支付、网银支付、迷你付（IC 卡支付）等多种支付方式，为持卡人提供境内外网上购物、水电煤缴费、商旅预订等支付服务。
en: UnionPay Online Payment Gateway is an integrated, comprehensive internet payment tool provided by China UnionPay in collaboration with commercial banks. It mainly supports various payment methods such as card number input payment, user login payment, online banking payment, and mini payment (IC card payment), offering cardholders services for domestic and international online shopping, utility bill payments, travel bookings, and more.

zh-Hans: IJKPlayer 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的轻量级 Android/iOS 视频播放器，具有 API 易于集成、编译配置可裁剪、支持硬件加速解码、DanmakuFlameMaster 架构清晰、简单易用等优势。
en: IJKPlayer is a lightweight Android/iOS video player based on FFmpeg, with advantages such as easy-to-integrate APIs, customizable compile configurations, support for hardware-accelerated decoding, a clear DanmakuFlameMaster architecture, and ease of use.

zh-Hans: HTTPDNS 基于 HTTP 协议向腾讯云的 DNS 服务器发送域名解析请求，替代了基于 DNS 协议向运营商 LocalDNS 发起解析请求的传统方式，可以避免 LocalDNS 造成的域名劫持和跨网访问问题，解决移动互联网服务中域名解析异常带来的困扰。
en: HTTPDNS sends domain name resolution requests to Tencent Cloud's DNS server based on the HTTP protocol, replacing the traditional method of initiating resolution requests to the operator's LocalDNS based on the DNS protocol. This can avoid domain hijacking and cross-network access issues caused by LocalDNS, solving the troubles brought by domain resolution anomalies in mobile internet services.

zh-Hans: AndroLua 是基于 LuaJava 开发的安卓平台轻量级脚本编程语言工具，既具有 Lua 简洁优雅的特质，又支持绝大部分安卓 API，可以使你在手机上快速编写小型应用。
en: AndroLua is a lightweight scripting language tool for the Android platform developed based on LuaJava, featuring the simplicity and elegance of Lua while supporting most Android APIs, enabling you to quickly write small applications on your phone.

zh-Hans: 阿里聚安全是面向开发者，以移动应用安全为核心的开放平台。
en: Alibaba Ju Security is an open platform focused on mobile application security for developers.

zh-Hans: Unity 是一款由 Unity Technologies 所研发的跨平台2D / 3D 游戏引擎，可用于开发 Windows、MacOS 及 Linux 平台的单机游戏，PlayStation、XBox、Wii、3DS 和 任天堂Switch 等游戏主机平台的视频游戏，以及 iOS、Android 等移动设备的游戏。
en: Unity is a cross-platform 2D/3D game engine developed by Unity Technologies, used for developing standalone games for Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, video games for game consoles such as PlayStation, Xbox, Wii, 3DS, and Nintendo Switch, as well as games for mobile devices such as iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: Xamarin 是一个跨平台开发软件，通过使用 C# 共享的代码库，开发人员可以使用 Xamarin 工具，使用本地用户界面编写原生的 Android、iOS 和 Windows 应用程序，并跨多个平台（包括 Windows 和 MacOS）共享代码。
en: Xamarin is cross-platform development software that allows developers to use Xamarin tools to write native Android, iOS, and Windows applications using a shared C# codebase and share code across multiple platforms, including Windows and macOS.

zh-Hans: RenderScript 是用于在 Android 上以高性能运行计算密集型任务的框架。RenderScript 主要用于数据并行计算，不过串行工作负载也可以从中受益。RenderScript 运行时可在设备上提供的多个处理器（如多核 CPU 和 GPU）间并行调度工作。这样您就能够专注于表达算法而不是调度工作。RenderScript 对于执行图像处理、计算摄影或计算机视觉的应用来说尤其有用。
en: RenderScript is a framework for running computationally intensive tasks on Android with high performance. RenderScript is primarily used for data-parallel computation, but serial workloads can also benefit from it. The RenderScript runtime can parallel schedule work across multiple processors available on a device, such as multi-core CPUs and GPUs. This allows you to focus on expressing algorithms rather than scheduling work. RenderScript is particularly useful for applications performing image processing, computational photography, or computer vision.

zh-Hans: 针对目前移动应用普遍存在的破解、篡改、盗版、钓鱼欺诈、内存调试、数据窃取等各类安全风险，梆梆安全为开发者提供全面的移动应用加固加密技术和攻击防范服务。
en: Bangbang Security provides developers with comprehensive mobile application reinforcement encryption technology and attack prevention services, targeting various security risks commonly found in mobile applications, such as cracking, tampering, piracy, phishing fraud, memory debugging, and data theft.

zh-Hans: Flutter 是一个开源的用户界面工具包，用于从单一代码库中为移动、网络、桌面和嵌入式设备构建美观的本地编译应用程序。
en: Flutter is an open source UI toolkit for building beautiful, natively compiled applications for mobile, web, desktop, and embedded devices from a single codebase.

zh-Hans: 岳鹰全景监控，是阿里 UC 官方出品的先进移动应用线上监控平台，为多家知名企业提供服务。
en: Yueying Panorama Monitoring is an advanced mobile application online monitoring platform officially produced by Alibaba UC, providing services for many well-known enterprises.

zh-Hans: 环信即时通讯云为开发者提供基于移动互联网的即时通讯能力，如单聊、群聊、发语音、发图片、发位置、实时音频、实时视频等，让开发者摆脱繁重的移动 IM 通讯底层开发，24 小时即可让 App 拥有稳定健壮的内置 IM 能力。
en: Huanxin Instant Messaging Cloud provides developers with mobile internet-based instant messaging capabilities, such as single chat, group chat, voice messages, images, location sharing, real-time audio, and video, allowing developers to bypass the heavy lifting of mobile IM communication layer development, enabling apps to have stable and robust built-in IM capabilities within 24 hours.

zh-Hans: ⼩米⼩爱开放平台借助小米的硬件生态和海量数据，提供全球领先的语音识别、NLP 等多项人工智能技术，为开发者提供一站式的人工智能服务平台。小米小爱开放平台包括语音服务平台和技能开发平台两部分，为企业级用户和个人开发者打造更多更好的语⾳服务和技能。
en: Xiaomi Xiaoai Open Platform leverages Xiaomi's hardware ecosystem and vast data to provide globally leading voice recognition, NLP, and other artificial intelligence technologies, offering developers a one-stop artificial intelligence service platform. Xiaomi Xiaoai Open Platform includes a voice service platform and a skill development platform, creating more and better voice services and skills for enterprise-level users and individual developers.

zh-Hans: 移动智能终端补充设备标识体系统一调用 SDK 由中国信息通信研究院泰尔终端实验室、移动安全联盟整合提供，知识产权归中国信息通信研究院所有。
en: Mobile Intelligent Terminal Supplementary Device Identification System Unified Call SDK is provided by the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology's Terminal Laboratory and the Mobile Security Alliance. The intellectual property rights belong to the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology.

zh-Hans: 小米游戏是小米手机、小米平板、小米电视的官方游戏下载平台，在这里我们为所有游戏开发者提供一站式的接入服务，并提供高质量分发与推广服务，为您的游戏助跑。
en: Xiaomi Games is the official game download platform for Xiaomi phones, Xiaomi tablets, and Xiaomi TVs. Here we provide one-stop access services for all game developers, as well as high-quality distribution and promotion services to give your game a boost.

zh-Hans: ARCore 是 Google 的增强现实体验构建平台。 ARCore 利用不同的 API 让您的手机能够感知其环境、理解现实世界并与信息进行交互。 一些在 Android 和 iOS 上同时提供的 API 支持共享 AR 体验。
en: ARCore is Google's platform for building augmented reality experiences. ARCore uses different APIs to enable your phone to sense its environment, understand the world, and interact with information. Some of the APIs are available across Android and iOS to enable shared AR experiences.

zh-Hans: MTA 为您的应用（APP、H5和小程序）提供实时数据统计分析服务，监控版本质量、渠道状况、用户画像属性及用户细分行为，通过数据可视化展现，协助产品、运营和市场决策。
en: MTA provides real-time data statistics and analysis services for your applications (APP, H5, and mini-programs), monitoring version quality, channel conditions, user profile attributes, and user segmentation behavior, presenting data through visualization to assist product, operation, and market decision-making.

zh-Hans: 微博 Android 平台 SDK 为第三方应用提供了简单易用的微博 API 调用服务，使第三方客户端无需了解复杂的验证机制即可进行授权登陆，并提供微博分享功能，可直接通过微博官方客户端分享微博。
en: Weibo Android Platform SDK provides third-party applications with simple and easy-to-use Weibo API call services, allowing third-party clients to authorize login without understanding complex authentication mechanisms, and providing Weibo sharing functions, enabling sharing through the official Weibo client.

zh-Hans: 高德地图 Android SDK 是一套地图开发调用接口，开发者可以轻松地在自己的 Android 应用中加入地图相关的功能，包括：地图显示（含室内、室外地图）、与地图交互、在地图上绘制、兴趣点搜索、地理编码、离线地图等功能。
en: Amap Android SDK is a set of map development interface that allows developers to easily integrate map-related functions into their Android applications, including map display (indoor and outdoor maps), map interaction, drawing on the map, point of interest search, geocoding, offline maps, and more.

zh-Hans: 借助 ViroCore，Android 开发者现在可以使用熟悉的语言和工具来构建沉浸式 AR/VR 应用。
en: With ViroCore, Android developers can now use familiar languages and tools to build immersive AR/VR applications.

zh-Hans: 腾讯地图定位 SDK 是一套基于 Android 4.1 及以上版本设备的应用程序接口。通过该接口，您可以轻松使用腾讯地图定位服务，构建 LBS 应用程序。
en: Tencent Map Location SDK is a set of application programming interfaces based on Android 4.1 and above devices. Through this interface, you can easily use Tencent map location services to build LBS applications.

zh-Hans: Bmob 后端云专注于为移动应用提供一整套后端云服务，帮助开发者免去几乎所有的服务器端编码的工作量，成倍降低开发成本和开发时间。
en: Bmob Backend Cloud focuses on providing a complete set of backend cloud services for mobile applications, helping developers eliminate almost all server-side coding workload, exponentially reducing development costs and time.

zh-Hans: IM 即时通讯 - SealTalk 支持应用内社交等场景，体验单群聊、聊天室、音视频通话、小视频、动态表情等通讯能力
en: IM Instant Messaging - SealTalk supports in-app social scenarios, providing experiences like single and group chat, chat rooms, audio and video calls, short videos, dynamic expressions, and more.

zh-Hans: WGS84 为一种大地坐标系，也是目前广泛使用的 GPS 全球卫星定位系统使用的坐标系。GCJ02 又称火星坐标系，是由中国国家测绘局制定的地理坐标系统，是由 WGS84 加密后得到的坐标系。在中国，所有的坐标都必须经过国家测绘局进行偏移，因此需要将 GPS 坐标进行转换。
en: WGS84 is a geodetic coordinate system and is the coordinate system used by the widely-used GPS global positioning system. GCJ02, also known as Mars Coordinate System, is a geospatial coordinate system formulated by the National Mapping Bureau of China, obtained by encrypting WGS84. In China, all coordinates must be shifted by the National Mapping Bureau, thus requiring GPS coordinates to be converted.

zh-Hans: Bugsnag 的 Android 崩溃报告库会自动检测 Android 应用程序中的崩溃，收集诊断信息并立即通知您的开发团队，以帮助您尽快理解和解决问题。
en: Bugsnag's Android crash reporting library automatically detects crashes in Android applications, collects diagnostic information, and immediately notifies your development team to help you understand and resolve issues as soon as possible.

zh-Hans: Realm 平台是一个用于跨平台应用程序的次世代数据层。Realm 是响应式的、并发的和轻量级的，它允许您使用实时的原生对象。使用 Realm 可使您的应用程序在信号较弱、脱机或中断的情况下无缝运行。
en: The Realm platform is a next-generation data layer for cross-platform applications. Realm is reactive, concurrent, and lightweight, allowing you to use live native objects. Using Realm enables your application to run seamlessly in weak signal, offline, or interrupted conditions.

zh-Hans: OpenCV 是一个跨平台的计算机视觉库，可用于开发实时的图像处理、计算机视觉以及模式识别程序。
en: OpenCV is a cross-platform computer vision library that can be used for developing real-time image processing, computer vision, and pattern recognition programs.

zh-Hans: BoostMultiDex是一个用于Android低版本设备（4.X及以下，SDK < 21）快速加载多DEX的解决方案。
en: BoostMultiDex is a solution for quickly loading multiple DEX files on low-version Android devices (4.X and below, SDK < 21).

zh-Hans: Chromium 项目有一个通用实用程序库，称为 libbase。因为它是独立的，不依赖于 Chromium 的其他部分，所以已被其他与 Google 相关的项目采用，以便人们不必重新发明这些东西。沿着这些思路，Chromium OS 中提供了一个包，以便我们特定的项目可以共享代码，而无需多次打包。目前，Chromium OS 中有超过 20 个这样的项目。为了让人们保持警惕，该包被命名为 libchrome，因为 libbase 本身太混乱了。当然，libchrome 本身也不够清晰，但这是一个两难境地，我们尽力而为。请仍然爱我们。
en: The Chromium project has a general utility library referred to as libbase. Because it is standalone and does not depend on any other parts of Chromium, it has been picked up by other Google related projects so people don't have to reinvent these things. Along those lines, a package in Chromium OS is provided so that projects specific to us can share the code without having to bundle it multiple times over. Currently, there are over 20 such projects in Chromium OS. To keep people on their toes, the package is named libchrome as libbase by itself is too confusing. Granted, libchrome isn‘t exactly clear itself, but it’s a lose-lose situation, and we tried our best. Please still love us.

zh-Hans: OpenSSL 是用于传输层安全性（TLS）协议的健壮的，商业级，功能齐全的开源工具包。协议实现基于完整功能的通用密码库，该库也可以独立使用。
en: OpenSSL is a robust, commercial-grade, full-featured open-source toolkit for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The protocol implementation is based on a full-featured general-purpose cryptographic library, which can also be used independently.

zh-Hans: android-gif-drawable 是在 Android 上显示动画 GIF 的绘制库。
en: android-gif-drawable is a library for displaying animated GIFs on Android.

zh-Hans: 天翼数字生活科技有限公司
自动识别本机号码，实现一键登录。
en: 天翼数字生活科技有限公司
Automatically detects the local phone number to enable one-click login.

zh-Hans: SDK 快速集成，免费注册使用。智能推送+场景推送，有效提升用户活跃度与粘性。
en: Quick SDK integration, free registration and use. Smart push + scenario push effectively enhance user activity and stickiness.

zh-Hans: 腾讯移动开放平台是为广大移动端应用开发者提供的平台。
en: Tencent Mobile Open Platform is a platform provided for mobile application developers.

zh-Hans: GIFLIB 项目维护 giflib 服务库，自 1989 年以来一直从 GIF 中提取图像。它部署在您能想到的所有地方，以及一些您可能想不到的地方——多个操作系统、游戏机、智能手机上的图形应用程序和网络浏览器，甚至可能是您的 ATM。
en: The GIFLIB project maintains the giflib service library, which has been pulling images out of GIFs since 1989. It is deployed everywhere you can think of and some places you probably can't - graphics applications and web browsers on multiple operating systems, game consoles, smartphones, and likely your ATM too.

zh-Hans: 作为腾讯端服务（Tencent Device-oriented Service，简称 TDS）产品联盟的重要成员，MMKV 是由微信团队开发并已在 GitHub 上开源的高性能 KV 组件，提供跨平台、高并发、零延迟的本地存储解决方案。通过内存映射（mmap）与 Protobuf 序列化的深度优化，性能可达传统方案的 300 倍，完美适配高频数据读写、多进程协作等严苛场景。
en: As an important member of the Tencent Device-oriented Service (TDS) product alliance, MMKV is a high-performance key-value component developed by the WeChat team and open-sourced on GitHub. It provides a cross-platform, high-concurrency, zero-latency local storage solution. Through deep optimization of memory mapping (mmap) and Protobuf serialization, its performance can reach up to 300 times that of traditional solutions, making it well suited for demanding scenarios such as high-frequency data reads and writes and multi-process collaboration.

zh-Hans: GCanvas 是一个跨平台的画布解决方案，它实现了图形 2D 和 WebGL API。GCanvas 使其用户能够直接访问 OpenGL ES API。GCanvas 旨在解决 JavaScript 开发人员的画布的性能问题和兼容性问题。
en: GCanvas is a cross-platform canvas solution that implements graphics 2D and WebGL API. GCanvas enables its users to directly access the OpenGL ES API. GCanvas is designed to address performance and compatibility issues of canvas for JavaScript developers.

zh-Hans: 百度地图 Android SDK 是一套基于 Android 4.0 及以上版本设备的应用程序接口。 您可以使用该套 SDK 开发适用于 Android 系统移动设备的地图应用，通过调用地图 SDK 接口，您可以轻松访问百度地图服务和数据，构建功能丰富、交互性强的地图类应用程序。
en: Baidu Maps Android SDK is a set of application programming interfaces based on Android 4.0 and above devices. You can use this SDK to develop map applications suitable for Android mobile devices. By calling the map SDK interface, you can easily access Baidu map services and data, building feature-rich, interactive map applications.

zh-Hans: 在 Android 应用中运行原生代码。
en: Run native code in Android applications.

zh-Hans: PLDroidPlayer 是七牛推出的一款免费的适用于 Android 平台的播放器 SDK，采用全自研的跨平台播放内核，拥有丰富的功能和优异的性能，可高度定制化和二次开发。
en: PLDroidPlayer is a free player SDK for the Android platform launched by Qiniu, adopting a self-developed cross-platform playback kernel, with rich functions and excellent performance, highly customizable and suitable for secondary development.

zh-Hans: 由微信团队开发并已在 GitHub 上开源的业界领先终端数据库。它全面支持 C++、Java、Kotlin、Swift 和 Objc 五种开发语言，覆盖 Android、iOS、macOS、Windows、Linux 及鸿蒙 Next 六大终端平台，并提供数据备份、修复、迁移、压缩等多项业界领先的数据管理能力，助力多端应用高效、可靠地实现数据持久化。
en: An industry-leading client-side database developed by the WeChat team and open-sourced on GitHub. It fully supports five development languages: C++, Java, Kotlin, Swift, and ObjC. It covers six client platforms: Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and HarmonyOS Next, and provides industry-leading data management capabilities such as data backup, repair, migration, and compression, helping multi-platform applications implement data persistence efficiently and reliably.

zh-Hans: 360 加固保是基于 360 核心加密技术，给安卓应用进行深度加密、加壳保护的安全技术产品，可保护应用远离恶意破解、反编译、二次打包，内存抓取等威胁。
en: 360 Reinforcement is a security technology product based on 360 core encryption technology, providing deep encryption and shell protection for Android applications, protecting applications from malicious cracking, decompilation, repackaging, memory capture, and other threats.

zh-Hans: 腾讯实时音视频（Tencent Real-Time Communication，TRTC），将腾讯 21 年来在网络与音视频技术上的深度积累，以多人音视频通话和低延时互动直播两大场景化方案，通过腾讯云服务向开发者开放，致力于帮助开发者快速搭建低成本、低延时、高品质的音视频互动解决方案。
en: Tencent Cloud Real-time Audio and Video

Tencent Real-Time Communication (TRTC) brings Tencent's deep accumulation in network and audio-video technology over 21 years, offering developers open access to low-cost, low-latency, high-quality audio-video interactive solutions through Tencent Cloud services, with two major scenario solutions for multi-person audio-video calls and low-latency interactive live streaming.

zh-Hans: SQLCipher 是一个 SQLite 扩展，它提供数据库文件的 256 位 AES 加密能力。
en: SQLCipher is an SQLite extension that provides 256-bit AES encryption for database files.

zh-Hans: libYUV 是 Google 开源的 yuv 图像处理库，实现对各种 yuv 数据之间的转换，包括数据转换，裁剪，缩放，旋转。
en: libYUV is Google's open-source YUV image processing library, implementing conversion between various YUV data, including data conversion, cropping, scaling, and rotation.

zh-Hans: Ping++ 是一种全新的移动支付接入方式。通过使用 Ping++ 提供的 SDK，你的产品可以同时支持目前主流的多种支付渠道。同时 Ping++ 还提供交易管理平台，方便你统一管理所有支付渠道中的交易，有效降低你的前期开发和后期管理成本。
en: Ping++ is a new mobile payment integration method. By using the SDK provided by Ping++, your product can simultaneously support various mainstream payment channels. Ping++ also provides a transaction management platform, allowing you to manage transactions across all payment channels effectively, reducing your upfront development and subsequent management costs.

zh-Hans: 烈焰弹幕使是 Android 上开源的弹幕解析绘制引擎项目。
en: Flame Danmaku Master is an open-source engine project for parsing and rendering danmaku on Android.

zh-Hans: Android 系统中的帧序列封装库。
en: Frame sequence encapsulation library in the Android system.

zh-Hans: FreeType 是免费提供的用于渲染字体的软件库。 它用 C 语言编写，旨在小巧，高效，高度可定制和便携式，同时能够生成大多数矢量和位图字体格式的高质量输出（字形图像）。
en: FreeType is a free software library for rendering fonts. It is written in C and aims to be small, efficient, highly customizable, and portable while being able to generate high-quality output (glyph images) for most vector and bitmap font formats.

zh-Hans: TDLib 是用于构建 Telegram 客户端的跨平台库。几乎所有编程语言都可以轻松使用它。
en: TDLib is a cross-platform library for building Telegram clients. It can be easily used with almost any programming language.

zh-Hans: 一个在 Facebook 开发和使用的开源 C++ 库。
en: An open-source C++ library developed and used at Facebook.

zh-Hans: LAME 是一个高质量的 MPEG 音频层 III (MP3) 编码器，采用 LGPL 许可。
en: LAME is a high-quality MPEG Audio Layer III (MP3) encoder licensed under the LGPL.

zh-Hans: Crashlytics 是 Firebase 的主要崩溃报告工具。将众多崩溃整理成一个方便管理的问题列表，从而缩短问题排查时间。在 Crashlytics 信息中心内查看问题对用户造成的影响，从而清楚合理地确定应当首先解决哪些问题。
en: Crashlytics is Firebase's primary crash reporting tool. It organizes numerous crashes into a manageable list of issues, shortening troubleshooting time. Within the Crashlytics information center, view the impact of issues on users to clearly and reasonably determine which issues should be addressed first.

zh-Hans: 虚幻引擎是 Epic Games 开发的实时 3D 创作工具，用于游戏、影视和可视化。Unreal Engine 4 和 Unreal Engine 5 是不同的主要版本；UE5 引入了 Nanite 虚拟化几何体和 Lumen 动态全局光照。Android 库文件名（如 libUE4.so 或 libUnreal.so）本身不能验证应用使用的引擎版本，也不能证明应用启用了某项渲染功能。
en: Unreal Engine is Epic Games’ real-time 3D creation tool for games, film and visualization. Unreal Engine 4 and Unreal Engine 5 are distinct major versions; UE5 introduced Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen dynamic global illumination. An Android library filename (such as libUE4.so or libUnreal.so) alone does not verify the engine version used by an app or establish that a rendering feature is enabled.

zh-Hans: Go 是一种开源编程语言，可轻松构建简单，可靠和高效的软件。
en: Go is an open-source programming language that makes it easy to build simple, reliable, and efficient software.

zh-Hans: Epic 是一个在虚拟机层面、以 Java Method 为粒度的 运行时 AOP Hook 框架。简单来说，Epic 就是 ART 上的 Dexposed（支持 Android 4.0 ~ 10.0）。它可以拦截本进程内部几乎任意的 Java 方法调用，可用于实现 AOP 编程、运行时插桩、性能分析、安全审计等。
en: Epic is a runtime AOP Hook framework at the virtual machine level, with Java Method as the granularity. Simply put, Epic is Dexposed on ART (supports Android 4.0 ~ 10.0). It can intercept almost any Java method call within the process, and can be used to implement AOP programming, runtime instrumentation, performance analysis, security auditing, and more.

zh-Hans: 米大师（Midas）为腾讯官方唯一虚拟支付平台。原生支持 Q 币、微信支付、QQ 钱包、QQ 卡等支付渠道。
en: Midas is Tencent's official and only virtual payment platform. It natively supports payment channels such as Q coins, WeChat Pay, QQ Wallet, QQ Card, etc.

zh-Hans: 讯飞开放平台作为全球首个开放的智能交互技术服务平台，致力于为开发者打造一站式智能人机交互解决方案。
en: iFlytek Open Platform is the world's first open intelligent interactive technology service platform, dedicated to providing developers with one-stop intelligent human-computer interaction solutions.

zh-Hans: Hardcoder 是一套 Android APP 与系统间的通信解决方案，突破了 APP 只能调用系统标准 API，无法直接调用系统底层硬件资源的问题，让 Android APP 和系统能实时通信。APP 能充分调度系统资源如 CPU 频率，大小核，GPU 频率等来提升 APP 性能，系统能够从 APP 侧获取更多信息以便更合理提供各项系统资源。同时，对于 Android 缺乏标准接口实现的功能，APP 和系统也可以通过该框架实现机型适配和功能拓展。
en: Hardcoder is a communication solution between Android apps and the system, breaking through the problem that apps can only call system standard APIs and cannot directly call system underlying hardware resources, allowing Android apps and systems to communicate in real-time. Apps can fully schedule system resources such as CPU frequency, big and little cores, GPU frequency, etc., to improve app performance, and the system can obtain more information from the app side to provide various system resources more reasonably. Meanwhile, for functions lacking standard interface implementation in Android, apps and systems can also achieve model adaptation and function expansion through this framework.

zh-Hans: WebP 编解码器是一个用于编码和解码 WebP 格式图像的库。此包包含可在其他程序中使用以添加 WebP 支持的库，以及命令行工具 'cwebp' 和 'dwebp'，分别用于压缩和解压缩图像。
en: WebP codec is a library to encode and decode images in WebP format. This package contains the library that can be used in other programs to add WebP support, as well as the command line tools ‘cwebp’ and ‘dwebp’ to compress and decompress images respectively.

zh-Hans: 视频通话 SDK 可实现一对一单聊、多人群聊，同时具备纯语音通话和视频通话功能。
en: Video call SDK can achieve one-to-one single chat and multi-person group chat, with both pure voice call and video call functions.

zh-Hans: Hippy 是 TDF 腾讯端框架（Tencent Device-oriented Framework）下的开源跨平台应用开发解决方案。Hippy 从底层做了大量工作，抹平了 iOS、Android、OpenHarmony 三端差异，提供了接近 Web 的开发体验，目前上层支持了 React 和 Vue 两套界面框架，前端开发人员可以通过它，将前端代码转换为终端的原生指令，进行原生终端 APP 的开发。同时，Hippy 从底层进行了大量优化，在启动速度、渲染性能、动画速度、内存占用、包体积等方面都提供了业内顶尖的性能表现。
en: Hippy is a cross-platform development framework, that aims to help developers write once, and run on multiple platforms(iOS, Android, Web, and so on). Hippy is quite friendly to Web developers, especially those who are familiar with React or Vue.

zh-Hans: TDS 腾讯端服务跨平台框架
包含面向客户端开发、原生性能的 Kuikly 框架和面向前端开发的 Hippy 框架。支持移动端（含鸿蒙）、Web、小程序多平台跨端开发，提供极致的开发调试体验，助力业务提升研发生产力。Kuikly、Hippy作为腾讯端服务（Tencent Device-oriented Service，简称TDS）产品联盟的核心成员，将持续推动跨端开发的技术创新和生态建设。
en: TDS 腾讯端服务跨平台框架

Includes the Kuikly framework for client-side development with native performance and the Hippy framework for front-end development. It supports cross-platform development across mobile platforms (including HarmonyOS), Web, and mini programs, providing an excellent development and debugging experience to help businesses improve R&D productivity. As core members of the Tencent Device-oriented Service (TDS) product alliance, Kuikly and Hippy will continue to drive technical innovation and ecosystem development in cross-platform development.

zh-Hans: 高德地图 Android SDK 是一套地图开发调用接口，开发者可以轻松地在自己的 Android 应用中加入地图相关的功能，包括：地图显示（含室内、室外地图）、与地图交互、在地图上绘制、兴趣点搜索、地理编码、离线地图等功能。
en: Gaode Map Android SDK is a set of map development call interfaces, allowing developers to easily add map-related functions to their Android applications, including map display (indoor and outdoor maps), map interaction, drawing on the map, point of interest search, geocoding, offline maps, and more.

zh-Hans: Cronet 是 Chromium 网络堆栈，可作为库提供给 Android 应用。Cronet 利用多种技术来减少延迟并提高应用正常运行所需的网络请求吞吐量。
en: Cronet is the Chromium network stack provided as a library for Android applications. Cronet utilizes multiple technologies to reduce latency and improve the throughput of network requests necessary for the normal operation of applications.

zh-Hans: 百川云推送是基于大数据的阿里移动云服务，实现更快、更稳、更准的实时推送。旨在为百川移动应用提供从云端到移动终端的优质的信息推送服务。开发者只需通过简单的配置和编码工作，即能够快速搭建起服务于自身业务的、高效稳定的推送服务。
en: Baichuan Cloud Push is an Alibaba Mobile Cloud service based on big data, achieving faster, more stable, and more accurate real-time push. It aims to provide high-quality information push services from the cloud to mobile terminals for Baichuan mobile applications. Developers can quickly build efficient and stable push services for their own business through simple configuration and coding work.

zh-Hans: 云推送（Push）是百度开放云向开发者提供的消息推送服务；通过利用云端与客户端之间建立稳定、可靠的长连接来为开发者提供向客户端应用推送实时消息的一种开发者服务。
en: Cloud Push is a message push service provided by Baidu Open Cloud to developers; it provides developers with a way to push real-time messages to client apps by establishing a stable and reliable long connection between the cloud and the client.

zh-Hans: JPush 是经过考验的大规模 App 推送平台，每天推送消息数超过 5 亿条。 开发者集成 SDK 后，可以通过调用 API 推送消息。同时，JPush 提供可视化的 web 端控制台发送通知，统计分析推送效果。 JPush 全面支持 Android, iOS, Winphone 三大手机平台。
en: JPush is a proven large-scale app push platform, with over 500 million messages pushed daily. After integrating the SDK, developers can push messages by calling the API. JPush also provides a visual web console for sending notifications and analyzing push effects. JPush fully supports Android, iOS, and Winphone platforms.

zh-Hans: libtnet 是一个用 C++ 编写的高性能网络库，它在设计上面主要参考 Tornado，为服务端网络编程提供简洁而高效的接口，非常易于使用。
en: libtnet is a high-performance network library written in C++, mainly referencing Tornado in its design, providing a simple and efficient interface for server-side network programming, very easy to use.

zh-Hans: 百度地图 Android 定位 SDK 是为 Android 移动端应用提供的一套简单易用的定位服务接口，专注于为广大开发者提供最好的综合定位服务。通过使用百度定位 SDK，开发者可以轻松为应用程序实现智能、精准、高效的定位功能。
en: Baidu Maps Android Location SDK is a set of simple and easy-to-use location service interfaces for Android mobile applications, dedicated to providing the best comprehensive location services for a wide range of developers. By using the Baidu Location SDK, developers can easily implement intelligent, accurate, and efficient location functions for their applications.

zh-Hans: 移动应用安全 （Mobile Security，MS）提供了移动应用的一站式安全解决方案。用户只需上传签名过的安装包，就能享受安全检测、应用加固、渠道监控以及安全 SDK 等一系列安全服务。移动应用安全可帮助您防止应用被盗版破解，及时发现应用漏洞，监控应用正盗版分发等，有效捍卫移动应用所有者利益。
en: Mobile Application Security (Mobile Security, MS) provides a one-stop security solution for mobile applications. Users only need to upload signed installation packages to enjoy a series of security services such as security detection, application reinforcement, channel monitoring, and security SDK. Mobile Application Security can help you prevent applications from being pirated and cracked, timely discover application vulnerabilities, monitor application piracy distribution, etc., effectively defending the interests of mobile application owners.

zh-Hans: 小米推送（MiPush）是小米面向开发者的消息推送服务，使用云端与客户端之间的持久连接，将消息实时发送到应用。
en: MiPush is Xiaomi’s messaging service for developers. It delivers messages to apps in real time over a persistent connection between the cloud and the client.

zh-Hans: 华为推送服务（HUAWEI Push Kit）是华为为开发者提供的消息推送平台，建立了从云端到终端的消息推送通道。开发者通过集成 HUAWEI Push Kit 可以实时推送消息到用户终端应用，构筑良好的用户关系，提升用户的感知度和活跃度。
en: HUAWEI Push Kit is a message push platform provided by Huawei for developers, establishing a message push channel from the cloud to the terminal. Developers can push messages to user terminal apps in real-time by integrating HUAWEI Push Kit, building a good user relationship, and enhancing user perception and activity.

zh-Hans: Room 持久性库在 SQLite 的基础上提供了一个抽象层，让用户能够在充分利用 SQLite 的强大功能的同时，获享更强健的数据库访问机制。
en: Room persistence library provides an abstraction layer on top of SQLite, allowing users to leverage SQLite's powerful features while enjoying a more robust database access mechanism.

zh-Hans: 提供使用 Google 登录的 API。
en: Provide API for using Google Sign-In.

zh-Hans: 基于友盟+全域数据建立精准的消息推送平台，为开发者提供更灵活、更智能、更有效的消息推送方案，有效提升用户粘性，提高 App 活跃度。
en: Based on Umeng+ global data, establish a precise message push platform, providing developers with more flexible, intelligent, and effective message push solutions to effectively enhance user stickiness and increase app activity.

zh-Hans: 快应用是一种新的应用形态，以往的手机端应用主要有两种方式：网页、原生应用；网页无需安装，却体验不是很好；原生应用体验流畅，却需要从应用商店下载安装，难以一步直达用户；快应用的出现，就是希望能够让用户无需下载安装，并且还能流畅的体验应用内容。
en: Quick apps are a new form of application. Previously, mobile apps mainly had two forms: web and native apps; the web doesn't require installation but the experience isn't great; native apps have a smooth experience but need to be downloaded and installed from app stores, making it hard to reach users directly. The advent of quick apps aims to allow users to experience app content smoothly without downloading and installing.

zh-Hans: 使用 Google Cast SDK，您可以扩展 Android，iOS 或 Chrome 应用，以将其流式视频和音频定向到电视或声音系统。 您的应用程序成为播放，暂停，搜索，倒带，停止和控制媒体的遥控器。
en: Using the Google Cast SDK, you can extend Android, iOS, or Chrome apps to direct their streaming video and audio to a TV or sound system. Your app becomes a remote control for playing, pausing, searching, rewinding, stopping, and controlling media.

zh-Hans: Mtop 是稳定的高性能无线 RPC 网关，网关本身包含了一套安全体系，包括加密传输、防攻击、防刷、防篡改、过载保护等安全策略，同时针对无线网络的特点，在连通性、网络加速、流量方面进行了针对性优化。
en: Mtop is a stable and high-performance wireless RPC gateway. The gateway itself includes a set of security systems, including encrypted transmission, anti-attack, anti-sweeping, anti-tampering, overload protection, etc. At the same time, it has been optimized for connectivity, network acceleration, and traffic based on the characteristics of wireless networks.

zh-Hans: 移动推送 TPNS（Tencent Push Notification Service）为您提供稳定、快速高抵达的 APP 推送服务。其接入方便快捷，拥有行业前沿的技术实力，稳定可靠的消息推送通道，独有可自选的双 Service 联合保活服务，能有效提升消息抵达率；系统每分钟可容纳1800万推送消息，消息能秒级到达（支撑王者荣耀等腾讯内应用推送工具）；此外，其具备精准用户标签能力，有效助力 APP 的精细化运营。
en: Mobile Push TPNS (Tencent Push Notification Service) provides you with stable, fast, and high-reach app push services. Its integration is convenient and fast, with industry-leading technical strength, stable and reliable message push channels, and a unique optional dual-Service joint keep-alive service, effectively improving message reach rate; the system can accommodate 18 million push messages per minute, with messages reaching in seconds (supporting Tencent internal applications like Honor of Kings); additionally, it has precise user tag capabilities, effectively assisting in refined app operations.

zh-Hans: Matrix 是一款微信研发并日常使用的应用性能接入框架，支持 iOS, macOS 和Android。 Matrix 通过接入各种性能监控方案，对性能监控项的异常数据进行采集和分析，输出相应的问题分析、定位与优化建议，从而帮助开发者开发出更高质量的应用。
en: Matrix is an application performance access framework developed and used daily by WeChat, supporting iOS, macOS, and Android. By accessing various performance monitoring solutions, Matrix collects and analyzes abnormal data of performance monitoring items, outputting corresponding problem analysis, positioning, and optimization suggestions, thus helping developers develop higher quality applications.

zh-Hans: 阿里移动推送（Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push）是基于大数据的移动智能推送服务，帮助 App 快速集成移动推送的功能，在实现高效、精确、实时的移动推送的同时，极大地降低了开发成本。让开发者最有效地与用户保持连接，从而提高用户活跃度、提高应用的留存率。
en: Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push is a mobile intelligent push service based on big data, helping apps quickly integrate mobile push functionality, achieving efficient, precise, real-time mobile push while significantly reducing development costs. It allows developers to effectively maintain connections with users, thereby increasing user activity and app retention rates.

zh-Hans: Firebase 提供了分析、数据库、消息传递和崩溃报告等功能，可助您快速采取行动并专注于您的用户。
en: Firebase provides analytics, databases, messaging, and crash reporting, helping you take action quickly and focus on your users.

zh-Hans: 为开发者提供移动应用全生命周期服务，覆盖全终端全场景，降低开发成本，提升运营效率，助力商业成功。
en: Provide developers with mobile application lifecycle services, covering all terminals and scenarios, reducing development costs, improving operational efficiency, and assisting in commercial success.

zh-Hans: BoostMultiDex是一个用于Android低版本设备（4.X及以下，SDK < 21）快速加载多DEX的解决方案。
en: BoostMultiDex is a solution for quickly loading multiple DEX files on low-version Android devices (4.X and below, SDK < 21).

zh-Hans: Android 实用程序库，用于在后台延迟运行作业。 根据 Android 版本的不同，将使用 JobScheduler，GcmNetworkManager 或 AlarmManager。
en: Android utility library for running jobs in the background with delay. Depending on the Android version, JobScheduler, GcmNetworkManager, or AlarmManager will be used.

zh-Hans: 腾讯浏览服务，依托 X5 内核强大的能力，致力于提供优化移动端浏览体验的整套解决方案。
en: Tencent Browser Service, relying on the powerful capabilities of the X5 kernel, is dedicated to providing a complete solution for optimizing mobile browsing experiences.

zh-Hans: OPPO PUSH 是 ColorOS 上的系统级通道，为开发者提供稳定，高效的消息推送服务。
en: OPPO PUSH is a system-level channel on ColorOS, providing developers with stable and efficient message push services.

zh-Hans: 腾讯广告汇聚腾讯公司全量的应用场景，拥有核心行业数据、营销技术与专业服务能力。
en: Tencent Advertising aggregates all application scenarios of Tencent, possessing core industry data, marketing technology, and professional service capabilities.

zh-Hans: 快手信息流广告，为您和用户搭建桥梁。
en: Kuaishou information flow ads build a bridge between you and users.

zh-Hans: 一个强大且轻量的 Android 插件化框架。
en: A powerful and lightweight Android plugin framework.

zh-Hans: Android 文件下载引擎，稳定、高效、灵活、简单易用。
en: Android file download engine, stable, efficient, flexible, and easy to use.

zh-Hans: Firebase 云信息传递 (FCM) 是一种跨平台消息传递解决方案，可供您免费、可靠地传递消息。
en: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) is a cross-platform messaging solution that allows you to reliably deliver messages for free.

zh-Hans: 魅族推送服务是由魅族公司为开发者提供的消息推送服务，开发者可以向集成了魅族 push SDK 的客户端实时地推送通知或者消息，与用户保持互动，提高活跃率。
en: Meizu Push Service is a message push service provided by Meizu for developers, allowing developers to push notifications or messages to clients integrated with the Meizu push SDK in real-time, keeping interaction with users and increasing activity rate.

zh-Hans: IM SDK 是网易云通信其他能力（实时语音视频、互动白板等）的基础，本节讲述 IM SDK 的集成步骤也将其他能力 SDK 的集成步骤融合起来，开发者可以根据实际业务需要选择接入的类库。
en: IM SDK is the foundation for NetEase Cloud Communication's other capabilities (real-time voice and video, interactive whiteboard, etc.). This section describes the integration steps of the IM SDK, which also incorporate the integration steps of other capability SDKs, allowing developers to choose the libraries to access based on actual business needs.

zh-Hans: WorkManager 是适合用于持久性工作的推荐解决方案。如果工作始终要通过应用重启和系统重新启动来调度，便是持久性的工作。由于大多数后台处理操作都是通过持久性工作完成的，因此 WorkManager 是适用于后台处理操作的主要推荐 API。
en: WorkManager is the recommended solution for persistent work. Work is persistent when it remains scheduled through app restarts and system reboots. Because most background processing is best accomplished through persistent work, WorkManager is the primary recommended API for background processing.

zh-Hans: Google Analytics（分析）是一款免费的应用衡量解决方案，可提供关于应用使用情况和用户互动度的分析数据。
en: Google Analytics is a free app measurement solution that provides analytics data on app usage and user engagement.

zh-Hans: Tinker 是适用于 Android 的热更新程序库，它支持无需重新安装 apk 来更新 dex，库和资源。
en: Tinker is a hot update library for Android, supporting updating dex, libraries, and resources without reinstalling the apk.

zh-Hans: 支付宝开放平台基于支付宝海量用户，将强大的支付、营销、数据能力，通过接口等形式开放给第三方合作伙伴，帮助第三方合作伙伴创建更具竞争力的应用。
en: The Alipay Open Platform, based on Alipay's vast user base, opens powerful payment, marketing, and data capabilities to third-party partners through interfaces, helping them create more competitive applications.

zh-Hans: PCDN 支持点播和直播的 P2P 加速服务，采用独立进程的方式运行，即使崩溃也不影响 App 主进程的使用。
en: PCDN supports P2P acceleration services for on-demand and live streaming, running as an independent process so that even if it crashes, it does not affect the main process of the app.

zh-Hans: 提供各种 API，可帮助您收集、配置和报告用户与您的在线内容进行互动的数据。
en: Provide various APIs to help you collect, configure, and report data on user interactions with your online content.

zh-Hans: AndroidUtilCode 是一个强大易用的安卓工具类库，它合理地封装了安卓开发中常用的函数，具有完善的 Demo 和单元测试，利用其封装好的 APIs 可以大大提高开发效率。
en: AndroidUtilCode is a powerful and easy-to-use Android utility class library. It reasonably encapsulates commonly used functions in Android development, has comprehensive demos and unit tests, and its encapsulated APIs can greatly improve development efficiency.

zh-Hans: vivo 推送（即 vpush）是 vivo 公司向开发者提供的消息推送服务，通过在云端与客户端之间建立一条稳定、可靠的长连接，为开发者提供向客户端应用实时推送消息的服务，支持百亿级的通知/消息推送，秒级触达移动用户。
en: vivo Push (i.e., vPush) is a message push service provided by vivo for developers. By establishing a stable and reliable long connection between the cloud and client devices, it enables developers to deliver real-time messages to client applications, supporting 10-billion-level notification and message pushes with second-level delivery to mobile users.

zh-Hans: Android 平台上的权限管理器。
en: Permission manager on the Android platform.

zh-Hans: 为保证用户输入支付密码时的输入安全，招行自主开发了安全输入键盘，以 SDK 形式供商户集成到 APP 中，配合招行一网通支付使用，保护用户的密码安全。分为 Android 版和 iOS 版。
en: To ensure input security when users enter payment passwords, China Merchants Bank independently developed a secure input keyboard, provided in SDK form for merchants to integrate into apps, used in conjunction with China Merchants Bank's OneNetPay to protect users' password security. Available in Android and iOS versions.

zh-Hans: RePlugin 是一套完整的、稳定的、适合全面使用的，占坑类插件化方案，由 360 手机卫士的 RePlugin Team 研发，也是业内首个提出“全面插件化”（全面特性、全面兼容、全面使用）的方案。
en: RePlugin is a complete, stable, and fully usable placeholder plugin solution developed by the RePlugin Team of 360 Mobile Security, and it is the first in the industry to propose a 'comprehensive pluginization' solution (comprehensive features, comprehensive compatibility, comprehensive usage).

zh-Hans: 腾讯核心内部服务，二十年技术沉淀，助你成就更高梦想。
en: Tencent core internal services, twenty years of technical accumulation, help you achieve higher dreams.

zh-Hans: 用于 HMS SDK 引导升级 Huawei Mobile Services(APK)，提供给系统安装器读取升级文件。
en: Used for guiding the upgrade of Huawei Mobile Services (APK) in the HMS SDK, providing files for the system installer to read.

zh-Hans: vivo 推送是 Funtouch OS 上系统级消息推送平台，帮助开发者在 vivo 平台有效提升活跃和留存。通过和系统的深度结合，建立稳定可靠、安全可控、高性能的消息推送服务，帮助不同行业的开发者挖掘更多的运营价值。
en: Vivo Push is a system-level message push platform on Funtouch OS, helping developers effectively enhance activity and retention on the Vivo platform. Through deep integration with the system, it establishes a stable, reliable, secure, controllable, and high-performance message push service, helping developers in various industries explore more operational value.

zh-Hans: 百川电商 SDK - 授权
用户可将某些功能/能力同意给媒体使用，媒体可通过获取用户的授权，访问页面/API 等数据。
en: Users can consent to certain features/capabilities for media use, allowing media to access page/API data through user authorization.

zh-Hans: HMS Core 是华为终端云服务提供的端、云开放能力的合集，助您高效构建精品应用。
en: HMS Core is a collection of terminal and cloud open capabilities provided by Huawei Terminal Cloud Services, helping you efficiently build quality applications.

zh-Hans: 号码认证能力提供一键登录、本机号码校验服务。
en: Number authentication capability provides one-click login and local number verification services.

zh-Hans: Google AdMob 是一个助您通过应用实现创收的移动广告平台。
en: Google AdMob is a mobile advertising platform that helps you monetize your app.

zh-Hans: EasyPermissions 是一个包装器库，用于简化针对 Android M 或更高版本的基本系统权限逻辑。
en: EasyPermissions is a wrapper library to simplify the basic system permissions logic for Android M and above.

zh-Hans: 华为动态标签管理器 Dynamic Tag Manager（DTM）是一个动态标签代码管理系统（Tag Manager System），您可以通过 Web 页面动态更新跟踪代码，轻松完成特定事件跟踪并将数据传送给第三方分析平台，实现营销数据随需监控。
en: Huawei Dynamic Tag Manager (DTM) is a dynamic tag code management system (Tag Manager System), allowing you to dynamically update tracking codes through a web page, easily complete specific event tracking, and transmit data to third-party analytics platforms, achieving on-demand monitoring of marketing data.

zh-Hans: 一个基于 AOSP 的代码提供简单图像裁剪 Activity 的 Android 库。
en: An Android library providing a simple image cropping Activity based on AOSP code.

zh-Hans: AppAuth for Android 是用于与 OAuth 2.0 和 OpenID Connect 提供程序进行通信的客户端 SDK。 它致力于直接映射那些规范的请求和响应，同时遵循实现语言的惯用风格。 除了映射原始协议流外，还有协助执行常见任务的便捷方法，例如执行刷新令牌操作。
en: AppAuth for Android is a client SDK for communicating with OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect providers. It strives to directly map those specifications to requests and responses, while following the idiomatic style of the implementation language. In addition to mapping the raw protocol flows, convenience methods are available to assist with performing common tasks such as performing a token refresh.

zh-Hans: 小米账号授权登录服务是小米公司向开发者提供的，基于 OAuth 2.0 标准协议的小米账号快捷登录服务，用户可以方便快捷的使用小米账号登录您的网站或者移动应用。
en: Xiaomi Account Authorization Login Service is a quick login service based on the OAuth 2.0 standard protocol provided by Xiaomi for developers. Users can easily and quickly log in to your website or mobile application using their Xiaomi account.

zh-Hans: 借助 Google Play 服务，你的应用可以使用 Google 提供的最新功能，例如地图和 Google+，并通过 Google Play 商店以 APK 形式分发自动平台更新。这可以让用户更快地获得更新，也能更轻松地集成 Google 提供的最新信息。
en: With Google Play services, your app can take advantage of the latest features provided by Google, such as maps and Google+, and distribute automatic platform updates via the Google Play store in APK form. This allows your users to receive updates more quickly and integrates the latest information Google has to offer more easily.

zh-Hans: 翼支付是天翼电子商务有限公司旗下品牌，覆盖餐饮娱乐、交通出行、电商购物、民生缴费、通信交费等多个生活消费场景的便民服务。
en: Yi Payment is a brand under Tianyi E-Commerce Co., Ltd., covering various life consumption scenarios such as catering and entertainment, transportation, e-commerce shopping, utility bill payment, and communication fee payment.

zh-Hans: 百度移动推广 SDK(Android)是百度官方推出的移动推广 SDK 在 Android 平台上的版本
en: Baidu Mobile Promotion SDK (Android) is the Android platform version of the mobile promotion SDK officially launched by Baidu.

zh-Hans: 一个设计精美的 Android 图片视频选择器。
en: A beautifully designed Android image and video selector.

zh-Hans: Bugly 是 TDS 腾讯端服务（Tencent Device-oriented Service）旗下的端质量监控平台，通过采集、监控、定位、告警等核心能力，提供专业的质量监控服务，帮助开发者及时发现并解决质量问题，打造高质量应用。
en: Bugly is an end quality monitoring platform under Tencent Device-oriented Service (TDS), which provides professional quality monitoring services through the core competencies of collection, monitoring, location, and alerts to help developers find and solve quality problems in time and build high-quality applications.

zh-Hans: 帮助应用或游戏快速具备国内外多平台分享、第三方登录功能，SDK 包小，集成成本低，平台覆盖全。
en: Helps applications or games quickly have multi-platform sharing and third-party login functions domestically and internationally. The SDK package is small, integration costs are low, and platform coverage is complete.

zh-Hans: 在应用外显示模板化界面元素。
en: Display templated interface elements outside the application.

zh-Hans: Google Play 结算系统是一项可让您在 Android 应用中销售数字商品和内容的服务。无论您是要通过一次性购买交易创收，还是要为用户提供订阅服务，它都能帮您搞定。Google Play 提供了一整套 API，可集成到您的 Android 应用和服务器后端，从而为您的用户提供熟悉又安全的 Google Play 购买交易服务。
en: Google Play's billing system is a service that enables you to sell digital products and content in your Android app, whether you want to monetize through one-time purchases or offer subscriptions to your services. Google Play offers a full set of APIs for integration with both your Android app and your server backend that unlock the familiarity and safety of Google Play purchases for your users.

zh-Hans: 专注业务安全服务，用领先的人工智能技术解决业务欺诈、薅羊毛、刷单、爬虫、撞库等问题，让您的企业零投入也能有微信/QQ 级别的业务安全服务。
en: Focusing on business security services, using leading artificial intelligence technology to solve business fraud, coupon abuse, fake orders, web scraping, credential stuffing, and other issues, allowing your enterprise to have zero investment with WeChat/QQ-level business security services.

zh-Hans: Unity 是一款由 Unity Technologies 所研发的跨平台2D / 3D 游戏引擎，可用于开发 Windows、MacOS 及 Linux 平台的单机游戏，PlayStation、XBox、Wii、3DS 和 任天堂Switch 等游戏主机平台的视频游戏，以及 iOS、Android 等移动设备的游戏。
en: Unity is a cross-platform 2D/3D game engine developed by Unity Technologies, used for developing standalone games for Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, video games for game consoles such as PlayStation, Xbox, Wii, 3DS, and Nintendo Switch, as well as games for mobile devices such as iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: Visual Studio App Center 将多个通用服务整合到 DevOps 云解决方案中。开发人员使用 App Center 来构建，测试和分发应用程序。部署应用程序后，开发人员可以使用 Analytics 和 Diagnostics 服务监视应用程序的状态和使用情况。
en: Visual Studio App Center integrates multiple common services into a DevOps cloud solution. Developers use App Center to build, test, and distribute applications. After deployment, developers can use Analytics and Diagnostics services to monitor application status and usage.

zh-Hans: 小米广告 SDK 提供各种广告形式给客户端集成，应用既可以在 MIUI 系统上运行，也可以在非 MIUI 系统上运行。
en: Xiaomi Advertising SDK provides various ad forms for client integration, applications can run on both MIUI and non-MIUI systems.

zh-Hans: 与其他应用共享媒体内容和控件。已被 media2 取代。
en: Share media content and controls with other apps. Replaced by media2.

zh-Hans: 创建一个包装，使开发人员更容易地提供 PendingIntent。
en: Create a wrapper to make it easier for developers to provide PendingIntent.

zh-Hans: 神策分析，是针对企业级客户推出的深度用户行为分析产品，支持私有化部署，客户端、服务器、业务数据、第三方数据的全端采集和建模，驱动营销渠道效果评估、用户精细化运营改进、产品功能及用户体验优化、老板看板辅助管理决策、产品个性化推荐改造、用户标签体系构建等应用场景。作为 PaaS 平台支持二次开发，可通过 BI、大数据平台、CRM、ERP 等内部 IT 系统，构建用户数据体系，让用户行为数据发挥深远的价值。
en: Sensor Analytics is an in-depth user behavior analysis product launched for enterprise customers, supporting private deployment, full-end collection, and modeling of client, server, business data, and third-party data. It drives marketing channel effect evaluation, user refined operation improvement, product function and user experience optimization, boss dashboard auxiliary management decision-making, product personalized recommendation transformation, user tag system construction, and other application scenarios. As a PaaS platform, it supports secondary development and can construct a user data system through internal IT systems like BI, big data platforms, CRM, ERP, allowing user behavior data to play a far-reaching value.

zh-Hans: 可靠，灵活，高性能以及强大的下载引擎。
en: Reliable, flexible, high-performance, and powerful download engine.

zh-Hans: 一个强大的 Android 图片下载缓存库。
en: A powerful Android image download and cache library.

zh-Hans: FileProvider 是 ContentProvider 的特殊子类，它通过创建 content://Uri 代替 file:///Uri 以促进安全分享与应用程序关联的文件。
en: FileProvider is a special subclass of ContentProvider that facilitates secure sharing of files associated with an application by creating content://Uri instead of file:///Uri.

zh-Hans: App Startup 库提供了一种直接，高效的方法来在应用程序启动时初始化组件。库开发人员和应用程序开发人员都可以使用 App Startup 来简化启动顺序并显式设置初始化顺序。App Startup 允许您定义共享单个内容提供程序的组件初始化程序，而不必为需要初始化的每个组件定义单独的内容提供程序。这可以大大缩短应用启动时间。
en: The App Startup library provides a straightforward and efficient way to initialize components at application startup. Both library developers and application developers can use App Startup to simplify startup sequences and explicitly set initialization order. App Startup allows you to define component initializers that share a single content provider, rather than defining a separate content provider for each component that needs initialization. This can significantly shorten app startup time.

zh-Hans: 今日头条屏幕适配方案终极版，一个极低成本的 Android 屏幕适配方案。
en: The ultimate version of the Toutiao screen adaptation scheme, an extremely low-cost Android screen adaptation scheme.

zh-Hans: 生命周期感知型组件可执行操作来响应另一个组件（如 Activity 和 Fragment）的生命周期状态的变化。这些组件有助于您写出更有条理且往往更精简的代码，这样的代码更易于维护。
en: Lifecycle-aware components can perform actions in response to changes in the lifecycle state of another component (such as Activity and Fragment). These components help you write more organized and often more concise code, making it easier to maintain.

zh-Hans: 通过 Facebook 广告使您通过移动媒体资源获利
en: Monetize your mobile media resources through Facebook ads.

ShareSDK can easily support third-party login, sharing, and friend list operations on more than 40 social platforms worldwide.
