en: Shizuku allows ordinary apps to use system APIs directly with adb or root privileges via a Java process started by app_process.

zh-Hans: 网易七鱼提供了丰富的 SDK 和服务端 API，方便企业快速使用七鱼，同时也可以根据自己的业务场景，进行一定程度的个性化开发。
en: NetEase Qiyu provides rich SDKs and server-side APIs, allowing enterprises to quickly use Qiyu while also enabling a certain degree of personalized development according to their business scenarios.

zh-Hans: AgentWeb 是一个基于的 Android WebView ，极度容易使用以及功能强大的库，提供了 Android WebView 一系列的问题解决方案 ，并且轻量和极度灵活。
en: AgentWeb is an Android WebView-based, extremely easy-to-use and powerful library, providing a series of solutions for Android WebView issues, and is lightweight and extremely flexible.

zh-Hans: 华为推送服务开放能力合集提供的匿名设备标识(AAID) 实体类与令牌实体类包。异步方式获取的 AAID 与令牌通过此包中对应的类承载返回。
en: Huawei Push Service Open Capability Collection provides anonymous device identifiers (AAID) entity class and token entity class package. The AAID and token obtained asynchronously are carried back through the corresponding classes in this package.

zh-Hans: HUAWEI Ads 流量变现服务（HUAWEI Ads Publisher Service）是依托华为终端强大的平台与数据能力为开发者提供的 App 流量变现服务，开发者通过该服务可以在自己的 App 中获取并向用户展示精准的、精美的、高价值的广告内容，并从中获得广告收益。
en: HUAWEI Ads Publisher Service is an app traffic monetization service provided by Huawei, relying on Huawei's powerful platform and data capabilities. Developers can obtain and display precise, exquisite, and high-value ad content in their apps through this service, earning ad revenue.

zh-Hans: Firebase 性能监控服务可帮助您深入了解您的 iOS 应用、Android 应用和网页应用的性能特点。
en: Firebase Performance Monitoring Service helps you gain insights into the performance characteristics of your iOS, Android, and web applications.

zh-Hans: MediaInfo(Lib) 是便捷统一展示视频和音频文件最相关的技术和标签数据的库。
en: MediaInfo(Lib) is a library for conveniently and uniformly displaying the most relevant technical and tag data of video and audio files.

zh-Hans: SDL 是一个跨平台的开发库，旨在通过 OpenGL 和 Direct3D 提供对音频、键盘、鼠标、操纵杆和图形硬件的低级访问。它被视频回放软件、模拟器和流行游戏使用，包括 Valve 的获奖目录和许多 Humble Bundle 游戏。
en: SDL is a cross-platform development library designed to provide low-level access to audio, keyboard, mouse, joystick, and graphics hardware via OpenGL and Direct3D. It is used by video playback software, emulators, and popular games including Valve's award-winning catalog and many Humble Bundle games.

zh-Hans: 使用此 API，您可以构建自己的自定义 Telegram 客户端。它对所有希望在我们的平台上创建 Telegram 应用程序的开发人员都是 100％ 开放的。
en: Using this API, you can build your own custom Telegram client. It is 100% open to all developers who wish to create Telegram applications on our platform.

zh-Hans: U-App 作为一款专业、免费的移动统计分析产品。在日常业务中帮您解决多种数据相关问题，如数据采集与管理、业务监测、用户行为分析、App 稳定性监控及实现多种运营方案等。助力互联网企业充分挖掘用户行为数据价值，找到产品更新迭代方向，实现精细化运营，全面提升业务增长效能。
en: U-App is a professional, free mobile analytics product. It helps you solve various data-related problems in daily business, such as data collection and management, business monitoring, user behavior analysis, app stability monitoring, and implementing various operational plans. It assists internet companies in fully exploiting the value of user behavior data, finding directions for product updates and iterations, achieving refined operations, and comprehensively enhancing business growth efficiency.

zh-Hans: VirtualApp(VA) 是一款运行于 Android 系统的沙盒产品，可以理解为轻量级的“Android 虚拟机”。其产品形态为高可扩展，可定制的集成 SDK，您可以基于 VA 或者使用 VA 定制开发各种看似不可能完成的项目。VA 目前被广泛应用于插件化开发、无感知热更新、云控自动化、多开、手游租号、手游手柄免激活、区块链、移动办公安全、军队政府保密、手机模拟信息、脚本自动化、自动化测试等技术领域。
en: VirtualApp (VA) is a sandbox product running on the Android system, which can be understood as a lightweight 'Android virtual machine.' Its product form is a highly extensible, customizable integrated SDK, allowing you to develop various seemingly impossible projects based on VA or using VA customization. VA is currently widely used in fields such as plugin development, non-perceptive hot updates, cloud control automation, multi-open, game account leasing, game controller activation-free, blockchain, mobile office security, military and government confidentiality, mobile simulation information, script automation, and automated testing.

zh-Hans: AVPro Video 是一个用于高级视频播放的多平台 Unity 插件
en: AVPro Video is a multi-platform Unity plugin for advanced video playback.

zh-Hans: libaria2 是一个 C 库，并提供 aria2 的核心功能。该库负责所有网络和下载内容，因此，其用法现在非常简单。
en: libaria2 is a C library that provides the core functionality of aria2. The library handles all network and download content, making its usage very simple now.

zh-Hans: libGDX 是基于 OpenGL(ES) 的跨平台 Java 游戏开发框架，可在 Windows，Linux，Mac OS X，Android，iOS 和支持 WebGL 的浏览器上运行。它为快速原型设计和快速迭代提供了一个经过充分验证的健壮环境。LibGDX 不会在您身上强加特定的设计或编码风格，而是使您可以自由选择自己喜欢的方式来创建游戏。
en: libGDX is a cross-platform Java game development framework based on OpenGL(ES), capable of running on Windows, Linux, Mac OS X, Android, iOS, and WebGL-enabled browsers. It provides a well-proven robust environment for rapid prototyping and fast iteration. LibGDX does not impose any specific design or coding style on you, allowing you the freedom to create games in your preferred way.

zh-Hans: FrostWire 的制造商为 libtorrent 提供的 Swig Java 接口。享受用 Java 编写代码来开发基于 libtorrent 的应用程序。
en: FrostWire's manufacturer provides the Swig Java interface for libtorrent. Enjoy writing code in Java to develop applications based on libtorrent.

zh-Hans: libtorrent 的 Swig Java 接口。
设备风险保护，基于先进的人工智能技术，通过高稳定高兼容设备指纹反欺诈 SDK，全路径布控和全栈式实时防御营销活动作弊、撞库盗号、渠道推广作弊、支付交易风险、内容盗爬、刷榜刷单、用户裂变等欺诈行为，护航客户营销 ROI 增长。
en: Device risk protection, based on advanced artificial intelligence technology, through a high-stability high-compatibility device fingerprint anti-fraud SDK, full-path control, and full-stack real-time defense against marketing activity fraud, credential stuffing, channel promotion fraud, payment transaction risk, content scraping, ranking manipulation, user fission, and other fraudulent behaviors, safeguarding customer marketing ROI growth.

zh-Hans: Play Asset Delivery (PAD) 将应用包的优势带入游戏。它允许大于 200MB 的游戏通过发布一个包含游戏所需所有资源的单一工件来替代传统的扩展文件 (OBBs)。PAD 提供灵活的交付模式、自动更新、压缩和增量修补，并且免费使用。
en: Play Asset Delivery (PAD) brings the benefits of app bundles to games. It allows games larger than 200MB to replace legacy expansion files (OBBs) by publishing a single artifact to Play containing all the resources the game needs. PAD offers flexible delivery modes, auto-updates, compression, and delta patching, and is free to use.

zh-Hans: 智齿客服 SDK 是客服系统访客端的解决方案，既包含了客服聊天逻辑管理，也提供了聊天界面，开发者可方便的将客服功能集成到自己的 App 中。
en: Zhichi Customer Service SDK is a solution for the visitor side of the customer service system, including customer service chat logic management and providing a chat interface, allowing developers to easily integrate customer service functionality into their apps.

zh-Hans: 乐播投屏 SDK，已全面支持 iOS 和 Android 系统。接入后，能让您的 App 轻松拥有投屏与镜像能力，从而在满足用户需求的同时，也将您的内容分发上大屏。可广泛应用于通话，视频，音乐，直播，游戏，教育，办公等场景。
en: LeBo Screen Mirroring SDK fully supports iOS and Android systems. After integration, your app can easily have screen mirroring and projection capabilities, meeting user needs while distributing your content on large screens. It can be widely used in scenarios like calls, videos, music, live broadcasts, games, education, and office work.

zh-Hans: FFmpeg 是领先的多媒体框架，能够解码，编码，转码，MUX，DEMUX，流式，过滤和播放人类和机器创建的几乎所有内容。
en: FFmpeg is a leading multimedia framework capable of decoding, encoding, transcoding, muxing, demuxing, streaming, filtering, and playing almost anything that humans and machines have created.

zh-Hans: GlideWebpDecoder 是一个 Glide 集成库，用于在 Android 平台上解码和显示 webp 图像。它基于 libwebp 项目，并以 Fresco 和 GlideWebpSupport 的一些实现作为参考。
en: GlideWebpDecoder is a Glide integration library for decoding and displaying webp images on the Android platform. It is based on the libwebp project and refers to some implementations of Fresco and GlideWebpSupport.

zh-Hans: LeakCanary 是适用于 Android 的内存泄漏检测库。
en: LeakCanary is a memory leak detection library for Android.

zh-Hans: Scanner Compat 库解决了在 Android 上扫描 BLE 设备的问题。
en: The Scanner Compat library addresses the issue of scanning BLE devices on Android.

zh-Hans: xLua 为 Unity、.Net、Mono 等 C# 环境增加 Lua 脚本编程的能力，借助 xLua，这些 Lua 代码可以方便的和 C# 相互调用。
en: xLua adds Lua scripting capabilities to C# environments such as Unity, .Net, and Mono. With xLua, these Lua codes can easily call each other with C#.

zh-Hans: 腾讯客户端性能分析（QAPM）是一款全方位定位检测 APP 应用性能的 SDK，其简单易用、并能提供多维度检测及分析，您只需简单的调用几个接口，就能对您的 APP 做全方位的性能检测。
en: Tencent Client Performance Analysis (QAPM) is an SDK for comprehensive detection of app performance, which is simple to use and provides multi-dimensional detection and analysis. You only need to call a few interfaces to perform comprehensive performance detection on your app.

zh-Hans: 一款针对 Android 平台下的图片选择器，支持从相册获取图片、视频、音频 & 拍照，支持裁剪(单图 or 多图裁剪)、压缩、主题自定义配置等功能，支持动态获取权限&适配 Android 5.0+ 系统的开源图片选择框架。
en: An image picker for the Android platform, supporting image, video, and audio retrieval from the album & taking photos, supporting cropping (single or multiple image cropping), compression, theme customization configuration, and more, supporting dynamic permission acquisition & adapting to the Android 5.0+ system open-source image selection framework.

zh-Hans: 新一代 Flutter-Native 混合解决方案。FlutterBoost 是一个 Flutter 插件，它可以轻松地为现有原生应用程序提供 Flutter 混合集成方案。FlutterBoost 的理念是将 Flutter 像 Webview 那样来使用。在现有应用程序中同时管理 Native 页面和 Flutter 页面并非易事。FlutterBoost 帮你处理页面的映射和跳转，你只需关心页面的名字和参数即可（通常可以是 URL）。
en: A next-generation Flutter-Native hybrid solution. FlutterBoost is a Flutter plugin that facilitates the integration of Flutter into existing native applications. The philosophy of FlutterBoost is to use Flutter in a manner similar to Webview. Managing both Native and Flutter pages in an existing application is not an easy task. FlutterBoost assists in handling page mapping and transitions, allowing you to focus only on the page names and parameters, which are typically URLs.

zh-Hans: CRIWARE 中用于视频回放解码的组件。
en: CRIWARE component for video playback decoding.

zh-Hans: Unity 中的可用于商业游戏开发的声音系统插件。可以从支持网站上下载专用工具来编辑声音，同时网站上还提供技术支持。
en: A sound system plugin for commercial game development in Unity. Dedicated tools for editing sound can be downloaded from the support website, and technical support is also available on the website.

zh-Hans: iconv 是一个计算机程序以及一套应用程序编程接口的名称。它的作用是在多种国际编码格式之间进行文本内码的转换。
en: iconv is the name of a computer program and a set of application programming interfaces. Its function is to convert text internal codes between multiple international encoding formats.

zh-Hans: Unity 游戏使用 Il2Cpp 后端时产生的游戏代码。
en: Unity is a cross-platform 2D/3D game engine developed by Unity Technologies, used for developing standalone games for Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, video games for game consoles such as PlayStation, Xbox, Wii, 3DS, and Nintendo Switch, as well as games for mobile devices such as iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: SQLite 是遵守 ACID 的关系数据库管理系统，它包含在一个相对小的 C 程序库中。与许多其它数据库管理系统不同， SQLite 不是一个客户端/服务器结构的数据库引擎，而是被集成在用户程序中。 SQLite 遵守 ACID ，实现了大多数 SQL 标准。它使用动态的、弱类型的 SQL 语法。
en: SQLite is an ACID-compliant relational database management system contained in a relatively small C library. Unlike many other database management systems, SQLite is not a client-server structure database engine but is embedded in the user program. SQLite complies with ACID and implements most of the SQL standard. It uses dynamic, weakly typed SQL syntax.

zh-Hans: 中国无线营销联盟通用 SDK
MMA(中国无线营销联盟)通用 SDK。以往，要监测 APP 中广告的曝光、点击等数据，需要加入第三方广告监测公司的 SDK，如果不同广告主使用了不同的第三方广告监测，需要加多个公司的监测 SDK，无疑增加了成本和风险。现在，只需添加一次 MMA(中国无线营销联盟)通用 SDK，即可满足所有 MMA 成员中所有第三方监测公司的监测需求，同时 SDK 内部的调用方法保持一致，也降低了开发成本。
en: China Wireless Marketing Alliance General SDK

MMA (China Wireless Marketing Alliance) Universal SDK. Previously, to monitor ad exposure and clicks in an app, you needed to integrate SDKs from third-party ad monitoring companies. If different advertisers used different third-party ad monitoring, multiple monitoring SDKs needed to be added, undoubtedly increasing costs and risks. Now, by adding the MMA Universal SDK once, you can meet the monitoring needs of all third-party monitoring companies among all MMA members, while maintaining consistent internal SDK call methods, reducing development costs.

zh-Hans: cocos2d-cpp 是用 C++ 14 编写的 2D 便携式游戏引擎，适用于 Android，iOS，Linux，MacOS 和 Windows。
en: cocos2d-cpp is a 2D portable game engine written in C++ 14, suitable for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows.

zh-Hans: VLC 是一款免费、自由、开源的跨平台多媒体播放器及框架，可播放大多数多媒体文件，以及各类流媒体协议。
en: VLC is a free, open-source, cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files, as well as various streaming protocols.

zh-Hans: 借助 WebRTC，您可以在基于开放标准的应用程序中添加实时通信功能。它支持在同级之间发送视频，语音和通用数据，从而使开发人员能够构建功能强大的语音和视频通信解决方案。该技术可在所有现代浏览器以及所有主要平台的本机客户端上使用。 WebRTC 背后的技术被实现为一个开放的 Web 标准，并在所有主要浏览器中均以常规 JavaScript API 的形式提供。
en: With WebRTC, you can add real-time communication capabilities to your application that works on top of an open standard. It supports sending video, voice, and generic data between peers, enabling developers to build powerful voice- and video-communication solutions. The technology is available on all modern browsers as well as on native clients for all major platforms. The technology behind WebRTC is implemented as an open web standard and is available as regular JavaScript APIs in all major browsers.

zh-Hans: ApngDrawable 是 Android 平台上的一个高效而轻量的 APNG 图像解码库。
en: ApngDrawable is an efficient and lightweight APNG image decoding library on the Android platform.

zh-Hans: Google VR for Android 支持 DayDream 和 Cardboard。
en: Google VR for Android supports DayDream and Cardboard.

zh-Hans: PayPal 安卓 SDK 可以轻松地将 PayPal 支付服务集成到移动应用中。
en: PayPal Android SDK can easily integrate PayPal payment services into mobile applications.

zh-Hans: 一个框架。一套代码库。任意平台部署。不仅能提供整个软件开发生命周期所需要的一切，更是打造领先于行业、为用户所钟爱软件的最快捷、最聪明的方法。
en: One framework. One codebase. Deploy to any platform. Not only can it provide everything needed for the entire software development lifecycle, but it is also the fastest and smartest way to create industry-leading software that users love.

zh-Hans: 一个 Android 平台上的简单的 GIF 编码器。
en: A simple GIF encoder on the Android platform.

zh-Hans: 基于灵活高效的分析模型，发现用户行为数据的价值，进而转化为促进增长的行动。
en: Discover the value of user behavior data based on a flexible and efficient analysis model, then translate it into actions that promote growth.

zh-Hans: 这个 Android 库用于以最简单的方式修复 android.widget.Toastm的一些严重的 bug。
en: This Android library is used to fix some serious bugs in android.widget.Toastm in the simplest way.

zh-Hans: 业务安全风控 AFD，是基于业务场景，结合 IP 画像、设备指纹、黑卡检测、威胁情报等多维度信息实时识别风险的专业防护产品。AFD 能够有效识别和解决渠道推广、账号安全、支付安全、营销活动等作弊问题，避免企业出现巨大的经济损失。Android 安全 SDK 又名——昊天 SDK，是一个基于海量威胁情报数据的智能分析平台， 打通了移动、云、PC 的全链条安全数据，利用深度学习人工智能平台从海量的安全事件中进行关联分析，能感知出潜在的互联网威胁以及 APT 事件，并能对攻击阵营的基础设施和技术手段进行分析识别，告别被动防御局面， 为用户提供更加安全的互联网体验。
en: Business Security Risk Control AFD is a professional protection product that identifies risks in real-time based on business scenarios, combining IP portraits, device fingerprints, black card detection, threat intelligence, and other multidimensional information. AFD can effectively identify and solve cheating issues in channel promotion, account security, payment security, marketing activities, etc., preventing huge economic losses for enterprises. The Android Security SDK, also known as Haotian SDK, is an intelligent analysis platform based on massive threat intelligence data, connecting the full chain of mobile, cloud, and PC security data. It uses a deep learning artificial intelligence platform to perform correlation analysis from massive security events, perceiving potential internet threats and APT events, and analyzing and identifying the infrastructure and technical means of the attack camp, moving away from passive defense, providing users with a more secure internet experience.

zh-Hans: ZBar 是一个用于从各种来源读取条码的开源软件套件, 它支持许多流行的条码类型, 包括 EAN-13/UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, Code 128, Code 39, 交叉 2/5 码(Interleaved 2 of 5)和二维码(QR Code)
en: ZBar is an open-source software suite for reading barcodes from various sources. It supports many popular barcode types, including EAN-13/UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, Code 128, Code 39, Interleaved 2 of 5, and QR Code.

zh-Hans: Rclone 是一个用于管理云文件的命令行程序。
en: Rclone is a command-line program for managing cloud files.

zh-Hans: Ren'Py 是一种视觉小说引擎，被来自世界各地数以千计的创作者们使用，可帮助您使用文字、图像和声音在计算机和移动设备上运行交互式故事。
en: Ren'Py is a visual novel engine used by thousands of creators around the world, helping you run interactive stories on computers and mobile devices using text, images, and sound.

zh-Hans: 机器学习服务（ML Kit）提供机器学习套件，为开发者使用机器学习能力开发各类应用，提供优质体验。得益于华为长期技术积累，ML Kit 为开发者提供简单易用、服务多样、技术领先的机器学习能力，助力开发者更快更好地开发各类 AI 应用。
en: Machine Learning Kit (ML Kit) provides a suite of machine learning capabilities for developers to use in developing various applications, offering a high-quality experience. Benefiting from Huawei's long-term technical accumulation, ML Kit provides developers with simple, diverse, and technologically advanced machine learning capabilities, helping developers develop various AI applications faster and better.

zh-Hans: Conscrypt 是一个 Java 安全提供程序 (JSP)，它实现了部分 Java 加密扩展 (JCE) 和 Java 安全套接字扩展 (JSSE)。 它使用 BoringSSL 为 Android 和 OpenJDK 上的 Java 应用程序提供加密原语和传输层安全性 (TLS)。 有关所提供内容的详细信息，请参阅功能文档。
en: Conscrypt is a Java Security Provider (JSP) that implements parts of the Java Cryptography Extension (JCE) and Java Secure Socket Extension (JSSE). It uses BoringSSL to provide cryptographic primitives and Transport Layer Security (TLS) for Java applications on Android and OpenJDK. For detailed information on what is provided, see the feature documentation.

zh-Hans: xHook 是一个针对 Android 平台 ELF (可执行文件和动态库) 的 PLT (Procedure Linkage Table) hook 库。
en: xHook is a PLT (Procedure Linkage Table) hook library for ELF (Executable and Linkable Format) files and dynamic libraries on the Android platform.

zh-Hans: KOOM(Kwai OOM, Kill OOM)是快手性能优化团队在处理移动端 OOM 问题的过程中沉淀出的一套完整解决方案。
en: KOOM (Kwai OOM, Kill OOM) is a complete solution developed by the Kuaishou performance optimization team in the process of handling mobile OOM issues.

zh-Hans: Sentry 是一个实时事件日志记录和聚合平台，它专门用于监视错误和提取执行适当的事后操作所需的所有信息。
en: Sentry is a real-time event logging and aggregation platform specifically designed for monitoring errors and extracting all the information needed for appropriate post-mortem actions.

zh-Hans: Dexter 是一个 Android 库，它简化了运行时请求权限的过程。
en: Dexter is an Android library that simplifies the process of requesting runtime permissions.

zh-Hans: 京东开普勒提供标准化交易组件，合作伙伴以 SDK/H5 的方式集成，也可直接呼起京东 APP，打造完美的购物体验，轻松实现流量合作。
en: JD Kepler provides standardized trading components, allowing partners to integrate via SDK/H5 or directly invoke the JD APP, creating a perfect shopping experience and easily achieving traffic cooperation.

zh-Hans: Trichrome 返回到 Chrome 和 Webview 的单独应用程序，但将共享资源放在第三个共享库 APK 中。
en: Trichrome returns to separate apps for Chrome and Webview, but places shared resources in a third shared-library APK.

zh-Hans: libcurl 是一个免费且易于使用的客户端 URL 传输库。
en: libcurl is a free and easy-to-use client URL transfer library.

zh-Hans: 中文簡繁轉換開源項目，支持詞彙級別的轉換、異體字轉換和地區習慣用詞轉換（中國大陸、臺灣、香港、日本新字體）。
en: An open-source project for converting between traditional and simplified Chinese, supporting conversion at the vocabulary level, variant character conversion, and regional habitual word conversion (Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan's new characters).

zh-Hans: Opus 是用于通过网络进行交互式语音和音频传输的编解码器。
en: Opus is a codec for interactive voice and audio transmission over the internet.

zh-Hans: Log4cpp 是一个 C++ 类库，用于灵活地将日志记录到文件、系统日志、IDSA 和其他目的地。
en: Log4cpp is a library of C++ classes for flexible logging to files, syslog, IDSA, and other destinations.

zh-Hans: Cubism SDK 是在用户 APP 上使用通过 Live2D Cubism Editor 制作的模型所需的软件开发组套件。
en: Cubism SDK is a software development kit required to use models created with the Live2D Cubism Editor in user applications.

zh-Hans: Megazord 将多个 Rust 组件打包为单一的 .so 文件，以减少代码体积并增加易用性。
en: Megazord packages multiple Rust components into a single .so file to reduce code size and increase usability.

zh-Hans: 内置几种了常用的弹窗，十几种良好的动画，将弹窗和动画的自定义设计的极其简单。
en: Built-in several common pop-ups, with dozens of good animations, making the custom design of pop-ups and animations extremely simple.

zh-Hans: 一个 SharedPreferences 的包装器，真正支持跨多进程共享数据。
en: A wrapper for SharedPreferences that truly supports cross-process data sharing.

zh-Hans: ML Kit 以功能强大且易于使用的软件包将 Google 的机器学习专业知识带给移动开发人员。使用经过优化可在设备上运行的解决方案，让您的 iOS 和 Android 应用程序更具吸引力、个性化和有用。
en: ML Kit brings Google's machine learning expertise to mobile developers with powerful and easy-to-use packages. Use optimized solutions to run on-device, making your iOS and Android apps more engaging, personalized, and useful.

zh-Hans: libtorrent 的 Java 版本，libtorrent 的 swig Java 接口。
en: libtorrent for java, a swig Java interface for libtorrent.

zh-Hans: 用 Go 编写的加密覆盖文件系统。
en: Encrypted overlay filesystem written in Go.

zh-Hans: TiffBitmapFactory 是一个 Android 库，允许在 Android 设备上打开和保存 *.tif 格式的图像。
en: TiffBitmapFactory is an Android library that allows opening and saving images in *.tif format on Android devices.

zh-Hans: LibRaw 是一个用于读取数码相机 RAW 文件的库。
en: LibRaw is a library for reading RAW files from digital cameras.

zh-Hans: 一个框架。一套代码库。任意平台部署。不仅能提供整个软件开发生命周期所需要的一切，更是打造领先于行业、为用户所钟爱软件的最快捷、最聪明的方法。
en: One framework. One codebase. Deploy to any platform. Not only can it provide everything needed for the entire software development lifecycle, but it is also the fastest and smartest way to create industry-leading software that users love.

zh-Hans: AdColony 移动广告 SDK 适用于 Android。
en: AdColony Mobile Ads SDK for Android.

zh-Hans: 一个现代、便携、易于使用的加密库。
en: A modern, portable, easy to use crypto library.

zh-Hans: 腾讯云语音识别 ASR SDK 提供服务端、客户端、前端以及小程序 SDK ，给您提供了一种方便、快捷、灵活的方式，将语音识别功能集成到您的服务。
en: Tencent Cloud Speech Recognition ASR SDK provides server-side, client-side, front-end, and mini-program SDKs, offering a convenient, fast, and flexible way to integrate speech recognition functionality into your services.

zh-Hans: 华为账号服务（HUAWEI Account Kit）为您提供了简单、安全的登录授权功能，方便用户快捷登录。用户不必输入账号、密码和繁琐验证，就可以通过“华为账号登录”快速登录，即刻使用您的App。
en: HUAWEI Account Kit provides you with simple, secure, and quick sign-in and authorization functions. Instead of entering accounts and passwords and waiting for authentication, users can just tap the Sign in with HUAWEI ID button to quickly and securely sign in to your app with their HUAWEI IDs.

zh-Hans: 华为分析服务（Analytics Kit）是针对移动应用、Web、快应用等产品的一站式用户行为分析平台，贴合业务场景，提供数据采集、数据管理、数据分析、数据应用的一体化解决方案，驱动企业实现精准拉新、产品优化、精益运营、业务增长。
en: Huawei Analytics Kit is a one-stop user behavior analysis platform for mobile apps, web, quick apps, etc., tailored to business scenarios, providing an integrated solution for data collection, management, analysis, and application, driving enterprises to achieve precise user acquisition, product optimization, lean operations, and business growth.

zh-Hans: 闪验整合三大运营商，支持国内三网手机号段，Android/iOS 手机，可通过一键获取用户手机号的 SDK 产品，建立以手机号码作为去中心化的开放账号体系，提升注册转换效率的必备功能。
en: Flash Verification integrates the three major operators, supporting domestic three-network mobile number segments, Android/iOS phones, and provides an SDK product for one-click obtaining user phone numbers, establishing a decentralized open account system with mobile numbers as the basis, enhancing registration conversion efficiency.

zh-Hans: 顶象无感验证结合了设备指纹、行为特征、访问频率、地理位置等多项技术，有效的拦截恶意登录、批量注册，阻断机器操作，拦截非正常用户。
en: Dingxiang's frictionless verification combines multiple technologies such as device fingerprinting, behavior characteristics, access frequency, and geographic location to effectively intercept malicious logins, bulk registrations, block machine operations, and intercept abnormal users.

zh-Hans: Android NDK crazy linker 的分支。
en: Fork of the Android NDK crazy linker.

zh-Hans: 用 Go 编写的基于规则的隧道。
适用于Windows、iOS、Android 的多平台视觉小说/ADV 游戏引擎。
en: A multi-platform visual novel/ADV game engine for Windows, iOS, and Android.

zh-Hans: 在原生 Android、iOS、macOS、Node.js 和 Qt 应用程序中显示交互式、完全可定制的地图，由矢量瓦片和 OpenGL 提供支持。
en: Interactive, thoroughly customizable maps in native Android, iOS, macOS, Node.js, and Qt applications, powered by vector tiles and OpenGL.

zh-Hans: Kraken 是一款基于 W3C 标准的高性能渲染引擎。Kraken 底层基于 Flutter 进行渲染，通过其自绘渲染的特性，保证多端一致性。上层基于 W3C 标准实现，拥有非常庞大的前端开发者生态。
en: Kraken is a high-performance rendering engine based on W3C standards. Kraken's underlying rendering is based on Flutter, ensuring multi-end consistency through its self-drawing rendering features. The upper layer is implemented based on W3C standards, with a vast front-end developer ecosystem.

zh-Hans: Jetpack Compose 是用于构建原生 Android 界面的新工具包。Jetpack Compose 使用更少的代码、强大的工具和直观的 Kotlin API 简化并加快了 Android 上的界面开发。
en: Jetpack Compose is a new toolkit for building native Android interfaces. Jetpack Compose simplifies and accelerates UI development on Android with less code, powerful tools, and intuitive Kotlin APIs.

zh-Hans: CodeLocator是一个包含Android SDK 与 Android Studio插件的Android工具集。
en: CodeLocator is an Android toolkit containing Android SDK and Android Studio plugins.

zh-Hans: 让库能够提前预填充要由 ART 读取的编译轨迹。
en: Allow the library to pre-fill compilation traces to be read by ART.

zh-Hans: Qigsaw 是一套基于 Android App Bundles 实现的 Android 动态组件化方案，它无需应用重新安装即可动态分发插件。
en: Qigsaw is an Android dynamic componentization solution based on Android App Bundles, allowing dynamic distribution of plugins without reinstalling the app.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android 的条形码扫描库，使用 ZXing 进行解码。
en: Barcode scanning library for Android, using ZXing for decoding.

zh-Hans: Process Phoenix 便于重新启动您的应用程序进程。
en: Process Phoenix facilitates restarting your application process.

zh-Hans: Firebase C++ SDK 在适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 Firebase 的基础上提供了 C++ 接口，可为您的 C++ 游戏提供强力支持。您可以完全利用 C++ 代码访问 Firebase，无需编写任何平台原生代码。Firebase SDK 还将 Firebase 使用的许多编程语言所特有的习语转译为 C++ 开发人员更为熟悉的接口。
en: Firebase C++ SDK provides a C++ interface on top of Firebase for iOS and Android, offering strong support for your C++ games. You can fully utilize C++ code to access Firebase without writing any platform-native code. Firebase SDK also translates many idioms unique to the programming languages used by Firebase into interfaces more familiar to C++ developers.

zh-Hans: LSPatch 从 Xpatch 分支。LSPatch 提供了一种通过重新打包将 dex 和 so 插入目标 APK 的方法。
en: LSPatch fork from Xpatch. LSPatch provides a way to insert dex and so into the target APK by repackaging.

zh-Hans: Go 实现的 Trojan 代理，支持多路复用/路由功能/CDN 中转/Shadowsocks 混淆插件，多平台，无依赖。
en: Trojan proxy implemented in Go, supporting multiplexing/routing functionality/CDN relay/Shadowsocks obfuscation plugin, multi-platform, no dependencies.

zh-Hans: Rime 输入法引擎核心库。
en: Rime input method engine core library.

zh-Hans: 这个库为使用 XUL 语言和 Gecko 引擎的应用提供可调用的冻结 API。
en: This library provides a callable frozen API for applications using the XUL language and Gecko engine.

zh-Hans: 基于大数据风险识别及生物特征，面向多场景，提供多样化动态认证服务平台，精准识别并认证当前行为人的身份。
en: Based on big data risk identification and biometric features, this platform provides diverse dynamic authentication services across multiple scenarios, accurately identifying and authenticating the current user's identity.

zh-Hans: 基于大数据风险识别及生物特征，面向多场景，提供多样化动态认证服务平台，精准识别并认证当前行为人的身份。
en: Based on big data risk identification and biometric features, this platform provides diverse dynamic authentication services across multiple scenarios, accurately identifying and authenticating the current user's identity.

zh-Hans: 抖音开放平台 SDK 目前提供了抖音登录 & 授权以及分享至抖音的基本能力。您可以通过接入抖音开放平台 SDK 来使用抖音授权登录您的应用或者分享图片或视频到抖音。
en: Douyin Open Platform SDK currently provides basic capabilities for Douyin login & authorization and sharing to Douyin. You can use the Douyin Open Platform SDK to log in to your application with Douyin authorization or share images or videos to Douyin.

zh-Hans: Neptune 是一套灵活，稳定，轻量级的插件化方案。它现在每天在数亿的设备上动态加载和运行插件，支撑着爱奇艺许多独立业务模块的需求和发展，如爱奇艺文学，电影票等。 Neptune 现在完全兼容 Android P 系统，可以在 Android P 设备上稳定且无缝地运行。框架只使用了少数几个浅灰名单中的 API。
en: Neptune is a flexible, stable, lightweight plugin solution. It now dynamically loads and runs plugins on billions of devices daily, supporting the needs and development of many independent business modules of iQIYI, such as iQIYI Literature, Movie Tickets, etc. Neptune is now fully compatible with the Android P system and can run stably and seamlessly on Android P devices. The framework uses only a few APIs from the shallow graylist.

zh-Hans: Filament 是一个基于物理的实时渲染引擎，适用于 Android、iOS、Linux、macOS、Windows 和 WebGL。它被设计为在 Android 上尽可能小且尽可能高效。
en: Filament is a physically-based real-time rendering engine for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and WebGL. It is designed to be as small and efficient as possible on Android.

zh-Hans: 在 Android 中进行测试。
Hermes 是一个为 React Native 应用程序的快速启动而优化的 JavaScript 引擎。它具有提前静态优化和紧凑的字节码。
en: Hermes is a JavaScript engine optimized for fast startup of React Native applications. It features ahead-of-time static optimization and compact bytecode.

zh-Hans: 网易云信致力于互联网络技术的开发与研究，使开发者通过简单集成客户端 SDK 和云端开放 API，快速实现强大的移动互联网 IM 和音视频功能。
en: NetEase Cloud Communication is dedicated to the development and research of internet technology, enabling developers to quickly implement powerful mobile internet IM and audio-video functions through simple integration of client SDK and cloud open API.

zh-Hans: 为你的项目集成一个高效可复用的 Activity 实例片段。
en: Integrate an efficient and reusable Activity instance fragment into your project.

zh-Hans: Quack 提供 Java（Android 和桌面）到 JavaScript 引擎的绑定。Quack 支持 Duktape 和 QuickJS 运行时。
en: Quack provides Java (Android and desktop) bindings to JavaScript engines. Quack supports both the Duktape and QuickJS runtimes.

zh-Hans: AppLovin 为移动游戏开发者提供变现、游戏发行、分析和业务发展等全方位服务。AppLovin 的营销平台和分析套件帮助开发者获取新用户并最大化营收能力，旗下独立运营的媒介部门 Lion Studios 为开发者的游戏发行和推广提供可靠的资源。
en: AppLovin provides monetization, game publishing, analytics, and business development services for mobile game developers. AppLovin's marketing platform and analytics suite help developers acquire new users and maximize revenue potential, while its independently operated media department, Lion Studios, provides reliable resources for game publishing and promotion.

zh-Hans: Audience Network 允许您通过 Facebook 广告变现您的 Android 应用程序。插页式广告是您可以在应用程序中显示的全屏广告。通常在应用程序中发生转换时显示插页式广告。例如——在游戏中完成一个关卡后或在新闻应用中加载一个故事后。
en: The Audience Network allows you to monetize your Android apps with Facebook ads. An interstitial ad is a full screen ad that you can show in your app. Typically interstitial ads are shown when there is a transition in your app. For example -- after finishing a level in a game or after loading a story in a news app.

zh-Hans: 致力于将快手在短视频和直播领域积累的技术能力与资源开放给广大开发者们，以合作互惠的方式共建快手生态。
en: Dedicated to opening up Kuaishou's accumulated technical capabilities and resources in the short video and live streaming fields to a wide range of developers, jointly building the Kuaishou ecosystem through mutually beneficial cooperation.

zh-Hans: Google Play Games plugin for Unity
使游戏开发人员能在使用 Unity® 编写的游戏中集成 Google Play Games API。
en: Google Play Games plugin for Unity
Enables game developers to integrate Google Play Games API into games written with Unity®.

zh-Hans: Cocos2d-x 是一款国产的开源的手机游戏开发框架，基于MIT许可证发布。引擎核心采用C++编写，提供C++、Lua、JavaScript 三种编程语言接口，跨平台支持 iOS、Android 等智能手机，Windows、Mac 等桌面操作系统，以及 Chrome, Safari, IE 等 HTML5 浏览器。Cocos2d-x 引擎被广泛用于开发制作手机游戏、儿童教育软件、网络多媒体UI解决方案等交互性的图形化应用。Cocos2d-x 的主要优势是跨平台、高性能、高兼容性、可热更新、可定制及易用性。
en: Cocos2d-x is a domestic open-source mobile game development framework released under the MIT license. The engine core is written in C++, providing C++, Lua, and JavaScript programming language interfaces, supporting cross-platform for iOS, Android, and other smartphones, Windows, Mac desktop operating systems, and HTML5 browsers like Chrome, Safari, and IE. The Cocos2d-x engine is widely used for developing mobile games, children's educational software, network multimedia UI solutions, and other interactive graphical applications. Its main advantages are cross-platform, high performance, high compatibility, hot updates, customizability, and ease of use.

zh-Hans: GL4ES 是 OpenGL 2.1/1.5 到 GL ES 2.0/1.1 的翻译库，支持 Pandora、ODroid、OrangePI、CHIP、Raspberry PI、Android、Emscripten 和 AmigaOS4。
en: GL4ES is an OpenGL 2.1/1.5 to GL ES 2.0/1.1 translation library, supporting Pandora, ODroid, OrangePI, CHIP, Raspberry PI, Android, Emscripten, and AmigaOS4.

zh-Hans: WebView 提供在应用中集成 Web 页面的能力。
en: WebView provides the ability to integrate web pages within applications.

zh-Hans: 阿里巴巴发布的 XQUIC 库是一个遵循 IETF 标准的 QUIC 和 HTTP/3 的客户端和服务端实现。支持 Android、iOS、Linux 和 macOS。
en: Alibaba released the XQUIC library, a client and server implementation of QUIC and HTTP/3 following IETF standards. It supports Android, iOS, Linux, and macOS.

zh-Hans: Android 和 iOS 的升级应用插件。
en: Upgrade application plugin for Android and iOS.

zh-Hans: quiche 是 Cloudflare 实现的 QUIC 传输协议和 IETF HTTP/3。它为处理 QUIC 数据包和处理连接状态提供了一个低级的 API。应用程序负责提供 I/O (例如 socket 处理)以及支持计时器的事件循环。
en: quiche is Cloudflare's implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and IETF HTTP/3. It provides a low-level API for processing QUIC packets and handling connection state. The application is responsible for providing I/O (e.g., socket handling) and supporting a timer-driven event loop.

zh-Hans: 终极 2D 游戏开发环境。
智能小程序，是百度提供的一种技术解决方案。开发者基于此开发出来的服务，在各类宿主环境（手机 App、车载系统、IOT 设备等）中，可做到用户无感知安装，即点即用。
en: Smart Mini Program is a technical solution provided by Baidu. Services developed based on this can be used in various host environments (mobile apps, in-vehicle systems, IoT devices, etc.) without users perceiving installation, enabling instant use.

zh-Hans: CameraX 是 Jetpack 的新增库。利用该库，可以更轻松地向应用添加相机功能。该库提供了很多兼容性修复程序和解决方法，有助于在众多设备上打造一致的开发者体验。
en: CameraX is a new library in Jetpack. With this library, it's easier to add camera functionality to apps. The library provides many compatibility fixes and workarounds, helping to create a consistent developer experience across a wide range of devices.

zh-Hans: 统一扫码服务（Scan Kit）提供便捷的条形码和二维码扫描、解析、生成能力，帮助您快速构建应用内的扫码功能。得益于华为在计算机视觉领域能力的积累，Scan Kit 可以实现远距离码或小型码的检测和自动放大，同时针对常见复杂扫码场景（如反光、暗光、污损、模糊、柱面）做了针对性识别优化，提升扫码成功率与用户体验。Scan Kit 支持 Android 和 iOS 系统集成。其中，Android 系统集成 Scan Kit 后支持横屏扫码能力。
en: Unified Scan Service (Scan Kit) provides convenient barcode and QR code scanning, parsing, and generation capabilities, helping you quickly build in-app scanning functions. Thanks to Huawei's accumulated capabilities in computer vision, Scan Kit can detect and automatically magnify distant or small codes and has targeted recognition optimization for common complex scanning scenarios (such as reflective, low light, damaged, blurred, cylindrical), improving scan success rate and user experience. Scan Kit supports integration with Android and iOS systems. On Android, Scan Kit supports landscape scanning capabilities.

zh-Hans: 移动互联网发展迅速，移动应用作为企业与客户连接的重要阵地具有重大战略意义，为了让移动应用成功实现数字化转型，凡泰极客推出 FinClip 小程序容器技术，任何 App 均可通过引入此小程序容器来获得运行小程序的能力，使研发人员能够快速响应一线业务诉求，达到降本增效的目的，进一步提升移动应用业务运营能力。
en: With the rapid development of mobile internet, mobile applications hold significant strategic importance as a crucial battleground connecting enterprises and customers. To enable mobile applications to successfully achieve digital transformation, Fantech Geek launched FinClip mini-program container technology. Any app can gain the ability to run mini-programs by introducing this mini-program container, allowing R&D personnel to quickly respond to front-line business demands, achieving cost reduction and efficiency increase, further enhancing mobile application business operation capabilities.

zh-Hans: Imebra DICOM C++ 库连接您的医疗设备。
en: Imebra DICOM C++ Library Connecting your medical devices.

zh-Hans: FMOD 是自适应音频的解决方案。
en: FMOD is the solution for adaptive audio.

zh-Hans: Nebula SDK（支付宝 WebView 定制内核）是移动端 Hybrid 解决方案 SDK，提供了良好的外部扩展功能，拥有功能插件化、事件机制、JSAPI 定制和 H5App 推送更新管理能力。
en: Nebula SDK (Alipay WebView custom kernel) is a mobile hybrid solution SDK, providing good external extension capabilities, with features like pluginization, event mechanism, JSAPI customization, and H5App push update management.

zh-Hans: 扫一扫（Scan）是 mPaaS 提供的扫码组件，源于支付宝的扫码能力。该组件秉承了支付宝精准、快速的扫码能力，能够迅速识别出条形码并准确地获得条码中的信息。
en: Scan is a component provided by mPaaS for scanning codes, originating from Alipay's scanning capabilities. This component inherits Alipay's precise and fast scanning capabilities, quickly identifying barcodes and accurately obtaining information from the codes.

zh-Hans: 检测图片或视频流中的人脸，支持针对检测出的人脸进行属性分析。
en: Detect faces in images or video streams and support attribute analysis for detected faces.

zh-Hans: 移动开发平台（Mobile PaaS，简称 mPaaS）是源于支付宝 App 的移动开发平台，为移动开发、测试、运营及运维提供云到端的一站式解决方案，能有效降低技术门槛、减少研发成本、提升开发效率，协助企业快速搭建稳定高质量的移动 App。
en: Mobile PaaS (mPaaS) is a mobile development platform originating from the Alipay app, providing a one-stop solution from cloud to end for mobile development, testing, operation, and maintenance, effectively reducing technical barriers, reducing R&D costs, improving development efficiency, and assisting enterprises in quickly building stable and high-quality mobile apps.

zh-Hans: mPaaS 的社交分享组件提供微博、微信、支付宝、QQ、短信等渠道的分享功能，提供给开发者统一的接口，无须处理各 SDK 的接口差异性。
en: mPaaS's social sharing component provides sharing functions through channels like Weibo, WeChat, Alipay, QQ, SMS, etc., offering developers a unified interface without handling the interface differences of each SDK.

zh-Hans: 腾讯御安全专注于为个人或企业移动应用开发者，提供全面的应用安全服务。通过对移动应用技术的持续研究，腾讯在移动应用安全领域积累了深厚的开发经验与技术，拥有强大的安全技术团队和丰富的安全数据资源库。
en: Tencent Yusafety focuses on providing comprehensive application security services for individual or enterprise mobile application developers. Through continuous research on mobile application technology, Tencent has accumulated rich development experience and technology in the field of mobile application security, with a strong security technology team and rich security data resource library.

zh-Hans: 用 ndk 和 gradle 构建的 GIF 库，采用 aar 格式，用于与 Android gradle 构建系统一起使用。
en: GIF library built with ndk and gradle in aar format for usage with android gradle build system.

zh-Hans: 7-Zip-JBinding 是一个免费的跨平台 Java 绑定的 7-Zip 免费压缩/解压缩库。
en: 7-Zip-JBinding is a free cross-platform java binding of 7-Zip free compress/decompress library.

zh-Hans: 游戏多媒体引擎（Game Multimedia Engine）是一个专门针对游戏场景定制的实时游戏音视频 SDK，覆盖了休闲社交类、MOBA 类、MMORPG 等多种游戏类型，提供了包括多人实时语音、实时视频、语音消息、语音转文本等功能。功能完备，接入门槛低，一个 SDK 即可满足多样化的游戏音视频诉求。
en: The Game Multimedia Engine is a real-time game audio-video SDK specifically customized for gaming scenarios, covering various game types such as casual social, MOBA, and MMORPG. It provides features including multi-player real-time voice, real-time video, voice messaging, and voice-to-text conversion. It is fully functional, easy to integrate, and a single SDK can meet diverse game audio-video needs.

zh-Hans: QuickJS 是一个小型的可嵌入 JavaScript 引擎。它支持 ES2020 规范，包括模块、异步生成器、代理和 BigInt。它可选地支持数学扩展，如大十进制浮点数（BigDecimal）、大二进制浮点数（BigFloat）和运算符重载。
en: QuickJS is a small and embeddable Javascript engine. It supports the ES2020 specification including modules, asynchronous generators, proxies, and BigInt. It optionally supports mathematical extensions such as big decimal floating point numbers (BigDecimal), big binary floating point numbers (BigFloat), and operator overloading.

zh-Hans: libnode 是 Node.js 的 C++ 实现。
en: libnode is a C++ implementation of Node.js.

zh-Hans: Logan 是美团点评集团推出的大前端日志系统。名称是 Log 和 An 的组合，代表个体日志服务，同时也是金刚狼大叔的大名。
en: Logan is a large-scale front-end logging system launched by Meituan Dianping Group. The name is a combination of Log and An, representing individual log services, and also the big name of Wolverine.

zh-Hans: Cocos2d-x 是 MIT 许可证下发布的一款功能强大的开源游戏引擎。允许开发人员使用 C++、Javascript 及 Lua 三种语言来进行游戏开发。 支持所有常见平台，包括 iOS、Android、Windows、macOS、Linux。
en: Cocos2d-x is a domestic open-source mobile game development framework released under the MIT license. The engine core is written in C++, providing C++, Lua, and JavaScript programming language interfaces, supporting cross-platform for iOS, Android, and other smartphones, Windows, Mac desktop operating systems, and HTML5 browsers like Chrome, Safari, and IE. The Cocos2d-x engine is widely used for developing mobile games, children's educational software, network multimedia UI solutions, and other interactive graphical applications. Its main advantages are cross-platform, high performance, high compatibility, hot updates, customizability, and ease of use.

zh-Hans: 您身边的移动安全专家，为移动应用安全保驾护航。
en: Your mobile security expert, safeguarding mobile application security.

zh-Hans: Vorbis 是一种通用音频和音乐编码格式，与 MPEG-4 的 AAC 和 TwinVQ 同时代，是 MPEG 音频层 3 的下一代。
en: Vorbis is a general-purpose audio and music encoding format contemporary to MPEG-4's AAC and TwinVQ, the next generation beyond MPEG audio layer 3.

zh-Hans: Camera2 是最新的低级 Android 相机包，取代了已弃用的 Camera 类。Camera2 为复杂的用例提供深入的控制，但需要您管理设备特定的配置。
en: Camera2 is the latest low-level Android camera package and replaces the deprecated Camera class. Camera2 provides in-depth controls for complex use cases, but requires you to manage device-specific configurations.

zh-Hans: 一个 Android 压缩和提取库，P7Zip 的 Android 移植。
en: An Android compress and extract library, P7Zip port for Android.

zh-Hans: 极光联盟涵盖效果广告、智能触达、VaaS、互动广告、互动游戏等五大服务，助力开发者提高用户活跃时长、增加用户粘性，提升用户价值。为开发者提供优质的广告变现服务！
en: Aurora Alliance covers five major services: performance advertising, smart reach, VaaS, interactive advertising, and interactive games, helping developers increase user engagement time, enhance user stickiness, and improve user value. Provides developers with premium ad monetization services!

zh-Hans: Mapbox Maps SDK for Android 是一个用于在原生 Android 中显示交互式、完全可定制地图的公共库。它采用符合 Mapbox 样式规范的地图样式，将其应用于符合 Mapbox 矢量瓦片规范的矢量瓦片，并使用 OpenGL 渲染它们。
en: The Mapbox Maps SDK for Android is a public library for displaying interactive, thoroughly customizable maps in native Android. It takes map styles that conform to the Mapbox Style Specification, applies them to vector tiles that conform to the Mapbox Vector Tile Specification, and renders them using OpenGL.

zh-Hans: Flipper（前称 Sonar）是一个用于调试 iOS 和 Android 移动应用程序的平台，最近甚至可以在浏览器或 Node.js 中调试 JS 应用程序。通过简单的桌面界面可视化、检查和控制您的应用程序。使用 Flipper 原样或通过插件 API 扩展它。
en: Flipper (formerly Sonar) is a platform for debugging mobile apps on iOS and Android and, recently, even JS apps in your browser or in Node.js. Visualize, inspect, and control your apps from a simple desktop interface. Use Flipper as is or extend it using the plugin API.

zh-Hans: 畅连能力（CaaS Engine）是华为依托畅连业务通信能力，面向应用开发者和硬件开发者提供的开放接口，可以帮助开发者快速实现应用内视频通话服务。开发者通过华为设备虚拟化服务，可以使用任意视频数据作为视频通话的视频源。
en: Changlian Capability (CaaS Engine) is an open interface provided by Huawei relying on Changlian's business communication capabilities, helping application and hardware developers quickly implement in-app video call services. Developers can use any video data as a video source for video calls through Huawei device virtualization services.

zh-Hans: 华为运动健康服务（HUAWEI Health Kit，简称 Health Kit）是为华为生态应用打造的基于华为账号和用户授权的运动健康数据开放平台。面向消费者，支持运动健康数据存储、灵活授权分享机制；面向开发者和合作伙伴提供数据平台和运动健康开放能力，开发者和合作伙伴可以基于多种类型数据，构建运动健康领域应用与服务。Health Kit 连接硬件设备与生态应用，为消费者提供健康关怀和运动指导，打造优质服务体验。
en: Huawei Health Kit is an open platform for sports and health data built for Huawei ecosystem applications based on Huawei account and user authorization. It supports sports and health data storage and flexible authorization sharing mechanisms for consumers; provides data platforms and open capabilities for sports health to developers and partners, enabling them to build applications and services in the sports health field based on various types of data. Health Kit connects hardware devices and ecosystem applications, providing consumers with health care and sports guidance, creating a quality service experience.

zh-Hans: 火山引擎实时音视频拥有亿级 DAU 产品验证打磨的音视频最佳实践，可以提供全球范围内高质量、低延时的实时音视频通信能力，帮助开发者快速构建语音通话、视频通话、互动直播、转推直播等丰富场景功能。
en: Volcano Engine Real-Time Audio and Video offers best practices for audio and video validated by products with hundreds of millions of DAUs, providing high-quality, low-latency real-time audio and video communication capabilities globally. It helps developers quickly build rich scene functions such as voice calls, video calls, interactive live streaming, and relay live streaming.

zh-Hans: 一个跨平台库，用于访问 USB 设备。
en: A cross-platform library to access USB devices.

zh-Hans: BSON 是一种计算机数据交换格式，主要被用作 MongoDB 数据库中的数据存储和网络传输格式。它是一种二进制表示形式，能用来表示简单数据结构、关联数组（MongoDB 中称为“对象”或“文档”）以及 MongoDB 中的各种数据类型。BSON 之名缘于 JSON，含义为 Binary JSON（二进制 JSON）。
en: BSON is a computer data interchange format, primarily used as a data storage and network transmission format in MongoDB databases. It is a binary representation that can represent simple data structures, associative arrays (called "objects" or "documents" in MongoDB), and various data types in MongoDB. The name BSON is derived from JSON, meaning Binary JSON.

zh-Hans: ANSI C 中的超轻量级 JSON 解析器。
en: Ultralightweight JSON parser in ANSI C.

zh-Hans: libzip 是一个 C 库，用于读取，创建和修改 zip 档案。
en: libzip is a C library for reading, creating, and modifying zip archives.

zh-Hans: zlib 设计为一个免费、通用、合法无拘束——即不受任何专利覆盖——的无损数据压缩库，几乎可以在任何计算机硬件和操作系统上使用。
en: zlib is designed to be a free, general-purpose, legally unencumbered -- that is, not covered by any patents -- lossless data-compression library for use on virtually any computer hardware and operating system.

zh-Hans: 将想法变为现实一款国产手机端可视化编程软件。
en: Turn ideas into reality with a domestic mobile visual programming software.

zh-Hans: 将文字信息转化为声音信息，让应用具备离线语音合成的能力。即让机器像人一样开口说话，给开发者的应用配上“嘴巴”。
en: Converts text information into voice information, giving applications the ability for offline speech synthesis. That is, making machines speak like humans, equipping developers' applications with a 'mouth'.

zh-Hans: RxFFmpeg 是基于 ( FFmpeg 4.0 + X264 + mp3lame + fdk-aac + opencore-amr + openssl ) 编译的适用于 Android 平台的音视频编辑、视频剪辑的快速处理框架，包含以下功能：视频拼接，转码，压缩，裁剪，片头片尾，分离音视频，变速，添加静态贴纸和gif动态贴纸，添加字幕，添加滤镜，添加背景音乐，加速减速视频，倒放音视频，音频裁剪，变声，混音，图片合成视频，视频解码图片，抖音首页，视频播放器及支持 OpenSSL https 等主流特色功能。
en: RxFFmpeg is a fast processing framework for audio-video editing and video clipping on the Android platform, compiled based on (FFmpeg 4.0 + X264 + mp3lame + fdk-aac + opencore-amr + openssl). It includes the following functions: video splicing, transcoding, compression, cropping, intro and outro, audio-video separation, speed change, adding static stickers and gif dynamic stickers, adding subtitles, adding filters, adding background music, speeding up and slowing down video, reversing audio-video, audio cropping, changing voice, mixing, image synthesis video, video decoding image, Douyin homepage, video player, and support for OpenSSL https and other mainstream features.

zh-Hans: 一个用于动态更改 Android ART 运行时的库，可以用于方法动态代理、内存注入、Xposed 以及应用脱壳等。
en: A library for dynamically changing the Android ART runtime, which can be used for method dynamic proxy, memory injection, Xposed, and application unpacking.

zh-Hans: Mobile AI Compute Engine (MACE) 是一个专为移动端异构计算平台(支持 Android, iOS, Linux, Windows)优化的神经网络计算框架。
en: Mobile AI Compute Engine (MACE) is a neural network computing framework optimized for mobile heterogeneous computing platforms (supporting Android, iOS, Linux, Windows).

zh-Hans: 小米 IoT 平台是小米面向消费类智能硬件领域的开放合作平台，开发者借助小米 IoT 平台开放的资源、能力和产品智能化解决方案，能够以极低的成本快速提升产品的智能化水平，满足不同用户对智能产品的使用需求和体验要求，与加入小米 IoT 的其他开发者共同打造极致的智能生活体验。
en: Xiaomi IoT Platform is an open cooperation platform for the consumer intelligent hardware field, allowing developers to quickly enhance the intelligence level of products at a very low cost by leveraging the open resources, capabilities, and intelligent solutions of the Xiaomi IoT Platform. It meets different user needs and experience requirements for intelligent products, creating an ultimate intelligent life experience together with other developers joining the Xiaomi IoT.

zh-Hans: 极光认证整合了三大运营商的网关认证能力，为开发者提供了一键登录和号码认证功能，优化用户注册/登录、号码验证的体验，提高安全性。
en: Aurora Authentication integrates the gateway authentication capabilities of the three major operators, providing developers with one-click login and number authentication functions, optimizing user registration/login and number verification experience, and enhancing security.

zh-Hans: ByteHook (又名 bhook) 是字节跳动开源的一个针对 Android app 的 PLT hook 框架。它提供了一套 Android app 使用 PLT hook 的整体方案，而不仅仅是替换地址。字节跳动的大多数 Android app（包括抖音，今日头条，西瓜视频）在线上环境中使用了 ByteHook 作为 PLT hook 方案。
en: ByteHook (also known as bhook) is a PLT hook framework for Android apps open-sourced by ByteDance. It provides a comprehensive solution for using PLT hooks in Android apps, not just address replacement. Most of ByteDance's Android apps (including TikTok, Toutiao, Xigua Video) use ByteHook as the PLT hook solution in the online environment.

zh-Hans: Monochrome 的目的是消除 32 位 Chrome 和 Webview 库之间的重复（大部分库是相同的）。在 32 位 Monochrome 中，单个组合库同时满足 Chrome 和 Webview 的需求。64 位版本增加了一个仅限 Webview 的库。
en: Monochrome's intent was to eliminate the duplication between the 32-bit Chrome and Webview libraries (most of the library is identical). In 32-bit Monochrome, a single combined library serves both Chrome and Webview needs. The 64-bit version adds an extra Webview-only library.

zh-Hans: ncnn 是一个为手机端极致优化的高性能神经网络前向计算框架。
en: ncnn is a high-performance neural network forward inference framework optimized for mobile devices.

zh-Hans: libp2p 是一个从 IPFS 项目中模块化出来的网络堆栈和库，并单独捆绑起来供其他工具使用的库。
en: libp2p is a network stack and library modularized from the IPFS project and bundled separately for use by other tools.

zh-Hans: Android/Java 包装器，围绕 Lame mp3 编码器。
en: Android/Java wrapper around Lame mp3 encoder.

zh-Hans: Mono 脚本后端，使用 JIT 技术在运行时按需编译代码。
en: Mono script backend, using JIT technology to compile code on demand at runtime.

zh-Hans: A C\C++ library and command-line tools for Diff & Patch between binary files or directories(folder). 一个高效的 diff/patch 实现。
en: A C\C++ library and command-line tools for Diff & Patch between binary files or directories (folder). An efficient diff/patch implementation.

zh-Hans: 提供 aria2 的核心功能，包括对网络和下载的处理。
en: Provides core functions of aria2, including handling network and downloads.

zh-Hans: 在 Android P 及以上版本中不受任何限制地使用反射。
en: Use reflection without any restrictions in Android P and above.

zh-Hans: Burst 是一个运用 LLVM 将 IL/.NET 字节码转换为高度优化的原生代码的编译器。
en: Burst is a compiler that uses LLVM to translate IL/.NET bytecode into highly optimized native code.

zh-Hans: 使用 vivo 账号统一登录，支付，并提供统一的实名认证服务。
en: Use vivo account for unified login, payment, and provide unified real-name authentication service.

zh-Hans: Lofelt Studio 使内容创作者能够利用最新技术提供强大的触觉效果。这套工具允许您通过对音频文件进行详细分析自动生成触觉效果。您可以避免手动编程丰富自然的触觉体验的繁琐过程。重要的是，Lofelt Studio 允许您一次创作触觉效果，然后在各种设备上使用它们。无需为具有不同功能的设备创建不同版本的触觉效果。
en: Lofelt Studio enables content creators to capitalize on the latest technologies for delivering powerful haptic effects. This suite of tools allows you to automatically generate haptic effects by performing detailed analysis of your audio files. You can avoid the painstaking process of manually programming rich and natural haptic experiences. And importantly, Lofelt Studio enables you to author haptic effects once and then use them on a wide variety of devices. There is no need to create different versions of haptic effects for devices with different capabilities.

zh-Hans: Easy Mobile 是一个多合一的 Unity 包，大大简化了移动游戏的标准功能的实现，包括广告、应用内购买、游戏服务、通知和本机移动功能。
en: Easy Mobile is an all-in-one Unity package that greatly simplifies the implementation of de facto standard features of mobile games including advertising, in-app purchasing, game service, notification, and native mobile functionalities.

zh-Hans: SandHook 是作用在 Android ART 虚拟机上的 Java 层 Hook 框架，作用于进程内是不需要 Root 的。
en: SandHook is a Java layer Hook framework acting on the Android ART virtual machine, which does not require Root when acting within the process.

zh-Hans: Android 运行时 (ART) 的 Hook 框架。
开源 Cardboard SDK 允许您为 Android 和 iOS 构建沉浸式跨平台 VR 体验。
en: The open source Cardboard SDK allows you to build immersive cross-platform VR experiences for Android and iOS.

zh-Hans: AndroidPhotoFilters 旨在提供快速、强大和灵活的图像处理工具，用于在任何图像媒体上创建出色的效果。
en: AndroidPhotoFilters aims to provide fast, powerful and flexible image processing instrument for creating awesome effects on any image media.

zh-Hans: OpenAL 音频 API 的软件实现。
en: Software implementation of the OpenAL audio API

zh-Hans: LayaAir 是一个开源的 2D/3D 引擎，专为高性能游戏而设计。LayaAir 支持 TypeScript、JavaScript 和 ActionScript 3.0 编程语言。一次开发，多平台发布。
en: LayaAir is an open-source 2D/3D engine designed for high-performance gaming. LayaAir supports TypeScript, JavaScript, and ActionScript 3.0 programming languages. Develop once, publish on multiple platforms.

zh-Hans: ENet 的目的是在 UDP（用户数据报协议）之上提供一个相对较薄、简单和稳健的网络通信层。它提供的主要功能是可选的可靠、有序的数据包传递。
en: ENet's purpose is to provide a relatively thin, simple and robust network communication layer on top of UDP (User Datagram Protocol). The primary feature it provides is optional reliable, in-order delivery of packets.

zh-Hans: 号码认证服务（Phone Number Verification Service）整合三大运营商特有的网关认证能力，验证用户本机号码与输入号码或账号绑定号码的一致性，升级短信验证码体验，应用于用户注册、登录、安全校验等场景，实现无感知校验。
en: Phone Number Verification Service integrates the unique gateway authentication capabilities of the three major operators to verify the consistency of the user's local number with the input number or account-bound number, upgrading the SMS verification code experience, and applying to scenarios like user registration, login, and security verification, achieving perceptionless verification.

zh-Hans: 一个共享库，适用于 Android、iOS*、OSX、Windows、Linux 和 webGL**，用于压缩/解压缩 zip/gzip/tar/bz2 (.zip/.gz) 文件和缓冲区。
en: A shared library for Android, iOS*, OSX, Windows, Linux, and webGL** to compress/decompress zip/gzip/tar/bz2 (.zip/.gz) files and buffers.

zh-Hans: 一行代码检测 XP/调试/多开/模拟器/root。
BoringSSL 是 Google 在 OpenSSL 基础上派生出的一个原生库，在很多 Google 产品（最值得注意的是 Google Chrome）中和 Conscrypt 代码（Java 代码和原生代码）一起用于加密和传输层安全协议 (TLS)。BoringSSL 没有正式版本（所有用户都需要从头构建），并且无法保证 API 或 ABI 的稳定性。
en: BoringSSL is a native library derived by Google from OpenSSL, used alongside Conscrypt code (Java code and native code) in many Google products (most notably Google Chrome) for encryption and transport layer security protocols (TLS). BoringSSL does not have official releases (all users need to build from scratch) and does not guarantee API or ABI stability.

zh-Hans: 中国金融认证中心（CFCA）安全输入控件。
en: China Financial Certification Authority (CFCA) secure input control.

zh-Hans: ThreadFix 通过将测试和漏洞数据集中在一个地方，使安全团队能够花更少的时间手动关联结果，花更多的时间解决安全风险和漏洞。而且，由于您可以快速识别对组织最重要的风险领域，因此您可以将漏洞存在于应用程序中的时间减少多达 40%。
en: ThreadFix centralizes test and vulnerability data in one place, allowing security teams to spend less time manually correlating results and more time addressing security risks and vulnerabilities. Moreover, by quickly identifying the most important risk areas to the organization, you can reduce the time vulnerabilities exist in applications by up to 40%.

zh-Hans: libpag 是 PAG (Portable Animated Graphics) 动效文件的渲染 SDK，目前已覆盖几乎所有的主流平台，包括：iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, 以及 Web 端。PAG 方案是一套完善的动效工作流。提供从 AE（Adobe After Effects）导出插件，到桌面预览工具 PAGViewer，再到各端的跨平台渲染 SDK。 目标是降低或消除动效研发相关的成本，打通设计师创作到素材交付上线的极简流程，不断输出运行时可编辑的高质量动效内容。PAG 方案目前已经接入了腾讯系 40 余款应用，包括微信，手机 QQ，王者荣耀，腾讯视频，QQ 音乐等头部产品，稳定性经过了海量用户的持续验证，可以广泛应用于 UI 动画、贴纸 动画、视频编辑、模板设计等场景。典型应用场景可以参考官网案例。
en: libpag is the rendering SDK for PAG (Portable Animated Graphics) animation files, currently covering almost all mainstream platforms, including iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web. The PAG solution is a complete animation workflow, providing from AE (Adobe After Effects) export plugin to desktop preview tool PAGViewer, and then to cross-platform rendering SDK on each end. The goal is to reduce or eliminate the costs associated with animation development, streamline the process from designer creation to material delivery and launch, and continuously output high-quality animation content that can be edited at runtime.
