en: Financial-grade real-person authentication service equipped with biometric technologies such as live detection and face comparison, combined with authoritative data source verification, can quickly verify the true identity of natural persons.

zh-Hans: Sonic 库是一个非常简单的 ANSI C 库，设计为易于集成到流式语音应用程序中，如 TTS 后端。
en: The Sonic library is a very simple ANSI C library that is designed to easily be integrated into streaming voice applications, like TTS back ends.

zh-Hans: Reanimated 是一个 React Native 库，允许在 UI 线程上创建流畅的动画和交互。
en: Reanimated is a React Native library that allows for creating smooth animations and interactions that run on the UI thread.

zh-Hans: 一个简单的 React-Native Utils 库，具有随机有用的功能。主要用于后台服务任务，例如通知 onReceive 事件。
en: A simple React-Native Utils library with randomly useful functions. Mainly used for background service tasks, such as notification onReceive events.

zh-Hans: Brotli 是一种通用的无损压缩算法，通过结合现代变体的 LZ77 算法、霍夫曼编码和二阶上下文建模来压缩数据，其压缩比可与当前可用的最佳通用压缩方法相媲美。它的速度与 deflate 相似，但提供更高密度的压缩。
en: Brotli is a generic-purpose lossless compression algorithm that compresses data using a combination of a modern variant of the LZ77 algorithm, Huffman coding, and 2nd order context modeling, with a compression ratio comparable to the best currently available general-purpose compression methods. It is similar in speed with deflate but offers more dense compression.

zh-Hans: ZAndrolua+ 提供的访问操作系统 Posix API 的 luaC 库。
en: ZAndrolua+ provides the luaC library for accessing the operating system Posix API.

zh-Hans: ZXing 是一个以 Java 实现的开源，多格式的 1D 和 2D 条形码映像处理库，其端口为其他语言。
en: ZXing is an open-source, multi-format 1D and 2D barcode image processing library implemented in Java, with ports to other languages.

zh-Hans: 在线客服，连接一切客户。
en: Online customer service, connecting all customers.

zh-Hans: 腾讯优图 AI 开放平台提供 AI + 互联网、金融、教育等多元化的人工智能服务和行业解决方案，包括人脸核身、人脸防伪、内容安全等领域的产品和案例。
en: Tencent Youtu AI Open Platform provides diversified artificial intelligence services and industry solutions, including products and cases in fields like face authentication, face anti-spoofing, content security, etc.

zh-Hans: 一键登录和本机号码校验
号码认证服务，整合三大运营商网关认证能力，在用户无感知过程中实现基于手机号码一键完成登录或认证，升级传统短信验证方式，提升用户体验、提高注册转化率、保障业务流程安全； 通信授权服务，提供用户授权数据实时存证、查询和管理能力，授权过程可知可信可追溯，应用于短信、语音等业务场景。
en: One-click Login and Mobile Number Verification

Number authentication service integrates the gateway authentication capabilities of the three major operators, achieving one-click login or authentication based on mobile numbers during the user's unconscious process, upgrading the traditional SMS verification method, enhancing user experience, improving registration conversion rate, and ensuring business process security; Communication authorization service provides real-time deposit, query, and management capabilities of user authorization data, with the authorization process being known, trustworthy, and traceable, applicable to business scenarios such as SMS and voice.

zh-Hans: 腾讯云慧眼人脸核身（原金融级身份证认证升级版）是一组对用户身份信息真实性进行验证审核的服务套件，提供各类认证功能模块，包含证件 OCR 识别、活体检测、人脸 1:1 对比等能力，以解决行业内大量对用户身份信息核实的需求，广泛应用于金融、运营商、共享出行等领域。
en: Tencent Cloud Huixin Face Verification (formerly Financial-grade ID Authentication Upgrade Version) is a suite of services for verifying the authenticity of user identity information, providing various authentication function modules, including document OCR recognition, liveness detection, and face 1:1 comparison capabilities, to meet the industry's demand for verifying user identity information, widely used in finance, operators, shared mobility, and other fields.

zh-Hans: 在整个移动应用开发生命周期中监控、优先排序和调试性能和稳定性问题。
en: Monitor, prioritize, and debug performance and stability issues throughout the entire mobile app development lifecycle.

zh-Hans: Wwise® 是一款针对游戏开发的综合音频中间件解决方案，可创建精密、丰富的互动音频。它由紧密集成的设计工具和声音引擎构成，可让声音设计师和程序员在更短的时间内更经济地完成令人震憾的音频。
en: Wwise® is an integrated audio middleware solution for game development, allowing for the creation of precise, rich interactive audio. It consists of tightly integrated design tools and sound engines, enabling sound designers and programmers to complete stunning audio in less time and more economically.

zh-Hans: CANN（Compute Architecture for Neural Networks）是华为针对 AI 场景推出的异构计算架构，对上支持多种 AI 框架，对下服务 AI 处理器与编程，发挥承上启下的关键作用，是提升昇腾 AI 处理器计算效率的关键平台。
en: CANN (Compute Architecture for Neural Networks) is a heterogeneous computing architecture introduced by Huawei for AI scenarios. It supports multiple AI frameworks at the upper layer and serves AI processors and programming at the lower layer, playing a key bridging role. It is a critical platform for improving the computing efficiency of Ascend AI processors.

zh-Hans: 网络安全服务 (NSS) 是一组库，旨在支持跨平台开发支持安全的客户端和服务器应用程序。使用 NSS 构建的应用程序可以支持 SSL v3、TLS、PKCS #5、PKCS #7、PKCS #11、PKCS #12、S/MIME、X.509 v3 证书和其他安全标准。
en: Network Security Services (NSS) is a set of libraries designed to support cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server applications. Applications built with NSS can support SSL v3, TLS, PKCS #5, PKCS #7, PKCS #11, PKCS #12, S/MIME, X.509 v3 certificates, and other security standards.

zh-Hans: Rust 的設計目標之一，是要使設計大型的網際網路客戶端和伺服器的任務變得更容易。因此更加強調安全性、記憶體組態、以及並行處理等方面的特性。
en: One of Rust's design goals is to make the task of designing large-scale internet clients and servers easier. Therefore, it places more emphasis on features such as safety, memory configuration, and concurrency.

zh-Hans: Tun2Socks 是一个网络通信库，它可以处理来自当前设备的任意应用的所有网络流量，并通过 HTTP/Socks4/Socks5/Shadowsocks 远程连接，支持 Windows、macOS 等多平台，并且支持 IPv6，可以提供最佳的性能。
en: Tun2Socks is a network communication library that can handle all network traffic from any application on the current device and connect remotely via HTTP/Socks4/Socks5/Shadowsocks, supporting multiple platforms like Windows, macOS, and supporting IPv6, providing optimal performance.

zh-Hans: GMP Push SDK 是 GMP 提供端触达能力的 SDK。
en: GMP Push SDK is an SDK provided by GMP for endpoint reach capabilities.

zh-Hans: Breakpad 是一组实现崩溃报告系统的客户端和服务器组件。
en: Breakpad is a set of client and server components implementing a crash reporting system.

zh-Hans: Gio是一个用于编写跨平台即时模式GUI的Go语言库。Gio支持所有主要平台：Linux、macOS、Windows、Android、iOS、FreeBSD、OpenBSD和WebAssembly。
en: Gio is a Go language library for writing cross-platform immediate mode GUIs. Gio supports all major platforms: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, and WebAssembly.

zh-Hans: Isar 是一款专门为 Flutter 打造的支持全文检索、ACID 语义、类型静态的高可扩展性、异步多线程超高速、跨平台开源数据库。
en: Isar is a highly scalable, asynchronous, multi-threaded, ultra-fast, cross-platform open-source database with full-text search, ACID semantics, and static typing, specifically built for Flutter.

zh-Hans: MindSpore Lite 是一个极速、极智、极简的 AI 引擎，使能全场景智能应用，为用户提供端到端的解决方案，帮助用户使能 AI 能力。
en: MindSpore Lite is a fast, intelligent, and simple AI engine that enables full-scene intelligent applications, providing users with end-to-end solutions, helping them enable AI capabilities.

zh-Hans: mpv 是一个免费的命令行媒体播放器。 它支持多种媒体文件格式、音频和视频编解码器以及字幕类型。
en: mpv is a free command-line media player. It supports various media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types.

zh-Hans: 此存储库托管官方 Unity 本机音频插件 SDK。它是一个标准的 Unity 项目，带有预构建的插件效果和自定义 GUI，适用于 OSX 和 Windows。提供所有插件效果的完整源代码，包括本机代码（NativeCode 文件夹中的 Xcode/VisualStudio C++ 项目代码）以及自定义 GUI（GUICode 文件夹中的 MonoDevelop 项目）。
en: This repository hosts the official Unity Native Audio Plugin SDK. It is a standard Unity project that comes with prebuilt plugin effects and custom GUIs for OSX and Windows. Full source code for all plugin effects is provided, both for the native code (Xcode/VisualStudio C++ projects code in the NativeCode folder) as well as the custom GUIs (MonoDevelop project in the GUICode folder).

zh-Hans: 使用 Skia 的高性能 2D 图形用于 React Native。
en: High-performance 2D graphics for React Native using Skia.

zh-Hans: ShadowHook 支持了很多新增 hook 特性，例如通过“函数地址”或“库名 + 函数名”的方式指定 hook 位置、集成符号地址查找功能等，现在被用于 Tiktok，抖音，今日头条等软件中。
en: ShadowHook supports many new hook features, such as specifying hook locations via 'function address' or 'library name + function name', integrating symbol address lookup functionality, etc., now used in software like TikTok, Douyin, and Toutiao.

zh-Hans: TagLib 是一个用于读取和编辑多种流行音频格式的元数据的库。 目前，它支持 MP3 文件的 ID3v1 和 ID3v2，FLAC、MPC、Speex、WavPack、TrueAudio、WAV、AIFF、MP4 和 ASF 文件中的 Ogg Vorbis 注释和 ID3 标签和 Vorbis 注释。
en: TagLib is a library for reading and editing metadata of many popular audio formats. Currently, it supports ID3v1 and ID3v2 for MP3 files, Ogg Vorbis comments, and ID3 tags in FLAC, MPC, Speex, WavPack, TrueAudio, WAV, AIFF, MP4, and ASF files.

zh-Hans: 将跟踪事件写入系统跟踪缓冲区。
en: Write tracking events to the system trace buffer.

zh-Hans: 为 Android Auto 和 Android Automotive OS 构建导航和兴趣点应用。
en: Build navigation and point of interest apps for Android Auto and Android Automotive OS.

zh-Hans: 该 Gradle 插件会在编译时扫描项目的项目对象模型依赖关系。如果应用程序的直接依赖项存在 Maven 项目对象模型，插件就会处理该元素，并在最终应用程序 APK 的 Android 资产中嵌入每个许可证的链接和标题。
en: This Gradle plugin scans the POM dependencies of a project at compile time. When a Maven POM exists for a direct dependency of the app, the plugin processes the element and embeds the link and title of each license in an Android asset in the final app APK.

zh-Hans: TapTap 开发者服务（TapTap Developer Services，简称 TDS 服务）旨在帮助开发者降低游戏研发、运营维护等阶段投入的精力和成本。TDS 整合了各项服务，让开发者能够聚焦在游戏核心乐趣的创造上，创作更优秀的游戏，进而促进游戏行业生态的良性循环，最终让开发者与玩家双双受益。
en: TapTap Developer Services (TDS) aims to help developers reduce the effort and cost invested in game development, operation, and maintenance stages. TDS integrates various services, allowing developers to focus on creating the core fun of games, creating better games, and promoting a positive cycle of the game industry ecosystem, ultimately benefiting both developers and players.

zh-Hans: ACRA 捕获异常，检索大量上下文数据并将其发送到您选择的后端。
en: ACRA catches exceptions, retrieves lots of context data and sends them to the backend of your choice.

zh-Hans: 视频拍摄 & 编辑 SDK 基于完全自主研发的跨平台视音频处理引擎，支持 iOS、Android、Web、PC、智能硬件等，提供视频模板(一键成片 & 剪同款)、智能视频创作、美颜滤镜、特效贴纸、智能校色、人像分割等整体解决方案。拥有高效灵活、低消耗、易扩展特点，降低内容创作门槛和成本，为企业和开发者提供具有竞争力的智能视频生产能力。
en: Video Shooting & Editing SDK is based on a fully self-developed cross-platform audio and video processing engine, supporting iOS, Android, Web, PC, smart hardware, etc. It provides video templates (one-click video creation & same style editing), intelligent video creation, beauty filters, special effects stickers, intelligent color correction, portrait segmentation, and other overall solutions. It features high efficiency, flexibility, low consumption, and easy expansion, lowering the threshold and cost of content creation, offering competitive intelligent video production capabilities to enterprises and developers.

zh-Hans: PDFium 是 Chrome 的 PDF 渲染引擎，并且是开源的。
en: PDFium is the PDF rendering engine for Chrome and is open-source.

zh-Hans: UniRapidJSON 是 Unity 的 RapidJSON 包装器。
en: UniRapidJSON is a RapidJSON wrapper for Unity.

zh-Hans: BarHopper 是一个 ML Kit 中的库，用于在 Android 设备上识别或解码条形码。
en: BarHopper is a library in ML Kit for recognizing or decoding barcodes on Android devices.

zh-Hans: Android StackBlur 是一个库，可以根据渐变（梯度）或半径对位图执行模糊效果（处理），并返回结果。该库基于 Mario Klingemann 的代码，兼容 Android 版本 1.5（几乎与每台设备兼容）。
en: Android StackBlur is a library that performs a blur effect on a bitmap based on gradient or radius and returns the result. The library is based on Mario Klingemann's code and is compatible with Android version 1.5 (almost compatible with every device).

zh-Hans: YAML 是一种对所有编程语言友好的数据序列化语言，LibYAML 是一个 YAML 解析器和发射器库。
en: YAML is a human-friendly data serialization language for all programming languages and LibYAML is a YAML parser and emitter library.

zh-Hans: 一个使用 C++ 实现的 dex 高性能运行时解析库，用于查找被混淆的类、方法或者属性。
en: A high-performance runtime parsing library implemented in C++ for dex, used to find obfuscated classes, methods, or properties.

zh-Hans: 通过库的办法供给特效才能，在无用资源删去、无用代码去除、代码优化上有较大空间，实现了对用户拍摄好的视频内容进行编辑、添加特效等工作（如：TikTok 特效拍照），在支撑多功能用途的根底上尽量减小包的体积，提高代码的质量，完成代码功效与代码体积之间的平衡。
en: By providing library capabilities for special effects, there is considerable space for removing useless resources, eliminating unnecessary code, and optimizing code. It allows users to edit and add special effects to video content (e.g., TikTok special effect shooting), aiming to minimize package size while supporting multi-functional uses, improving code quality, and achieving a balance between code functionality and code size.

zh-Hans: 腾讯云视立方·腾讯特效（Tencent Effect）SDK 是音视频终端 SDK （腾讯云视立方）的重要组成部分，提供美颜特效功能。移动端/PC 端美颜特效基于优图精准的 AI 能力和天天 P 图丰富的实时特效处理，为各类视频处理场景提供丰富的产品能力。腾讯特效 SDK 支持与腾讯云视立方·直播 SDK 、短视频 SDK、音视频通话 SDK  等音视频终端产品集成，高效便捷，优势尤为明显。
en: Tencent Cloud Cubic · Tencent Effect (Tencent Effect) SDK is an important component of the audio-video terminal SDK (Tencent Cloud Cubic), providing beauty effect functions. Mobile/PC beauty effects are based on Youtu's precise AI capabilities and TianTian P Tu's rich real-time effect processing, providing rich product capabilities for various video processing scenarios. Tencent Effect SDK supports integration with Tencent Cloud Cubic · Live SDK, Short Video SDK, Audio and Video Call SDK, and other audio-video terminal products, efficient and convenient, with particularly obvious advantages.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android（8.0+，OpenGL ES 3.2）和 iOS（10+）的轻量级和现代地图 SDK。
en: The lightweight and modern Map SDK for Android (8.0+, OpenGL ES 3.2) and iOS (10+)

zh-Hans: nmmp 是一个用于保护 Android 类的 dex 文件的库，它使用 dex-vm 技术将类和方法转换为字节码，从而防止反编译。
en: nmmp is a library for protecting Android class dex files, using dex-vm technology to convert classes and methods into bytecode, preventing decompilation.

zh-Hans: Oboe 是谷歌推出用于在 Android 上实现高性能音频应用的 C++ 库，支持 API16 以上 Android 版本。在 API27 以上使用 AAudio 实现，API27 以下使用 OpenSL ES 实现，以提供最好的音频能力。适用于低延迟、高互动的场景，比如耳返功能、高互动游戏等。
en: Oboe is a C++ library launched by Google for implementing high-performance audio applications on Android, supporting Android versions above API16. It uses AAudio implementation above API27 and OpenSL ES implementation below API27 to provide the best audio capabilities. Suitable for low-latency, high-interaction scenarios, such as ear return function, high-interaction games, etc.

zh-Hans: 通过 Adjust 安卓 SDK，您可以在自己的安卓应用中跟踪归因、事件及更多数据。
en: With the Adjust Android SDK, you can track attribution, events, and more data within your Android app.

zh-Hans: SoundTouch 是开源音频处理库，用于更改音频流或音频文件的节奏、音调和播放速度，以及较准确地估计音轨的 BPM。
en: SoundTouch is an open-source audio processing library used for changing the tempo, pitch, and playback speed of audio streams or audio files, and for accurately estimating the BPM of audio tracks.

zh-Hans: 适用于 React Native 的 SQLite3 本机插件。
en: SQLite3 Native Plugin for React Native

zh-Hans: Tiny C Compiler（简称 TCC, 或 Tiny CC）。可以编译所有 C99 标准的 ANSI C 程序 , 支持 CPU 包括：X86 32 或 64 位, ARM，支持 Windows, Linux, OSX.（跨平台跨系统的能力强）。
en: Tiny C Compiler (TCC, or Tiny CC) can compile all ANSI C programs of the C99 standard, supporting CPUs including: X86 32 or 64 bit, ARM, supporting Windows, Linux, OSX. (Strong cross-platform and cross-system capabilities).

zh-Hans: 游戏盾是通过封装登录器隐藏真实 IP，需要修改业务IP换成游戏盾 IP，然后在后台添加源 IP 和转发业务端口，玩家通过下载封装好的登录器进入游戏。是采用多机房集群部署模式，节点切换无感知，加密所有连接，实现 CC 零误封，避免源 IP 泄漏，免疫 CC 与 DDOS 攻击。
en: Game Shield hides the real IP by encapsulating the login program. You need to modify the business IP to the Game Shield IP, then add the source IP and forwarding business port in the background. Players enter the game by downloading the encapsulated login program. It adopts a multi-machine room cluster deployment mode, with seamless node switching, encrypting all connections, achieving CC zero false positives, avoiding source IP leakage, and immune to CC and DDOS attacks.

zh-Hans: zipalign 是一种 zip 归档文件对齐工具，有助于确保归档文件中的所有未压缩文件相对于文件开头对齐。这样一来，您便可直接通过 mmap(2) 访问这些文件，而无需在 RAM 中复制这些数据并减少了应用的内存用量，zipalign 使用了4字节的边界对齐方式来映射内存，通过空间换时间的方式提高执行效率。在将 APK 文件分发给最终用户之前，先使用 zipalign 进行优化。
en: zipalign is a zip archive alignment tool that helps ensure all uncompressed files in the archive are aligned relative to the start of the file. This allows you to access these files directly through mmap(2) without copying this data into RAM, reducing the application's memory usage. zipalign uses 4-byte boundary alignment to map memory, improving execution efficiency by trading space for time. Optimize your APK files with zipalign before distributing them to end users.

zh-Hans: 使用 Jetpack Compose 风格的 API 为远程表面构建布局。
en: Build layouts for remote surfaces using a Jetpack Compose-style API.

zh-Hans: 视频服务（Video Kit）提供视频播放、HDR Vivid 视频处理服务，后续将提供视频编辑和视频托管服务，助力您快速构建视频特性，帮助您向用户提供视频媒体体验。
en: Video Service (Video Kit) provides video playback and HDR Vivid video processing services. In the future, it will offer video editing and video hosting services, helping you quickly build video features and provide a video media experience to users.

zh-Hans: Snapdragon 神经处理引擎（SNPE）是一个 Qualcomm Snapdragon 软件加速运行时，用于执行深度神经网络。
en: The Snapdragon Neural Processing Engine (SNPE) is a Qualcomm Snapdragon software-accelerated runtime for the execution of deep neural networks.

zh-Hans: TNN 是由腾讯优图实验室开源的高性能、轻量级神经网络推理框架，同时拥有跨平台、高性能、模型压缩、代码裁剪等众多突出优势。TNN 框架在原有 Rapidnet、ncnn 框架的基础上进一步加强了移动端设备的支持以及性能优化，同时借鉴了业界主流开源框架高性能和良好拓展性的特性，拓展了对于后台 X86, NV GPU 的支持。手机端 TNN 已经在众多应用中落地，服务端 TNN 作为腾讯云 AI 基础加速框架已为众多业务落地提供加速支持。
en: TNN is an open-source high-performance, lightweight neural network inference framework by Tencent Youtu Lab, featuring cross-platform, high performance, model compression, code trimming, and many other outstanding advantages. TNN framework further enhances mobile device support and performance optimization on the basis of the original Rapidnet and ncnn frameworks, while drawing on the high performance and good extensibility characteristics of mainstream open-source frameworks in the industry, expanding support for backend X86, NV GPU. TNN on mobile devices has already been deployed in numerous applications, and TNN on the server side, as Tencent Cloud's AI base acceleration framework, has provided acceleration support for many business deployments.

zh-Hans: libdevinfo 库提供用于访问所有公共设备配置数据的接口。
en: libdevinfo library provides interfaces for accessing all public device configuration data.

zh-Hans: 基于语音的人机交互，一直都是带着神秘的面纱，给广大需要使用这个能力的设备、应用的开发者带来不少的困惑。为了让大家能比较容易为设备进行语音赋能，思必驰基于自己近十多年的深度研发，基于全链路语音技术推出 DUI 平台及 DUI 语音系统，旨在为大家降低进入门槛，为您的设备、应用赋能语音交互能力，给您服务的用户带来全新的体验。
en: Voice-based human-computer interaction has always been shrouded in mystery, causing a lot of confusion for developers who need to use this capability in their devices and applications. To make it easier for everyone to empower devices with voice, iFlytek has launched the DUI platform and DUI voice system based on its nearly ten years of deep research and full-chain voice technology, aiming to lower the entry threshold and empower your devices and applications with voice interaction capabilities, bringing a new experience to the users you serve.

zh-Hans: 这是一个带有实验性质的库，提供使用伪终端文件描述符创建进程的功能，以探索本机上的可能性代码来实现 PTY 与否；而不是去利用纯 FFI 和阻塞隔离的方式。预计它将比当前的实现，即（https://github.com/TerminalStudio/pty）更具稳定性。
en: This is an experimental library that provides the ability to create processes using pseudo-terminal file descriptors to explore the possibility of implementing PTY on the native side; rather than using pure FFI and blocking isolation. It is expected to be more stable than the current implementation at (https://github.com/TerminalStudio/pty).

zh-Hans: FUSE（用户空间文件系统）是一个接口，用于用户空间程序将文件系统导出到 Linux 内核。FUSE 项目由两个组件组成：fuse 内核模块（在常规内核存储库中维护）和 libfuse 用户空间库（在此存储库中维护）。libfuse 提供了与 FUSE 内核模块通信的参考实现。FUSE 文件系统通常实现为一个独立的应用程序，链接到 libfuse。libfuse 提供挂载文件系统、卸载、从内核读取请求并发送响应回去的功能。libfuse 提供两种 API：“高级”同步 API 和“低级”异步 API。
en: FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) is an interface for userspace programs to export a filesystem to the Linux kernel. The FUSE project consists of two components: the fuse kernel module (maintained in the regular kernel repositories) and the libfuse userspace library (maintained in this repository). libfuse provides the reference implementation for communicating with the FUSE kernel module. A FUSE file system is typically implemented as a standalone application that links with libfuse. libfuse provides functions to mount the file system, unmount it, read requests from the kernel, and send responses back. libfuse offers two APIs: a "high-level", synchronous API, and a "low-level" asynchronous API.

zh-Hans: HDR Vivid视频处理服务提供HDR Vivid视频图像的OETF、Tonemapping、HDR2SDR等能力，助力您快速构建HDR Vivid视频的播放、分享特性，帮助您向用户提供HDR Vivid视频媒体体验。
en: HDR Vivid video processing service provides capabilities such as OETF, Tonemapping, and HDR2SDR for HDR Vivid video images, helping you quickly build HDR Vivid video playback and sharing features, providing users with HDR Vivid video media experience.

zh-Hans: Leptonica 是一个以教学为导向的开源库，包含广泛用于图像处理和图像分析应用的软件。
en: Leptonica is a pedagogically-oriented open-source library containing software that is broadly useful for image processing and image analysis applications.

zh-Hans: Liblouis 软件套件提供了一个开源盲文翻译器、反翻译器和格式化器，适用于大量语言和盲文代码。它是一组库，设计用于许多应用程序，无论是免费还是商业的。它用 C 编写，因此不需要运行时环境，因此可以在用高级语言（如 Java 和 Python）编写的应用程序中使用。
en: The Liblouis software suite provides an open-source braille translator, back-translator, and formatter for a large number of languages and braille codes. It is a set of libraries designed for use in any of a number of applications, both free and commercial. It is written in C so that it does not require a runtime environment and hence can be used in applications written in high-level languages such as Java and Python.

zh-Hans: Foxit PDF SDK for Android 致力于帮助开发人员快速将强大的 Foxit PDF 技术集成到他们自己的移动端应用程序中。通过 Foxit 开发包，即使是对 PDF 了解有限的开发人员也可以在 Android 平台上用几行代码快速构建一个专业的 PDF 阅读器。有关更多详细信息，可以访问网站https://developers.foxitsoftware.cn/pdf-sdk/。
en: Foxit PDF SDK for Android aims to help developers quickly integrate powerful Foxit PDF technology into their own mobile applications. With the Foxit development kit, even developers with limited PDF knowledge can quickly build a professional PDF reader on the Android platform with just a few lines of code. For more details, you can visit the website https://developers.foxitsoftware.cn/pdf-sdk/.

zh-Hans: Stretch 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 Flexbox 实现。Stretch 的目标是为所有平台提供一个坚实的布局基础，特别关注移动设备。长期来看，我们希望 Stretch 不仅支持 Flexbox，还支持许多其他布局算法，如网格布局。Stretch 是为并支持 https://visly.app 而制作的。
en: Stretch is an implementation of high performance Flexbox written in Rust. The goal of stretch is to provide a solid foundation for layout across all platforms with a specific focus on mobile. Long term we want stretch to not only support flexbox but also many other layout algorithms such as grid layout. Stretch was made for and powers https://visly.app.

zh-Hans: Snapdragon 神经处理引擎（SNPE）是一个 Qualcomm Snapdragon 软件加速运行时，用于执行深度神经网络。
en: The Snapdragon Neural Processing Engine (SNPE) is a Qualcomm Snapdragon software-accelerated runtime for the execution of deep neural networks.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android、iOS、Raspberry Pi 和服务器的离线语音识别 API，支持 Python、Java、C# 和 Node。
en: Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi, and servers with Python, Java, C#, and Node.

zh-Hans: x264 是一个用于将视频流编码为 H.264/MPEG-4 AVC 压缩格式的自由软件库和应用程序，并根据 GNU GPL 条款发布。
en: x264 is a free software library and application for encoding video streams into the H.264/MPEG-4 AVC compression format, and is released under the terms of the GNU GPL.

zh-Hans: 华为服务号（Business Touch Kit）提供给商家对应的服务号，让用户快速发现商家服务，建立用户与商家的互动连接。为您提供华为统一的商家服务号中心，通过服务分发，用户互动连接，多样化的营销工具等，促进商家的商业闭环。
en: Huawei Business Touch Kit provides merchants with corresponding service numbers, allowing users to quickly discover merchant services and establish interactive connections between users and merchants. It provides Huawei's unified merchant service number center, promoting merchants' business closed-loop through service distribution, user interaction connections, and diverse marketing tools.

zh-Hans: 使用通用用户界面在远程接收设备上启用媒体显示和播放。
en: Enable media display and playback on remote receiver devices using a common user interface.

zh-Hans: 允许在平台的旧 API 版本上访问新 API（许多使用 Material Design）。
en: Allows access to new APIs on older API versions of the platform (many using Material Design).

zh-Hans: 在支持旧设备的同时，针对最新的平台功能和 API。
en: Target the latest platform features and APIs while also supporting older devices.

zh-Hans: 音频服务（Audio Kit）是华为公司在音频领域的能力集合，为您提供了基于 HMS Core 的音频播放能力，包括硬件及系统底层的音频编解码能力。
en: Audio Service (Audio Kit) is Huawei's capability collection in the audio field, providing you with audio playback capabilities based on HMS Core, including hardware and system-level audio codec capabilities.

zh-Hans: 广告服务（Ads Kit）依托华为终端平台与数据能力为您提供流量变现服务，帮助您解决流量变现的难题；同时为广告主提供广告服务，配合华为终端平台向用户提供个性化的营销活动或商业广告。
en: Ads Kit relies on Huawei's terminal platform and data capabilities to provide you with traffic monetization services, helping you solve the problem of traffic monetization; at the same time, it provides advertising services for advertisers, cooperating with Huawei's terminal platform to offer personalized marketing activities or commercial advertisements to users.

zh-Hans: Javet 是 V8 JavaScript 引擎的 Java 封装库。它是 Java 嵌入 Node.js 和 V8 的绝佳方案。
en: Javet is a Java wrapper library for the V8 JavaScript engine. It is an excellent solution for embedding Node.js and V8 in Java.

zh-Hans: 滴滴出行开放平台正式上线，三方应用与个人开发者接入 SDK 后，可将滴滴出行集成到自己的应用中，轻松构建打车服务，为您的用户提供一段美好旅程。
en: Didi Chuxing Open Platform is officially launched, allowing third-party applications and individual developers to integrate Didi Chuxing into their own applications via SDK, easily building ride-hailing services and offering your users a pleasant journey.

zh-Hans: ion 是 Google 在 Android 4.0 ICS 为了解决内存碎片化管理而引入的通用内存管理器，用来支持不同的内存分配机制。另外，ion 在内核空间和用户空间分别有一套接口，它不仅能管理内存，还可在其 clients（来自内核的或者来自用户空间的）之间共享内存；简单来说，ion 是一种用于内存管理和分配的高性能内核驱动程序。它可以帮助开发人员实现零拷贝（zero-copy）和共享内存等功能，从而提高系统的性能和效率。与此同时，ion 还与 CMA（Contiguous Memory Allocator）密切相关。在 Android 中，ion 使用了 CMA 来实现对物理内存的分配和释放。
en: ion is a general memory manager introduced by Google in Android 4.0 ICS to solve memory fragmentation management, supporting different memory allocation mechanisms. Additionally, ion has a set of interfaces in both kernel space and user space, managing memory and sharing it between its clients (from the kernel or user space). Simply put, ion is a high-performance kernel driver for memory management and allocation. It helps developers achieve zero-copy and shared memory functions, improving system performance and efficiency. Meanwhile, ion is closely related to CMA (Contiguous Memory Allocator). In Android, ion uses CMA for physical memory allocation and release.

zh-Hans: 快应用框架依赖的 JavaScript 运行环境。
en: The JavaScript runtime environment relied upon by the Quick Application Framework.

zh-Hans: VCAP 是 vivo 自研的全能力、高性能、跨平台的移动端 AI 计算加速平台，助力开发者将 AI 算法在移动端快速部署、高效运行。
en: VCAP is vivo's self-developed comprehensive, high-performance, cross-platform mobile AI computing acceleration platform, assisting developers in quickly deploying and efficiently running AI algorithms on mobile devices.

zh-Hans: Unity Ads SDK 由领先的移动游戏引擎创建，无论您是在 Unity、xCode 还是 Android Studio 中进行开发，都能为您的游戏提供全面的变现服务框架。
en: Unity Ads SDK, created by the leading mobile game engine, provides a comprehensive monetization service framework for your game, whether you are developing in Unity, xCode, or Android Studio.

zh-Hans: 极速视频（Express Video）是一款实时的音视频互动服务产品，能够为开发者提供便捷接入、高可靠、多平台互通的音视频服务。通过低至 200 ms 的端到端平均时延，业内领先的保障弱网质量的 QoS 策略，并结合强大的 3A 处理能力，完美支持一对多、多对多的实时音视频通话、直播、会议等场景。
en: Express Video is a real-time audio and video interactive service product that provides developers with convenient access, high reliability, and multi-platform interoperable audio and video services. With an end-to-end average delay as low as 200 ms, industry-leading QoS strategies for weak network quality assurance, and powerful 3A processing capabilities, it perfectly supports one-to-many, many-to-many real-time audio and video calls, live streaming, conferences, and other scenarios.

zh-Hans: OpenVPN 是一个功能齐全的开源 SSL VPN 解决方案，适用于各种配置，包括远程访问、站点到站点 VPN、Wi-Fi 安全性和企业级远程访问解决方案，具有负载均衡、故障转移和细粒度访问控制。OpenVPN 以复杂性为安全之敌为基本前提，提供了一种适合中小企业和企业市场的成本效益高、轻量级的替代方案。
en: OpenVPN is a full-featured open-source SSL VPN solution that accommodates a wide range of configurations, including remote access, site-to-site VPNs, Wi-Fi security, and enterprise-scale remote access solutions with load balancing, failover, and fine-grained access-controls. Starting with the fundamental premise that complexity is the enemy of security, OpenVPN offers a cost-effective, lightweight alternative to other VPN technologies that is well-adapted for the SME and enterprise markets.

zh-Hans: WireGuard® 是一个极其简单但快速且现代的 VPN，利用最先进的加密技术。它旨在比 IPsec 更快、更简单、更精简、更有用，同时避免了大量的麻烦。它打算比 OpenVPN 更加高效。WireGuard 被设计为通用 VPN，可在嵌入式界面和超级计算机上运行，适用于多种不同情况。最初为 Linux 内核发布，现在是跨平台的（Windows、macOS、BSD、iOS、Android）并广泛部署。虽然目前正在积极开发中，但它已经可能被认为是行业中最安全、最易于使用和最简单的 VPN 解决方案。
en: WireGuard® is an extremely simple yet fast and modern VPN that utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPsec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN. WireGuard is designed as a general-purpose VPN for running on embedded interfaces and supercomputers alike, fit for many different circumstances. Initially released for the Linux kernel, it is now cross-platform (Windows, macOS, BSD, iOS, Android) and widely deployable. It is currently under heavy development, but already it might be regarded as the most secure, easiest to use, and simplest VPN solution in the industry.

zh-Hans: miniLZO 是一个非常轻量级的 LZO 库子集，旨在便于与您的应用程序集成。
en: miniLZO is a very lightweight subset of the LZO library intended for easy inclusion with your application.

zh-Hans: 新一代认知智能大模型，拥有跨领域知识和语言理解能力，能够基于自然对话方式理解与执行任务。
en: A new generation cognitive intelligence model with cross-domain knowledge and language understanding capabilities, able to understand and execute tasks based on natural dialogue.

zh-Hans: Cello 是一个将高级编程引入 C 的库。通过作为一个现代、强大的运行时系统，Cello 使许多以前在 C 中不切实际或尴尬的事情变得简单。
en: Cello is a library that brings higher level programming to C. By acting as a modern, powerful runtime system Cello makes many things easy that were previously impractical or awkward in C.

zh-Hans: LiquidFun 是 Box2D 的扩展。它为 Box2D 的刚体功能添加了基于粒子的流体和软体模拟。LiquidFun 可以为许多不同的系统构建，包括 Android，iOS，Windows，OS X，Linux 和 JavaScript。
en: LiquidFun is an extension of Box2D. It adds particle-based fluid and soft-body simulation to Box2D's rigid body capabilities. LiquidFun can be built for many different systems, including Android, iOS, Windows, OS X, Linux, and JavaScript.

zh-Hans: Log4a 是一个基于 mmap，高性能、高可用的 Android 日志收集框架。
en: Log4a is a high-performance, high-availability Android log collection framework based on mmap.

zh-Hans: Ink 是一个软件库，使 Google 应用程序能够让用户通过手绘和手写表达自己。
en: Ink is a software library enabling Google applications to let their users express themselves using freehand drawing and handwriting.

zh-Hans: 一个美味的 root 检查库和示例应用程序。我们在互联网上搜罗了不同的方法来回答那个古老的问题……这个设备有 root 权限吗？
en: A tasty root checker library and sample app. We've scoured the internets for different methods of answering that age-old question... Has this device got root?

zh-Hans: libvpx 是 Google 和开放媒体联盟 (AOMedia) 的一个免费软件视频编解码库。它作为 VP8 和 VP9 视频编码格式的参考软件实现，而对于 AV1，则有一个名为 libaom 的特殊分支，剥离了向后兼容性。
en: libvpx is a free software video codec library from Google and the Alliance for Open Media (AOMedia). It serves as the reference software implementation for the VP8 and VP9 video coding formats, and for AV1 a special fork named libaom that was stripped of backward compatibility.

zh-Hans: WOFF2 压缩/解压缩算法库，用 C++ 实现。
en: WOFF2 compression/decompression algorithm library implemented in C++.

zh-Hans: 努比亚系统的推送服务。
运行 Android 4.4（API 级别 19）到 Android 10（API 级别 29）的旧设备和运行 Android 11 或 12 的 Android Go 设备，支持 Google Play 服务，可以安装照片选择器的回移版本。
en: Older devices that run Android 4.4 (API level 19) through Android 10 (API level 29) and Android Go devices running Android 11 or 12 that support Google Play services can install a backported version of the photo picker.

zh-Hans: 腾讯地图定位 SDK 是一套基于 Android 4.1 及以上版本设备的应用程序接口。通过该接口，您可以轻松使用腾讯地图定位服务，构建 LBS 应用程序。
en: Tencent Map Location SDK is a set of application programming interfaces based on Android 4.1 and above devices. Through this interface, you can easily use Tencent map location services to build LBS applications.

zh-Hans: 百川电商 SDK - 唤醒手淘

①任何投放都可直接唤醒手淘打开。当消费者无手淘时，默认引导手淘下载，但开发者可自行调整为退回到 H5 页面打开(请注意此时登录态不再支持透传)；
②部分页面可支持在开发者APP内打开，可以默认不唤醒手淘。这部分页面，新版百川 SDK 将通过套件功能对外开放，在套件内会包含相应可被调用的页面。
en: Baichuan E-commerce SDK - Wake Up Taobao

① Any placement can directly wake up Taobao to open. When consumers do not have Taobao, the default guide is to download Taobao, but developers can adjust it to return to the H5 page to open (please note that the login state is no longer supported for transparent transmission at this time); ② Some pages can be opened within the developer's APP without waking up Taobao by default. These pages, the new version of the Baichuan SDK will be opened to the public through the suite function, and the suite will contain corresponding callable pages.

zh-Hans: 哔哩哔哩 OAuth 2.0，可使用户授权第三方应用访问其哔哩哔哩上基本开放信息和其他已授权的相关信息，而无需将用户名和密码提供给第三方应用。
en: Bilibili OAuth 2.0 allows users to authorize third-party applications to access their basic open information and other authorized related information on Bilibili without providing usernames and passwords to third-party applications.

zh-Hans: 一个 Java 库，用于访问 Dropbox 的基于 HTTP 的核心 API v2。此 SDK 还支持较旧的核心 API v1，但该支持将在某个时候被删除。
en: A Java library to access Dropbox's HTTP-based Core API v2. This SDK also supports the older Core API v1, but that support will be removed at some point.

zh-Hans: DRouter 是 18 年滴滴乘客端自研的一套 Android 路由框架，基于平台化解耦的思想，为组件间通信服务。该项目以功能全面、易用为原则，支持各种路由场景，在页面路由、服务获取和过滤、跨进程及应用、VirtualApk 插件支持等方面都能提供多样化的服务。目前已在滴滴乘客端、顺风车、单车、国际化、滴滴定制车等十多个滴滴的 app 内使用，得到各种场景的验证。
en: DRouter is an Android routing framework independently developed by Didi Passenger in 2018, based on the idea of platform decoupling, serving communication between components. The project adheres to the principles of comprehensive functionality and ease of use, supporting various routing scenarios, and provides diverse services in page routing, service acquisition and filtering, cross-process and application, VirtualApk plugin support, and more. It is currently used in over ten Didi apps, including Didi Passenger, Hitch, Bike, Internationalization, Didi Custom Car, etc., and has been verified in various scenarios.

zh-Hans: IOTC（物联网云）平台是 Throughtek (TUTK) 所开发的基于云平台的物联网解决方案。它利用 P2P 连接技术与云计算，加上跨平台 API，使得不同的互联网设备之间可以建立跨平台的连接。使用 TUTK 提供的 SDK 所开发的网络摄像机客户端与服务端，会被嵌入 IOTC 库，用于与 TUTK 服务器通讯，并建立 P2P 连接。
en: IOTC (Internet of Things Cloud) platform is a cloud-based IoT solution developed by Throughtek (TUTK). It utilizes P2P connection technology and cloud computing, along with cross-platform APIs, enabling cross-platform connections between different internet devices. The network camera client and server developed using the SDK provided by TUTK will be embedded with the IOTC library for communication with TUTK servers and establishing P2P connections.

zh-Hans: 一套专为移动端开发的原创 IM 通信层框架。
en: An original IM communication layer framework designed for mobile development.

zh-Hans: hsynz 是一个用使用同步算法来进行增量更新的库，类似于 zsync。 通过http(s)实现rsync；在客户端实现同步算法，服务器端只需要提供http(s)的CDN。支持zstd和zlib压缩，支持大文件和目录(文件夹)，支持多线程。
en: hsynz is a library for incremental updates using synchronization algorithms, similar to zsync. Achieves rsync through http(s); implements synchronization algorithms on the client side, while the server side only needs to provide http(s) CDN. Supports zstd and zlib compression, supports large files and directories (folders), supports multi-threading.

zh-Hans: MuPDF 是一个轻量级的 PDF、XPS 和电子书查看器。
en: MuPDF is a lightweight PDF, XPS, and E-book viewer.

zh-Hans: 此包包含用于实现 JPEG 图像编码、解码和转码的 C 软件。JPEG 是一种标准化的全彩色和灰度图像压缩方法。
en: This package contains C software to implement JPEG image encoding, decoding, and transcoding. JPEG is a standardized compression method for full-color and grayscale images.

zh-Hans: 一个跨平台库，用于访问 USB 设备。
en: A cross-platform library to access USB devices.

zh-Hans: 将 RTL2832U 转变为 SDR 的软件。
en: Software to turn the RTL2832U into an SDR.

zh-Hans: React Native Screens 旨在为 React Native 暴露原生的导航容器组件，它目前只能作为 React Navigation 的依赖库而无法独立使用。
en: React Native Screens aims to expose native navigation container components to React Native, which can currently only be used as a dependency library for React Navigation and cannot be used independently.

zh-Hans: 小红书分享开放平台基于行业规则和开发者诉求，提供了基于客户端代码的分享 SDK。
en: Xiaohongshu Sharing Open Platform provides a sharing SDK based on client code, following industry rules and developer demands.

zh-Hans: ANGLE - 几乎原生的图形层引擎。

zh-Hans: TapTap 开发者服务（TapTap Developer Services，简称 TDS 服务）旨在运用 TapTap 平台资源、技术积累、发行经验，帮助开发者降低游戏研发、运营成本，连接目标玩家，提升各项数据，最终取得游戏成功。
en: TapTap Developer Services (TDS) aims to leverage TapTap’s platform resources, technical expertise, and publishing experience to help developers reduce game development and operation costs, connect with target players, improve key metrics, and ultimately achieve game success.

zh-Hans: uni-app 是一个使用 Vue.js 开发所有前端应用的框架，开发者编写一套代码，可发布到 iOS、Android、鸿蒙 Next、Web（响应式）、以及各种小程序、快应用、鸿蒙元服务等多个平台。
en: uni-app is a framework for developing all front-end applications using Vue.js. Developers write one set of code and can publish it to iOS, Android, HarmonyOS Next, Web (responsive), and various mini programs, quick apps, and HarmonyOS services.

zh-Hans: UC 内核内核是 UC 自研，并与最新 UC 浏览器同款的移动浏览器内核，其具有强大的 webview 能力，让用户获得畅快的 H5 体验。轻量的接入 SDK、稳定的性能以及完备的功能，让合作伙伴在快速嵌入 UC 浏览器内核后，为 app 获得更稳定、更安全、更顺畅的浏览体验。
en: The UC Kernel is UC’s self-developed mobile browser engine, the same as the latest UC Browser version. It offers powerful WebView capabilities for a smooth H5 experience. With its lightweight SDK, stable performance, and complete features, partners can quickly integrate the UC Browser engine to deliver a more stable, secure, and smooth browsing experience in their apps.

zh-Hans: 将 pytorch 模型部署到包括安卓在内的多个平台上运行。
en: Deploy and run models based on Pytorch, to multiple platforms including Android.

zh-Hans: Expo 是一个框架，使开发 Android 和 iOS 应用变得更简单。该框架提供基于文件的路由、标准的原生模块库等功能。
en: Expo is a framework that makes developing Android and iOS apps easier. The framework provides file-based routing, a standard library of native modules, and much more.

zh-Hans: Expo框架提供的 SQLite数据库功能。
en: The SQLite database functionality provided by the Expo framework.

zh-Hans: 基于 Socks5 代理的隧道（tun2socks），适用于 Unix。
en: A tunnel over Socks5 proxy (tun2socks) for Unix.

zh-Hans: libjpeg-turbo 是一个 JPEG 图像编解码器，使用 SIMD 指令（MMX、SSE2、AVX2、Neon、AltiVec）来加速 x86、x86-64、Arm 和 PowerPC 系统上的基线 JPEG 压缩与解压缩，以及在 x86、x86-64 和 Arm 系统上的渐进式 JPEG 压缩。
en: libjpeg-turbo is a JPEG image codec that uses SIMD instructions (MMX, SSE2, AVX2, Neon, AltiVec) to accelerate baseline JPEG compression and decompression on x86, x86-64, Arm, and PowerPC systems, as well as progressive JPEG compression on x86, x86-64, and Arm systems.

zh-Hans: U4 内核内核是 UC 自研，并与最新 UC 浏览器同款的移动浏览器内核，其具有强大的 webview 能力，让用户获得畅快的 H5 体验。轻量的接入 SDK、稳定的性能以及完备的功能，让合作伙伴在快速嵌入 UC 浏览器内核后，为 app 获得更稳定、更安全、更顺畅的浏览体验。
en: The U4 Kernel is UC’s self-developed mobile browser engine, the same as the latest UC Browser version. It offers powerful WebView capabilities for a smooth H5 experience. With its lightweight SDK, stable performance, and complete features, partners can quickly integrate the UC Browser engine to deliver a more stable, secure, and smooth browsing experience in their apps.

zh-Hans: MobileGlues（意为“在移动端，GL 使用 ES”）是一个运行在主机 OpenGL ES 3.2 之上的 GL 实现，旨在运行 Minecraft Java 版。
en: MobileGlues, which stands for "(on) Mobile, GL uses ES", is a GL implementation running on top of host OpenGL ES 3.2, with running Minecraft Java Edition in mind.

zh-Hans: 为应用提供安全可信的风险检测能力，包括：恶意 URL 检测能力、终端环境安全检测能力、日志防泄漏检测能力、移动应用加固服务、隐私安全检测服务、可信数字身份密钥服务，方便快速集成。
en: Provides secure and reliable risk detection capabilities for apps, including malicious URL detection, device environment security checks, log leak prevention, mobile app hardening services, privacy security detection, and trusted digital identity key services, making integration quick and easy.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android 的 pngquant 基础 Java 绑定库。
en: A basic Java binding library for pngquant on Android.

zh-Hans: 在 iOS 和 Android 上以相同方式工作的键盘管理器。
en: Keyboard manager which works in identical way on both iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: Picker 是一个跨平台 UI 组件，用于从选项列表中选择一个项目。
en: SVG library for React Native, React Native Web, and plain React web projects.

zh-Hans: 绕过安卓 Hidden Api 限制，Hidden Api 访问绝技。
en: Bypasses Android Hidden API restrictions, offering advanced Hidden API access capabilities.

zh-Hans: Taro 是一个开放式跨端跨框架解决方案，支持使用 React/Vue/Nerv 等框架来开发微信/京东/百度/支付宝/字节跳动/QQ/飞书/快手小程序、H5、React Native 等应用。
en: Taro is an open cross-platform, cross-framework solution that supports using React/Vue/Nerv to develop WeChat/JD/Baidu/Alipay/Bytedance/QQ/Feishu/Kuaishou mini programs, H5, React Native, and other applications.

zh-Hans: Xray，洞察一切。同时是最好的 v2ray-core。魔法发生的地方。一个用于多种用途的开放平台。
en: Xray, Penetrates Everything. Also the best v2ray-core. Where the magic happens. An open platform for various uses.

zh-Hans: Android 上强大的悬浮窗组件，支持 系统浮窗(需要权限)、应用内浮窗(无权限)、局部悬浮(View)，支持边缘吸附、回弹、自定义动画、位置保存、窗口化及分屏后位置修复等。
en: A powerful floating window component for Android, supporting system-level floating windows (requires permission), in-app floating windows (no permission), and partial floating views. It supports edge adsorption, rebound, custom animations, position saving, and position restoration after windowing or split-screen.

zh-Hans: Apache Cordova 是一个开源的移动的开发框架。它允许您使用标准 Web 技术——HTML 5、CSS 3 和 JavaScript 进行跨平台开发。Cordova 应用将在针对每个平台的包装器中执行，并依赖于符合标准的 API 绑定来访问每个设备的功能，如传感器、数据、网络状态等。
en: Apache Cordova is an open-source mobile development framework. It allows you to use standard web technologies - HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for cross-platform development. Applications execute within wrappers targeted to each platform, and rely on standards-compliant API bindings to access each device's capabilities such as sensors, data, network status, etc.

zh-Hans: Android 小部件，可以渲染存储在 SD 卡上、作为资源链接或从远程 URL 下载的 PDF 文档。
en: Android widget that can render PDF documents stored on SD card, linked as assets, or downloaded from a remote URL.

zh-Hans: 依托 Auth0 身份平台，为应用添加强大的身份认证与授权功能。集中管理来自多个身份提供商的用户，为他们提供品牌化、无缝的注册和登录体验。通过高度自定义的访问控制，满足最复杂的安全需求。
en: Rely on the Auth0 identity platform to add sophisticated authentication and authorization to your applications. Centralize and manage users from multiple identity providers and give them branded, seamless signup and login experiences. Finely control access with a degree of customization that can accommodate even the most complex security requirements.

zh-Hans: 一个 Flutter 插件，允许你添加内联 WebView、使用无界面 WebView，并打开应用内浏览器窗口。
en: A Flutter plugin that allows you to add an inline webview, to use an headless webview, and to open an in-app browser window.

zh-Hans: Stripe Android SDK 让你能够在 Android 应用中快速、轻松地构建出色的支付体验。我们提供功能强大且可自定义的 UI 元素，可直接用于收集用户的支付信息。同时，我们也提供支持这些 UI 的底层 API，方便你构建完全自定义的支付体验。
en: The Stripe Android SDK makes it quick and easy to build an excellent payment experience in your Android app. We provide powerful and customizable UI elements that can be used out-of-the-box to collect your users' payment details. We also expose the low-level APIs that power those UIs so that you can build fully custom experiences.

zh-Hans: Persona 提供了一个强大且安全的平台，帮助组织收集、验证、存储和分析全球任何个人的身份。前端的转化优化用户界面让你可以在几分钟内轻松开始身份验证。
en: Persona provides a powerful, secure platform to help organizations collect, verify, store, and analyze the identity of any individual in the world. A frontend, conversion-optimized user interface makes it easy to start verifying identities in minutes.

zh-Hans: BytePlus MediaLive 基于先进的音视频处理和大规模内容分发技术，为各行业的企业和个人提供安全、稳定、专业的云端直播服务。凭借丰富的功能和增值服务，BytePlus MediaLive 让你只需几步就能搭建一个流媒体平台。
en: BytePlus MediaLive, built on advanced audio and video processing and large-scale content distribution technologies, offers secure, stable, and professional cloud-based live-streaming services to enterprises and individuals across various industries.With a rich set of features and value-added services, BytePlus MediaLive enables you to build a streaming platform in just a few steps.

zh-Hans: 本组件用于识别当前用户使用的上网卡是否为王卡。识别后给王卡用户以相应的免流状态提示和王卡身份感知。
en: This component is used to identify whether the current user's SIM card is a KingCard. Once identified, KingCard users will receive the corresponding free data usage status prompt and KingCard identity awareness.

zh-Hans: Limbo 是一个基于 QEMU 的 Android 模拟器，支持以下架构的仿真：x86/x86_64 ARM/ARM64 PowerPC/PowerPC64 Sparc。
en: Limbo is a QEMU-based emulator for Android supports emulation for these architectures: x86/x86_64 ARM/ARM64 PowerPC/PowerPC64 Sparc

zh-Hans: 一个轻量级的、多平台、多架构的 Hook 框架。
en: a lightweight, multi-platform, multi-architecture hook framework.

zh-Hans: Tencent GCloud 服务平台是腾讯游戏研发效能部打造的游戏中台，负责聚焦腾讯游戏技术预研和实现，通过提供产品化的服务来提升整体游戏研发效能。
en: Tencent GCloud service platform is a game middleware developed by Tencent’s Game R&D Efficiency Department. It focuses on Tencent’s game technology research and implementation, providing productized services to improve overall game development efficiency.

zh-Hans: Juicebox 协议接口，提供基于简单 PIN 验证的分布式机密存储和恢复。
en: An interface for the Juicebox Protocol which provides distributed storage and recovery of secrets using simple PIN authentication.

zh-Hans: 使用 AI Voice SDK 并结合我们的完整指南，你可以轻松将 AI 驱动的噪声消除和音频解决方案集成到应用中。
en: Use AI Voice SDK with the help of our comprehensive guide. Easily integrate AI-powered noise cancellation and audio solutions into your applications.

zh-Hans: OpenH264 是一个编解码器库，支持 H.264 编码和解码。适用于 WebRTC 等实时应用。
en: OpenH264 is a codec library which supports H.264 encoding and decoding. It is suitable for use in real time applications such as WebRTC.

zh-Hans: 一个基于 Boardwalk 的适用于 Android 和 iOS 的《我的世界：Java 版》启动器。
en: A Minecraft: Java Edition Launcher for Android and iOS based on Boardwalk.

zh-Hans: 为 Flutter 开发者提供基于 Rust 的 HTTP 请求能力。
en: Make HTTP requests using Rust for Flutter developers.

zh-Hans: 这可能是 Android 上最小的 RTMP 客户端（约 60KB，完整版本约 300KB）。它通过 JNI 接口调用 librtmp 函数。
en: It is probably the smallest(~60KB, fat version ~300KB) rtmp client for android. It calls librtmp functions over JNI interface.

zh-Hans: 欢太账号 OAuth 授权 SDK
欢太账号 OAuth 授权 SDK 是向您提供的基于 Oauth2.0 标准协议的快捷登录服务，用户可以通过授权的方式直接登录手机上的欢太账号，快速访问您的应用。
en: The Huantai Account OAuth Authorization SDK provides a quick login service based on the OAuth 2.0 standard protocol. Users can directly log in to the Huantai account on their phones through authorization and quickly access your application.

zh-Hans: 使用此 SDK 可以为你的 Android/Kotlin 应用添加实时视频、音频和数据功能。通过连接到 LiveKit Cloud 或自建服务器，你只需几行代码就能快速构建多模态 AI、直播或视频通话等应用。
en: Use this SDK to add realtime video, audio and data features to your Android/Kotlin app. By connecting to LiveKit Cloud or a self-hosted server, you can quickly build applications such as multi-modal AI, live streaming, or video calls with just a few lines of code.

zh-Hans: Donut 多端框架是支持使用小程序技术和工具开发移动应用的框架，开发者可以一次编码，分别编译为小程序和 Android 以及 iOS 应用，实现多端开发；能帮助企业有效降低多端应用开发的技术门槛和研发成本，以及提升开发效率和开发体验。
en: The Donut multi-end framework supports using mini program technologies and tools to develop mobile applications. Developers can write code once and compile it into mini programs, Android apps, and iOS apps, enabling cross-platform development. It helps enterprises effectively reduce the technical barriers and R&D costs of multi-end application development, while improving development efficiency and experience.

zh-Hans: 一个包含项目、测试、设置片段和 AdblockWebView 演示应用的 Android 库。
en: An Android library containing project, tests, settings fragments, and demo application for AdblockWebView.

zh-Hans: AppSealing 是唯一的云端按需付费解决方案，可在无需编写任何代码的情况下保护移动应用。该方案易于使用，能够防止黑客攻击和非法的应用篡改，并通过 RASP 安全特性在运行时保障应用安全。
en: AppSealing is the only cloud-based pay-as-you-go solution to protect mobile apps without writing a single line of code. Our solution is easy to use and allows you to protect mobile apps from hackers and illegal application modification, thus making it secure in run-time with RASP Security Features.

zh-Hans: LWJGL 是一个 Java 库，使开发者能够跨平台访问常用的原生 API，用于开发图形（OpenGL、Vulkan）、音频（OpenAL）以及并行计算（OpenCL）应用。这种访问方式既直接且高性能，同时又封装在类型安全、用户友好的层之中，适合 Java 生态系统。
en: LWJGL is a Java library that enables cross-platform access to popular native APIs useful in the development of graphics (OpenGL, Vulkan), audio (OpenAL) and parallel computing (OpenCL) applications. This access is direct and high-performance, yet also wrapped in a type-safe and user-friendly layer, appropriate for the Java ecosystem.

zh-Hans: Rust 的跨平台 traceroute 库。Libtraceroute 是一个用于 Rust 的跨平台 traceroute 库，可用于显示可能的路由（路径），并测量数据包在 IP 网络中的传输延迟。
en: Cross-platform traceroute library for Rust. Libtraceroute is a cross-platform traceroute library for Rust, that allows displaying possible routes (paths) and measuring transit delays of packets across an Internet Protocol (IP) network.

zh-Hans: 为您自己开发的应用快速注入 MT 的文件提供器，无需 ROOT 即可在手机上管理此应用的私有目录文件。
en: Quickly inject the MT file provider into your self-developed application, allowing you to manage the app's private directory files on the phone without ROOT access.

zh-Hans: 面向泛生态合作伙伴提供的付费推广服务，帮助合作伙伴与荣耀终端用户建立沟通，向用户传递价值信息和服务。
en: A paid promotion service for pan-ecosystem partners, helping them establish communication with Honor device users to deliver valuable information and services.

zh-Hans: 京媒平台依托京东海量电商广告主，京东为媒体提供最优质的商业化解决方案。可帮助媒体快速自助对接资源、高效率将京东广告主的广告投放在媒体资源位上，支持多种交易模式，灵活、自主、透明，最大化实现媒体资源价值变现。
en: Relying on JD.com's massive e-commerce advertiser base, the JD Media platform provides media partners with high-quality commercialization solutions. It helps media quickly and autonomously access resources to efficiently display ads from JD advertisers, supporting various trading models that are flexible, independent, and transparent to maximize media resource monetization.

zh-Hans: BytePlus RTC 支持全球范围内高可靠、高并发且低延迟的实时通信，并提供允许各种形式在线互动的服务。
en: BytePlus RTC enables highly reliable, concurrent and low latency real-time communication across the globe and provides a service that allows various forms of online interaction.

zh-Hans: 一个可用于图片、实时摄像和视频的 C++ & Java 的滤镜处理库。
en: A C++ & Java filter processing library for images, real-time camera feeds, and video.

zh-Hans: CrashSight 为开发者提供崩溃异常捕获、上报、分析和规避方案等全链路闭环专业服务，帮助开发者快速定位并解决异常问题，降低产品崩溃率，提升用户体验。
en: CrashSight provides developers with professional, full-cycle services including crash exception capture, reporting, analysis, and avoidance solutions. It helps developers quickly locate and resolve exceptions, reducing product crash rates and improving user experience.

zh-Hans:
FLAC是一款开源软件，它能在不丢失任何信息的前提下，减少存储数字音频信号所需的存储空间。
该软件读取和生成的文件被称为FLAC文件。由于其他软件也能读写这些符合FLAC格式的文件，因此该软件通常被称为FLAC参考实现。
en:
FLAC is open-source software that reduces the storage space required for digital audio signals without losing any information.
The files read and generated by this software are called FLAC files. Since other software can also read and write these files conforming to the FLAC format, this software is often referred to as the FLAC reference implementation.

zh-Hans: KDE Frameworks 是一套包含 83 个用于 Qt 编程的附加库集合。
en: The KDE Frameworks are a set of 83 add-on libraries for programming with Qt.

zh-Hans: NativeScript 是一个基于 JavaScript 的开源跨平台开发框架，用于开发 iOS、visionOS 和 Android 平台应用。它将平台 API 直接连接到 JavaScript 运行时（具有强类型），并将 CSS 和视图模板等熟悉的 Web 方法与通用平台语言（Swift、Kotlin、Objective-C、Java）相结合。
en: NativeScript is a JavaScript-based cross-platform open-source development framework to develop apps for iOS, visionOS and Android platforms. It connects platform APIs directly to the JavaScript runtime (with strong types). combining familiar Web approaches like CSS and view templating with common platform languages (Swift, Kotlin, Objective-C, Java).

zh-Hans: PerfGenius SDK 提供系统状态变化主动上报、显示帧率设置、关键线程设置等接口，为开发者提供一条与硬件直接沟通的通道。开发者借此能了解系统状态并适时调整部分参数，提升系统的性能功耗体验。
en: The PerfGenius SDK offers interfaces for active system status reporting, frame rate configuration, and key thread settings, providing a direct communication channel with hardware. This allows developers to monitor system status and adjust parameters in real-time to optimize performance and power efficiency.

zh-Hans: PixUI 是一个实现了 H5ES 标准的跨平台 UI 引擎，旨在将强大易用的 H5 技术和工作流引入游戏和原生 App 开发，让开发者快速开发出与游戏引擎原生效果一致的 UI 界面，并通过 GPU 实现毫秒级渲染。
en: PixUI is a cross-platform UI engine implementing the H5ES standard, designed to bring powerful and user-friendly H5 technology and workflows to game and native app development. It allows developers to quickly create UIs matching native game engine effects, achieving millisecond-level rendering via the GPU.

zh-Hans: 一个 Android UI 组件库，提供实时、动态的高斯模糊效果。它使用原生 C++ 代码进行高效模糊处理，并提供一组模糊 UI 组件来增强你的应用设计。
en: The Android QmBlurView library provides a high-performance blur implementation, compatible with Android 5.0+.

zh-Hans: 适用于 React Native 的快速 SQLite 库。
en: Fast SQLite library for React Native.

zh-Hans: 在最危险、最隐蔽的机器人程序破坏客户信任之前拦截它们。
en: Stop the most dangerous, evasive bots before they erode customer trust.

zh-Hans: BlackBox 是一个虚拟引擎，可以在 Android 上克隆并运行虚拟应用，用户无需安装 APK 文件即可在设备上运行应用。BlackBox 控制所有虚拟应用，因此您可以通过 BlackBox 随心所欲地进行操作。
en: BlackBox is a virtual engine, it can clone and run virtual application on Android, users don't have to install APK file to run the application on devices. BlackBox control all virtual applications, so you can do anything you want by using BlackBox.

zh-Hans: 提供 Android API，实现数据的快速加密和身份验证。
en: Provides Android APIs for fast data encryption and authentication.

zh-Hans: Croppy 是一个为 Flutter 应用提供直观图片裁剪功能的高性能图片裁剪组件。
en: Croppy is a high-performance image cropping widget that provides intuitive image cropping functionality for Flutter applications.

zh-Hans: dav1d 是一个开源的 AV1 跨平台解码器，专注于速度和正确性。
en: dav1d is an AV1 cross-platform decoder, open-source, and focused on speed and correctness.

zh-Hans: 一个通用库，为音频和视频播放提供独立的 API。
en: A universal library that provides separate APIs for Audio and Video playback.

zh-Hans: 高通 FastCV SDK 提供了针对移动设备优化的计算机视觉（CV）库，专为提高所有基于 ARM 的处理器的效率而设计，包括多种移动设备均可用最常用的视觉处理功能，为开发者提供了最多用的计算密集型视觉处理 API。
en: The Qualcomm FastCV SDK offers a computer vision (CV) library optimized for mobile devices, designed to improve efficiency on all ARM-based processors. It includes common visual processing functions available across various mobile devices, providing developers with widely used APIs for computationally intensive visual processing.

zh-Hans: ffavc 是一个基于 ffmpeg 的视频解码器，它能让 libpag 将 ffmpeg 作为其软件解码器进行 H.264 解码。
en: ffavc is an FFmpeg-based video decoder that allows libpag to utilize FFmpeg as its software decoder for H.264 decoding.

zh-Hans: FluidSynth 是一个开源的软件合成器（software synthesizer），它能够实时将 MIDI 数据转换为音频信号，广泛用于音乐制作、音频开发、嵌入式系统和教育等领域。其核心功能是通过 SoundFont 技术实现高质量的乐器音色合成。
en: FluidSynth is an open-source software synthesizer that converts MIDI data into audio signals in real-time, widely used in music production, audio development, embedded systems, and education. Its core function is achieving high-quality instrument timbre synthesis using SoundFont technology.

zh-Hans: 一个用于查看和编码 AVIF 格式图像的 Flutter 插件。
en: A Flutter plugin for viewing and encoding images in AVIF format.

zh-Hans: 一个开源的Web浏览器引擎。
LiTr（发音为“lai-tr”）是一个轻量级视频/音频转换工具，支持带有可选帧修改功能的视频和音频轨道转码。
en: LiTr (pronounced "lai-tr") is a lightweight video/audio transformation tool which supports transcoding video and audio tracks with optional frame modification.

zh-Hans: Ogg 是一个能将原始音频数据流重组成更稳定、更实用的 Ogg 格式的库。
en: Ogg is a library capable of reassembling raw audio data streams into the more stable and practical Ogg format.

zh-Hans: PuerTS 是 Unity/Unreal/Dotnet 下的 TypeScript 编程解决方案，提供了一个 JavaScript 运行时，并提供 TypeScript 声明文件生成能力，易于通过 TypeScript 访问宿主引擎。
en: PuerTS is a TypeScript programming solution for Unity/Unreal/Dotnet. It provides a JavaScript runtime and TypeScript declaration file generation capabilities, enabling easy access to the host engine via TypeScript.

zh-Hans: 一个 React Native 组件，分别封装了 iOS 的 Slider 和 Android 的 SeekBar。
en: React Native component exposing Slider from iOS and SeekBar from Android.

zh-Hans: 适用于 React Native、React Native Web 和普通 React Web 项目的 SVG 库。
en: SVG library for React Native, React Native Web, and plain React web projects.

zh-Hans: 基于 React Native JSI 技术的移动端键值存储框架。
en: A mobile key-value storage library built on React Native JSI technology.

zh-Hans: Qualcomm 增强型软件开发套件 (QESDK) 提供了一个框架，允许 QTI 服务直接向 Android 应用程序公开 API。
en: The Qualcomm Enhanced Software Development Kit (QESDK) provides a framework that allows QTI services to expose APIs directly to Android applications.

zh-Hans: 为 Wwise 项目提供文本转语音支持。
en: Provides text-to-speech support for Wwise projects.

zh-Hans:
androidx.sqlite 库包含了抽象接口和基本实现，可用于构建您自己的 SQLite 访问库。
您可能需要考虑使用 Room 库，它在 SQLite 之上提供了一个抽象层，以实现更稳健的数据库访问，同时充分利用 SQLite 的强大功能。
en:
The androidx.sqlite library contains abstract interfaces along with basic implementations which can be used to build your own libraries that access SQLite.
You might want to consider using the Room library, which provides an abstraction layer over SQLite to allow for more robust database access while harnessing the full power of SQLite.

zh-Hans: SQLite JDBC 是一个用于在 Java 中访问和创建 SQLite 数据库文件的库。
en: SQLite JDBC is a library for accessing and creating SQLite database files in Java.

zh-Hans: tun2proxy 是一个可在 Linux、Android、macOS、iOS 和 Windows 平台上运行的 HTTP 和 SOCKS 代理隧道接口。
en: tun2proxy is a tunneling interface for HTTP and SOCKS proxies compatible with Linux, Android, macOS, iOS, and Windows platforms.

zh-Hans: React Native Worklets 是一个允许您在多个线程和运行时上并行运行 JavaScript 代码的库。
en: React Native Worklets is a library that allows you to run JavaScript code in parallel on multiple threads and runtimes.

zh-Hans: 通过小鱼易连终端 SDK，开发者可以快速实现多人音视频通话业务场景。平台提供覆盖手机、桌面全平台的终端 SDK，同时终端用户可以在微信小程序、web 网页使用平台提供的音视频服务。
en: With the XYLink Terminal SDK, developers can quickly implement multi-person audio and video calling scenarios. The platform offers terminal SDKs covering mobile and desktop platforms, while end users can access the audio and video services via WeChat mini-programs and web pages.

zh-Hans: 访问基于 Activity 构建的可组合 API。
en: Access composable APIs built on top of Activity.

zh-Hans: Jetpack Media3 是媒体库的新归宿，可帮助 Android 应用呈现丰富的音频和视觉体验。Media3 提供简单的架构，并具备强大的自定义能力、可靠性以及基于设备能力的优化，用于抽象由碎片化带来的复杂性。
en: Jetpack Media3 is the new home for media libraries that enables Android apps to display rich audio and visual experiences. Media3 offers a simple architecture with powerful customization, reliability, and optimizations based on device capabilities to abstract away the complexity that comes with fragmentation.

zh-Hans: Jetpack XR SDK 包含为 Android XR 设备构建沉浸式和增强体验所需的全部工具和库。
en: The Jetpack XR SDK includes all the tools and libraries you need to build immersive and augmented experiences for Android XR devices.

zh-Hans: 一个面向 React Native 的功能丰富的 Android 与 iOS 通知库。
en: A feature rich Android & iOS notifications library for React Native.

zh-Hans: Batch Android SDK 允许你通过高度个性化的推送通知和应用内消息，在 Android 应用中构建有意义的沟通体验。
en: The Batch Android SDK allows you to build meaningful communication experience in your Android app through highly personalized push notifications & In-App messages.

zh-Hans: 作为开发者，你可以使用 Google Tag Manager 在移动应用中实现和管理衡量代码和像素，而无需重新构建应用二进制文件并重新提交到应用市场。使用 Google Analytics for Firebase SDK 的开发者可以轻松添加 Tag Manager，以便即使在应用发布后也能管理实现并进行变更。
en: As a developer, you can use Google Tag Manager to implement and manage measurement tags and pixels in your mobile applications, without having to rebuild and resubmit application binaries to app marketplaces. Developers who work with the Google Analytics for Firebase SDK can easily add Tag Manager to help manage and make changes to the implementation, even after the app has shipped.

zh-Hans: Intercom for Android，用于将 Intercom 集成到你的 Android 应用中。
en: Intercom for Android, for integrating Intercom into your Android application.

zh-Hans: 用于通过 Web 服务验证用户身份的 Flutter 插件。
en: Flutter plugin for authenticating a user with a web service.

zh-Hans: ADAL for Android 让你能够为应用添加对工作帐户的支持。该 SDK 为你的应用提供 Microsoft Azure AD 的完整功能，包括对 OAuth2 等行业标准协议的支持、带用户级同意的 Web API 集成，以及双因素身份验证支持。最重要的是，它是 FOSS（自由及开放源代码软件），因此你可以在我们构建这些库的过程中参与开发。
en: ADAL for Android gives you the ability to add support for Work Accounts to your application. This SDK gives your application the full functionality of Microsoft Azure AD, including industry standard protocol support for OAuth2, Web API integration with user level consent, and two-factor authentication support. Best of all, it’s FOSS (Free and Open Source Software) so that you can participate in the development process as we build these libraries.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android 的 Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) 是一个库，可让 Android 应用通过 Microsoft 标识平台（前身为 Azure Active Directory）对用户进行身份验证，并使用 OAuth2 和 OpenID Connect 协议访问受保护的 Web API。MSAL Android 让开发者可以从 Microsoft 标识平台获取安全令牌，用于为基于 Android 的应用进行用户身份验证并访问安全的 Web API。
en: The Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) for Android is a library that enables Android applications to authenticate users with Microsoft identity platform (formerly Azure Active Directory) and access protected web APIs using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect protocols. MSAL Android enables developers to acquire security tokens from the Microsoft identity platform to authenticate users and access secure web APIs for their Android based applications.

zh-Hans: 适用于 Android 的 Microsoft Intune App SDK 允许你将 Intune 应用保护策略集成到原生 Java/Kotlin Android 应用中。这些策略也称为 MAM 策略。由 Intune 管理的应用是指已集成 Intune App SDK 的应用。当 Intune 主动管理应用时，Intune 管理员可以轻松地将应用保护策略部署到你的 Intune 托管应用。
en: The Microsoft Intune App SDK for Android lets you incorporate Intune app protection policies into your native Java/Kotlin Android app. These policies are also known as MAM policies. An Intune-managed application is one that is integrated with the Intune App SDK. When Intune actively manages the app, Intune administrators can easily deploy app protection policies to your Intune-managed app.

zh-Hans: AppFunctions 是一个 Android 平台 API，并配套提供 Jetpack 库，用于简化 Android MCP 集成。它使你的应用能够像设备端 MCP 服务器一样运行，贡献可作为工具使用的函数，供主动功能以及代理和助手（如 Google Gemini）使用。截至 2026 年 5 月，AppFunctions 与 Gemini 的集成正在面向受信任测试者进行私有预览。你现在可以开始准备应用，以使用 AppFunctions 和相关开发工具。
en: AppFunctions is an Android platform API with an accompanying Jetpack library to simplify Android MCP integration. It empowers your apps to behave like on device MCP servers, contributing functions that act as tools for use by proactive features along with agents and assistants, like Google Gemini. As of May 2026, AppFunctions integration with Gemini is in a private preview with trusted testers. You can begin preparing your apps now to use AppFunctions and development tools.

zh-Hans: Open Chinese Convert（OpenCC，开放中文转换）是一个用于在繁体中文、简体中文和日语汉字（新字体）之间进行转换的开源项目。支持字符级别和词汇级别的转换、异体字转换以及中国大陆、台湾地区和香港地区之间的区域性习惯用语转换。它不是普通话和粤语等语言之间的翻译工具。
en: Open Chinese Convert (OpenCC) is an open-source project for conversion between Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese Kanji (Shinjitai). It supports character-level and phrase-level conversion, variant character conversion, and regional idiom conversion among Mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. It is not a translation tool between languages such as Mandarin and Cantonese.

zh-Hans: react-native-mmkv 是一个库，可让你通过到原生 C++ 库的快速直接 JS 绑定，在 React Native 应用中轻松使用 MMKV。
en: react-native-mmkv is a library that allows you to easily use MMKV inside your React Native app through fast and direct JS bindings to the native C++ library.

zh-Hans: Nitro Modules 是高效的原生模块，具有静态编译到 JSI 的绑定层以及类型安全的 JS 绑定。
en: Nitro Modules are highly efficient native modules with a statically compiled binding layer to JSI, and typesafe JS bindings.

zh-Hans: 江西影安科技有限公司
由江西影安科技有限公司提供的安卓应用加固，包含签名验证、定制vmp保护、模块化加固、私人定制特征、dex定制加壳等保护。
en: 江西影安科技有限公司

Android application hardening provided by Jiangxi Ying'an Technology Co., Ltd., including signature verification, custom VMP protection, modular hardening, privately customized signatures, and custom DEX packing protection.

zh-Hans: SkiaSharp 是一个基于 Google Skia Graphics Library 的跨平台 2D 图形 API，面向 .NET 平台。它提供完整的 2D API，可在移动端、服务器和桌面模型中用于渲染图像。
en: SkiaSharp is a cross-platform 2D graphics API for .NET platforms based on Google's Skia Graphics Library. It provides a comprehensive 2D API that can be used across mobile, server and desktop models to render images.

zh-Hans: Skip 将 Swift 应用开发带到 Android。它是一款工具，使开发者能够基于单一 Swift 和 SwiftUI 代码库，为 iOS 和 Android 构建真正原生的应用。
en: Skip brings Swift app development to Android. It is a tool that enables developers to build genuinely native apps for both iOS and Android from a single Swift and SwiftUI codebase.

zh-Hans: Vulkan 是一种显式 API，能够直接控制 GPU 的实际工作方式。按照设计，Vulkan 驱动内部只进行最少量的错误检查。应用对正确运行拥有完全控制权，也承担完全责任。任何 Vulkan 使用方式上的错误都可能导致崩溃。该项目提供 Vulkan 验证层，可在开发过程中启用，帮助开发者验证应用是否正确使用 Vulkan API。
en: Vulkan is an Explicit API, enabling direct control over how GPUs actually work. By design, minimal error checking is done inside a Vulkan driver. Applications have full control and responsibility for correct operation. Any errors in how Vulkan is used can result in a crash. This project provides Vulkan validation layers that can be enabled to assist development by enabling developers to verify their applications correct use of the Vulkan API.

zh-Hans: 阿里云云解析DNS深度融合公共云与IDC解析能力，实现全场景覆盖、全链路解析与一站式管理，为企业提供全面、易用、高效的平台化域名解析服务。无论多云、混合云架构，还是移动应用与物联网场景，均可灵活适配，助力企业降本增效，构建稳定可靠的网络环境。
en: Alibaba Cloud DNS deeply integrates public cloud and IDC DNS resolution capabilities, enabling full-scenario coverage, end-to-end resolution, and one-stop management. It provides enterprises with a comprehensive, easy-to-use, and efficient platform-based domain name resolution service. Whether for multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures, or for mobile applications and IoT scenarios, it can adapt flexibly, helping enterprises reduce costs, improve efficiency, and build a stable and reliable network environment.

zh-Hans: libarc 是一个轻量级的C语言解压缩库，专注于解压而非压缩。它支持 tar、tar.gz/tgz、zip、lzh 和 MIME multipart 等格式，适合在嵌入式或资源受限环境中使用。
en: libarc is a lightweight C decompression library focused on decompression rather than compression. It supports formats such as tar, tar.gz/tgz, zip, lzh, and MIME multipart, making it suitable for embedded or resource-constrained environments.

zh-Hans: Open Asset Import Library 是一个可将多种 3D 文件格式加载为共享内存格式的库。它支持导入 40 多种文件格式，并支持数量持续增长的导出文件格式。
en: Open Asset Import Library is a library that loads various 3D file formats into a shared, in-memory format. It supports more than 40 file formats for import and a growing selection of file formats for export.

zh-Hans: 用于应用增量补丁的 bsdiff 库。
en: A bsdiff library for applying application delta patches.

zh-Hans: Comscore 是一家跨平台测量公司，可在各处精准衡量受众、品牌和消费者行为。
en: Comscore is the cross-platform measurement company that precisely measures audiences, brands and consumer behavior everywhere.

zh-Hans: 为应用中 C/C++ 代码引发的问题发送崩溃报告。
en: Send crash report for issues rising from the C/C++ code in your application.

zh-Hans: libfmodstudio.so 是 FMOD Studio 高级音频引擎的运行时库。它提供 API，用于播放在 FMOD Studio 工具中设计的复杂交互式声音事件、自适应音乐和 3D 空间音频。
en: libfmodstudio.so is the runtime library for the FMOD Studio high-level audio engine. It provides the API for playing back complex, interactive sound events, adaptive music, and 3D spatial audio designed in the FMOD Studio tool.

zh-Hans: LuaJIT 是 Lua 编程语言的即时编译器（JIT）。Lua 是一种强大、动态且轻量级的编程语言。它可以嵌入使用，也可以作为通用的独立语言使用。
en: LuaJIT is a Just-In-Time Compiler (JIT) for the Lua programming language. Lua is a powerful, dynamic and light-weight programming language. It may be embedded or used as a general-purpose, stand-alone language.

zh-Hans: 用 Rust 创建 Matrix 客户端的一体化工具包，覆盖从简单机器人到功能完整应用的开发。
en: Your all-in-one toolkit for creating Matrix clients with Rust, from simple bots to full-featured apps.

zh-Hans: Open XML SDK 是一个用于处理 Microsoft Office Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文档的框架。它包含与 OPC 包、Flat OPC 文件以及两种形式的 Open XML 标记（即强类型类和 LINQ to XML）相关的底层操作 API。它的设计目标是紧密遵循 Microsoft Office 对 ISO 29500 标准的实现，但并不旨在直接提供更高层级的抽象或生产力工具。
en: The Open XML SDK is a framework for working with Microsoft Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents. It includes APIs for low-level operations related to OPC packages, Flat OPC files, and Open XML markup in two forms (i.e., strongly-typed classes and LINQ to XML). It is designed to closely follow the Microsoft Office implementation of the ISO 29500 standard, but was not intended to directly provide higher-level abstractions or productivity tools.

zh-Hans: 这个共享库和静态库仅基于公开稳定的 JNI API，包含 libnativehelper 中一部分辅助例程。它会随调用方代码一起分发，并且由于非常轻量（小于 20 KB），通常更适合静态链接。这个库的名称有些误导，因为它不包含任何 C++ 代码。
en: This shared and static library contains a subset of the helper routines in libnativehelper based only on public stable JNI APIs. It gets distributed with the caller code and is preferrably linked statically since it is very thin (less than 20 KB). The name of this library is a misnomer since it contains no C++ code.

zh-Hans: 该包包含一个为 IPv6 邻居发现协议提供封装的库。它还提供了一个名为 ndptool 的工具，用于发送和接收 NDP 消息。
en: This package contains a library which provides a wrapper for IPv6 Neighbor Discovery Protocol. It also provides a tool named ndptool for sending and receiving NDP messages.

zh-Hans: Krypton Wrapper（又名 NG-GL4ES）是 gl4es 和 gl4es-114-extra 的一个分支。
en: Krypton Wrapper (aka NG-GL4ES) is a fork from gl4es and gl4es-114-extra.

zh-Hans: @rnx-kit/react-native-host 简化了 React Native 初始化。该包旨在提供一种向后（以及向前）兼容的 React Native 初始化方式，无论你使用的是新架构还是已完全无桥化。@rnx-kit/react-native-host 还将提供一种简单方式来启用拆分包和服务交付。
en: @rnx-kit/react-native-host simplifies React Native initialization. The aim of this package is to provide a backwards (and forwards) compatible way of initializing React Native, regardless of whether you're on New Architecture or have gone fully bridgeless.@rnx-kit/react-native-host will also a provide a simple way to enable split bundles and service delivery.

zh-Hans: 1DS（One Data Strategy，也称为 One Observability）C/C++ SDK 支持从多种 Microsoft 产品中进行跨平台遥测收集。它支持将数据/遥测上传到 Collector++。
en: 1DS (One Data Strategy, also known as One Observability) C/C++ SDK enables cross-platform telemetry collection from various Microsoft products. It enables data / telemetry upload to Collector++.

zh-Hans: Phira是一款由TeamFlos参照Phigros玩法编写的、基于Rust和MacroQuad的音乐游戏。
en: Phira is a music game developed by TeamFlos, inspired by Phigros gameplay and built with Rust and MacroQuad.

zh-Hans: Ruffle 是一个使用 Rust 编程语言编写的 Adobe Flash Player 模拟器。
en: Ruffle is an Adobe Flash Player emulator written in the Rust programming language.

zh-Hans: 一个速度奇快的 JSON 序列化/反序列化库，由 JIT (即时编译) 和 SIMD (单指令流多数据流) 加速。
en: An extremely fast JSON serialization/deserialization library accelerated by JIT (Just-In-Time compilation) and SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data).

zh-Hans: Ultra HDR 是一种真正的 HDR 图像格式，并且向后兼容。libultrahdr 是 Ultra HDR 格式的参考编解码器。支持该格式的编解码器可以在 HDR 显示器上呈现图像的 HDR 意图；其他编解码器仍然可以解码并显示图像的 SDR 意图。
en: Ultra HDR is a true HDR image format, and is backcompatible. libultrahdr is the reference codec for the Ultra HDR format. The codecs that support the format can render the HDR intent of the image on HDR displays; other codecs can still decode and display the SDR intent of the image.

zh-Hans: libuv 是一个多平台支持库，重点关注异步 I/O。它最初主要为 Node.js 使用而开发，但也被 Luvit、Julia、uvloop 等项目使用。
en: libuv is a multi-platform support library with a focus on asynchronous I/O. It was primarily developed for use by Node.js, but it's also used by Luvit, Julia, uvloop, and others.

zh-Hans: open-vcdiff 是 VCDIFF 格式的编码器和解码器，该格式见 RFC 3284：VCDIFF 通用差分和压缩数据格式。
en: open-vcdiff is an encoder and decoder for the VCDIFF format, as described in RFC 3284: The VCDIFF Generic Differencing and Compression Data Format.

zh-Hans: Wasmer 是一个极速且安全的 WebAssembly 运行时，可让极其轻量的容器在任何地方运行：从桌面到云端、边缘以及浏览器。
en: Wasmer is a blazing fast and secure WebAssembly runtime that enables incredibly lightweight containers to run anywhere: from Desktop to the Cloud, Edge and your browser.

zh-Hans: WebView 组件基于 Chromium 开源项目。WebView 与 Android 版 Chrome 共用相同的渲染引擎，因此 WebView 和 Chrome 之间的渲染应保持一致。
en: The WebView component is based on the Chromium open-source project. WebView and Chrome for Android share the same rendering engine, so rendering should remain consistent between WebView and Chrome.

zh-Hans: React Native Share 是一个用于与其他应用分享消息和文件的简单工具。
en: React Native Share, is a simple tool for sharing messages and files with other apps.

zh-Hans: 一个致力于让 React Native 开发者更轻松、更高效地进行文件访问和数据传输的项目。
en: A project committed to making file access and data transfer easier, efficient for React Native developers.

zh-Hans: 一个致力于让 React Native 开发者更轻松、更高效地进行文件访问和数据传输的项目。
en: A project committed to making file access and data transfer easier, efficient for React Native developers.

zh-Hans: 适用于 iOS/Android 的图像选择器，支持相机、视频、可配置压缩、多图选择和裁剪。
en: iOS/Android image picker with support for camera, video, configurable compression, multiple images and cropping.

zh-Hans: React Native Firebase 是一组官方 React Native 模块，用于连接 Firebase 服务；每个模块都是一个轻量级 JavaScript 层，可连接到适用于 iOS 和 Android 的原生 Firebase SDK。
en: React Native Firebase is a collection of official React Native modules connecting you to Firebase services; each module is a light-weight JavaScript layer connecting you to the native Firebase SDKs for both iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: 为 Android、iOS、桌面和 Web 构建美观的共享 UI，并在每个平台上都呈现自然的体验。
en: Build beautiful shared UIs for Android, iOS, desktop, and web that feel natural on every platform.

zh-Hans: 适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 React Native 本地与远程通知。
en: React Native Local and Remote Notifications for iOS and Android.

zh-Hans: 一个 Flutter 地理定位插件，可便捷访问平台特定的位置服务（Android 上为 FusedLocationProviderClient，若不可用则为 LocationManager；iOS 上为 CLLocationManager）
en: A Flutter geolocation plugin which provides easy access to platform specific location services (FusedLocationProviderClient, or if not available the LocationManager on Android and CLLocationManager on iOS)

zh-Hans: 通过将全球优质需求与出色的广告体验匹配到你的广告库存，提升每次展示的收益，从而增加收入。
